games.title: 1000xRESIST
games.shortDescription: 1000xRESIST is a thrilling sci-fi adventure. The year is unknown, and a disease spread by an alien invasion keeps you underground. You are Watcher. You dutifully fulfil your purpose in serving the ALLMOTHER, until the day you discover a shocking secret that changes everything.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《1000xRESIST》是一款惊心动魄的科幻冒险游戏。故事的年份未知，异星种群入侵，带来了某种疾病，迫使人们逃入地下。你是观灵，侍奉“全人之母”是你的天责，只是某天你得知一个惊天秘密，一切就此改变。

games.title: 33 Immortals
games.shortDescription: 33 Immortals is a co-op action-roguelike for 33 players. Jump straight into runs, solo or with friends. Battle hordes of monsters, defeat massive bosses, and grow stronger each run. Use in-game emotes to coordinate and combine powers with your fellow rebels, and face the Wrath of God, together.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 33 Immortals is a co-op action-roguelike for 33 players. Jump straight into runs, solo or with friends. Battle hordes of monsters, defeat massive bosses, and grow stronger each run. Use in-game emotes to coordinate and combine powers with your fellow rebels, and face the Wrath of God, together.

games.title: 9 Kings (Game Preview)
games.shortDescription: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 一款快节奏的王国建造类Roguelike游戏，数百张独特卡牌，数千种疯狂构筑，突破游戏规则……与九王史诗对决、赢得战斗、扩展帝国，成就众王之王！

games.title: A Game About Digging A Hole™
games.shortDescription: The original now on console!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 原版现已登陆主机！

games.title: A Way Out
games.shortDescription:
A Way Out is an exclusively co-op adventure where you play the role of one of two prisoners making their daring escape from prison.
Play the entire experience with your friends using the friends pass free trial feature.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《A Way Out》是场专为合作模式打造的冒险，您将扮演两名囚犯之一，一道从监狱中逃出生天。
通过好友免费试玩功能，您的好友可以免费和您一起体验整部游戏。

games.title: Abiotic Factor
games.shortDescription: Survive To See Your Next Day Off!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 活下去才能迎接下一天的休息日

games.title: Absolum
games.shortDescription: An original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 由Dotemu出品的原创Roguelite清版动作游戏!

games.title: Abyssus
games.shortDescription: Choose your loadout, blast through the corrupted denizens of a sunken civilization, and wield godly powers in Abyssus – a fast-paced 1-to-4 players FPS and roguelite brinepunk adventure.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 选择你的装备，在沉没文明的腐化居民间杀出一条血路，在《深渊之潮》中掌握神之力量——这是一款节奏紧凑的1-4人合作FPS和Roguelite类型的盐水朋克冒险游戏。

games.title: Aerial_Knight's DropShot
games.shortDescription: Dropshot is a fast-paced, stylized FPS where you face off against enemies to grab a parachute and land first. Armed with limited "Finger Gun" bullets, outsmart enemies, avoid fire, and use slipstreams to survive. Only one will make it.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Dropshot is a fast-paced, stylized FPS where you face off against enemies to grab a parachute and land first. Armed with limited "Finger Gun" bullets, outsmart enemies, avoid fire, and use slipstreams to survive. Only one will make it.

games.title: Age of Empires Definitive Edition
games.shortDescription: Age of Empires, the pivotal real-time strategy game that launched a 20-year legacy returns with modernized gameplay, all-new 4K visuals, 8-person multiplayer battles and a host of other new features.  Welcome back to history.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 出自二十年前的经典即时战略游戏《帝国时代》，将正式推出 Windows 10 PC 版。为您带来超过 40 个小时的现代化游戏内容、全新 4K 视觉效果、能和八位玩家进行多人游戏对战以及其他许多全新功能。现在就是投入《帝国时代》的最佳时机。欢迎重返历史荣光。

games.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
games.developer: World's Edge | Forgotten Empires | Tantalus | Wicked Witch
games.shortDescription: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition celebrates the 20th anniversary of one of the most popular strategy games ever, now with stunning 4K Ultra HD graphics, and a fully remastered soundtrack.  Age of Empires II: DE features “The Last Khans” with 3 new campaigns and 4 new Civilizations. Frequent updates include events, additional content, new game modes, and enhanced features with the recent addition of Co-Op mode!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 有史以来最受欢迎的战略游戏之一迎来 20 周年，为此我们推出了《帝国时代 II：决定版》。本作拥有惊人的 4K 超高画质，全面重制的新原声音乐，以及内含 3 个新战役和 4 个新文明的内容：《最后的可汗》。常态更新项目包括活动、添加内容、新游戏模式，以及随近期上线的合作模式所带来的增强功能！

metacritic.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition

games.title: Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition
games.developer: World's Edge | Tantalus Media | Forgotten Empires
games.shortDescription: Lead powerful civilizations across the globe, master strategies and tactics, and relive history in co op battles—now remastered in stunning 4K and modernized gameplay.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 率领世界上的强大文明，施展战略和战术，在合作战斗中重温历史——现已重制为惊艳的 4K 画质以及现代化玩法。

metacritic.title: Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition

games.title: Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition
games.shortDescription:
For years you’ve battled armies and made history your story. Now it’s time to make history once more with a new breakthrough in strategy gaming – introducing Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition, now available on Xbox consoles.* Includes native inputs for Xbox controller, console-specific user interface, and a new tutorial designed for first time players to help achieve easy setup and success.

*This content is available on Xbox consoles as a free download for current Xbox Game Pass subscribers and owners of Age of Empires IV on PC, excluding Steam purchasers.
games.titleZh: 帝国时代 IV：周年纪念版
games.shortDescriptionZh:
多年来，您挥毫征战，书写了属于自己的历史。现在，是时候通过战略游戏的新突破再次创造历史了——隆重介绍《帝国时代 VI：周年纪念版》，现已在 Xbox 游戏主机上推出。*包含 Xbox 控制器的原始输入，游戏主机特定的用户界面，以及为新玩家设计的全新教程，帮助玩家轻松完成设置并获得胜利。

*此内容可在 Xbox 主机上以免费下载的方式提供给当前 Xbox Game Pass 订阅者和 PC 上《帝国时代 VI》的所有者，不包括 Steam 购买者。

games.title: Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition
games.shortDescription:
Celebrating its first year of delighting millions of global players, the award-winning and best-selling strategy franchise continues with Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition, putting you at the center of even more epic historical battles that shaped the world. 

Featuring both familiar and innovative new ways to expand your empire, Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition brings an evolved real-time strategy game to the next level with a host of free new content and features including brand-new civilizations, new maps, additional in-game updates and languages, and new masteries, challenges, taunts and cheats – all at an amazing value that packs in more history than ever before!
games.titleZh: 帝国时代 IV：周年纪念版
games.shortDescriptionZh:
为了庆祝全球玩家在第一年达到数百万人，这款屡获殊荣且最受欢迎的即时战略游戏系列将随《帝国时代 IV：周年纪念版》荣耀回归，让您置身于塑造全新世界的更多史诗般历史战役的中心。

《帝国时代 IV：周年纪念版》同时采用常见及创新手法，让您能在以令人惊艳 4K 视觉保真度呈现的浩大场景中拓展帝国版图，并成功带领进化版即时战略游戏迈向新世代。本作包括许多免费的新内容和功能，例如全新的文明、新地图、更多游戏内更新和语言，以及全新的精通项目、挑战、叫嚣文件和作弊码。这些带来了惊人的价值，提供比以往版本更丰富的历史体验！

games.title: Age of Mythology: Retold
games.developer: World's Edge | Forgotten Empires | Tantalus Media | Virtuos | CaptureAge
games.shortDescription: From the creators of the award-winning Age of Empires franchise, Age of Mythology: Retold goes beyond history to a mythical age where gods, monsters, and humans collide.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《神话时代：重述版》由屡获殊荣的《帝国时代》系列的创作者精心制作，该游戏超越了历史，进入了一个众神、怪物和人类碰撞的神话时代。

games.title: Albion Online
games.shortDescription: Albion Online is a sandbox MMORPG in which you write your own story. Explore a vast open world, grow your wealth, forge alliances, and leave your mark on the world of Albion!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《阿尔比恩Online》是一款沙盒MMORPG，您可以在其中书写自己的故事。探索一个广阔的开放世界，累积财富，建立联盟，并在阿尔比恩的世界上留下您的印记！

games.title: Alice: Madness Returns
games.shortDescription: Eleven years ago Alice lost her family to a horrific fire. Afterwards Alice struggled to face her demons by escaping to Wonderland. Alice now returns to Wonderland, seeking what the “real” world can’t provide. However, an evil is now descending upon what once was her refuge. Can Alice save Wonderland—and herself—from the madness that consumes them both?
games.titleZh: 爱丽丝惊魂记：疯狂再临
games.shortDescriptionZh: 11年前，一場兇殘的大火帶走了愛麗絲的家人。之後，愛麗絲設法逃避心裡創傷，遁入了仙境世界。現在，愛麗絲重返仙境，尋找「現實」世界無法提供的一切。然而，邪魔潛入了這個曾經為她帶來庇護的地方。愛麗絲能否拯救仙境 - 和她自己 - 並阻止瘋狂將其一起吞沒？

games.title: Aliens: Dark Descent
games.shortDescription: Drop into the gripping journey of Aliens: Dark Descent, a squad-based, single-player action game in the iconic Alien franchise. Lead your soldiers in real-time to stop a new and terrifying kind of Xenomorph outbreak on Moon Lethe.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《异形：坠入黑暗》是一款以小队为单位的单人动作游戏，标志性科幻大作《异形》系列的又一游戏力作，来开启这场扣人心弦的征程吧。实时带领你的士兵阻止忘川月上一种新的可怕异形的大爆发。

games.title: Aliens: Dark Descent (Windows)
games.shortDescription: Drop into the gripping journey of Aliens: Dark Descent, a squad-based, single-player action game in the iconic Alien franchise. Lead your soldiers in real-time to stop a new and terrifying kind of Xenomorph outbreak on Moon Lethe.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《异形：坠入黑暗》是一款以小队为单位的单人动作游戏，标志性科幻大作《异形》系列的又一游戏力作，来开启这场扣人心弦的征程吧。实时带领你的士兵阻止忘川月上一种新的可怕异形的大爆发。

games.title: Among Us
games.shortDescription: An online and local party game of teamwork and betrayal for 4-15 players...in space!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这是一款可以连线或本地游玩的派对游戏，4 到 15 位玩家相互合作与背叛... 一切都发生在太空之中！

games.title: An Elder Scrolls Legend: Battlespire
games.shortDescription:
TRAPPED IN THE REALM OF DARKNESS

The Imperial Battle College has lost contact with the Battlespire, an elite training center hidden in a pocket realm of Oblivion. An agent sent to investigate discovers the Battlespire’s staff dead and the gate back to Tamriel blocked With the facility under siege by vile daedra, the only way out is to go deep into darkness and into the Daedric Realms.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
身陷黑暗王国

帝国战斗学院已经与战斗神塔——一个隐藏于《湮灭》口袋领域的精英训练中心失去了联系。一名被派去调查的特工发现战斗神塔的工作人员已经死亡，通往泰姆瑞尔的大门也被封锁了。由于设施受到了卑鄙恶魔的包围，唯一的出路就是深入黑暗，打入魔族领域。

games.title: Aniimo
games.shortDescription:
Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. On the vast continent of Idyll, you'll encounter countless unique creatures known as Aniimo. Twine with them and experience the beauty of this world from a completely new perspective and with new abilities.
You can also travel to a metropolis floating in the sky, where you'll meet other Pathfinders, share stories, and engage in t
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《伊莫》是一款多人在线大世界捉宠RPG。你将在广袤的艾德尔大陆上邂逅各种神奇生物——伊莫。和他们联结合体，还能以全新的视角和能力感受这个世界的美好。你也可以来到浮空天际的近未来都市，邂逅其他冒险家，交流旅途心得或是感受竞技的魅力。快带上你的伊莫，开启一场超越想象的大世界冒险之旅吧！

这莫多！形态分支进化，填满你的图鉴！

每只伊莫都会因区域、天气、养成方式和成长线的不同，进化出多样分支形态。从沙滩形态到潮湿形态，从晒日光浴的海湾红，到分支进化为女巫草或“家里蹲”埋埋，生态千差万别。丰富的形态图鉴等待你捕捉收集、培养与研究，构筑独属于你的莫百科！

这莫变！联结变身冒险，探索世界奇妙

在冒险的旅途中，你将与伊莫联结合体，并利用伊莫的各种能力：完成世界上的谜题，赢得每场战斗的胜利，解决遇到的一切问题！不再局限于人类的速度、视野和能力，亲自体验理性与野性共存的蓬勃。与伊莫“联结”合体，用全新

games.title: ANNO : Mutationem
games.shortDescription: ANNO: Mutationem is an action-adventure game with RPG elements set in a cyberpunk world, featuring a unique mix of pixelated 2D & 3D graphic style with a rich, dark and bizarre plot.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 欢迎来到纪元:变异，这是一个灯火霓虹彻夜不休的赛博朋克世界，血筹在巨型企业中翻涌流动，神秘的边缘群体和难以名状的怪异生物游走其间，而在凝重的黑暗中，有些东西永远无法被照亮。

games.title: Anno 1800™
games.shortDescription: Welcome to the dawn of the Industrial Age. Experience one of the most exciting & fast-changing periods of all time in a rich city-building experience.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
歡迎來到工業時代的黎明
透過豐富的城市建造遊戲，體驗有史以來最刺激和變動最快速的時代之一

games.title: Anno 1800™ Console Edition
games.shortDescription:
Welcome to the dawn of the Industrial Age in this city-building real-time strategy game. Experience one of the most exciting and fast-changing periods of all time as you discover new technologies, regions, and societies, implement your own strategy, and build a new world to your design.

Play solo or use the online mode to play PvP or co-op modes: How the world remembers your name is up to you.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
歡迎透過這款城市建造即時策略遊戲，來到工業時代的黎明。體驗有史以來最刺激和變動最快速的時代之一，探索新科技、區域與社會，執行屬於你的策略，打造你所設計的新世界。

獨自遊玩或使用線上模式遊玩 PvP 或合作模式——你的名聲就掌握在自己手中。

games.title: Aphelion
games.shortDescription: Hunted on a frozen planet, astronaut Ariane must brave rugged landscapes and shifting realities to rescue her wounded partner, Thomas. This action-packed sci-fi adventure blends exploration, traversal, and tense stealth gameplay.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在一颗遍布冰冻荒原的行星上，宇航员阿丽安娜遭遇生死追猎。为拯救受伤的同伴托马斯，她必须穿越险峻地形与不断扭曲的现实。这款险象环生的科幻冒险游戏融合了探索、攀越及惊险刺激的潜行玩法，为你带来一场步步惊心的生存之旅。

games.title: Ara History Untold: Anniversary Edition
games.shortDescription:
Build a nation and lead your people throughout history to the pinnacles of human achievement as you explore new lands, develop arts and culture, conduct diplomacy, and go head-to-head with your rivals to prove you are the greatest ruler ever known. It's Your World Now.

With your pre-order of the Deluxe Edition receive the Gilded Leader Skin Set.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
建立国家，带领你的子民开疆拓土，发展艺术与文化，施展外交手段，并与其他势力一较高下，穿越历史长河，成为人类文明最为璀璨的那颗明珠，证明你才是有史以来最伟大的统治者。历史任由你来书写。

访问 arahistoryuntold.com，加入内测会员计划！

games.title: ARK: Survival Ascended
games.shortDescription: ARK is reimagined from the ground-up in this next-generation of video game technology with Unreal Engine 5! Form a tribe, tame & breed hundreds of unique dinosaurs and creatures, explore, craft, build, and fight your way to the top of the food-chain. Your new world awaits!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在使用Unreal Engine 5的这一下一代视频游戏技术中，ARK从基础上重新构想！形成一个部落，驯服和繁殖数百种独特的恐龙和生物，探索，制作，建造和战斗到食物链的顶部。您的新世界正在等待！

games.title: ARK: Ultimate Survivor Edition
games.shortDescription: Experience everything that the ARK franchise has to offer in this definitive collection! With thousands of hours of unique content in an eons-spanning saga, you'll tame and ride primeval creatures as you explore savage lands, team up with other players to compete in epic tribal battles, and travel together on the greatest dinosaur-filled adventure of all time!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 通过数千小时的独特内容，在方舟决定合集里来体验这里才有的一切！，驯服和骑乘原始的野兽，探索蛮荒大陆，与其他玩家组队进行史诗般的部落战役，沉浸在充满空龙的终极冒险中！

games.title: ARK: Ultimate Survivor Edition
games.shortDescription: Experience everything that the ARK franchise has to offer in this definitive collection! With thousands of hours of unique content in an eons-spanning saga, you'll tame and ride primeval creatures as you explore savage lands, team up with other players to compete in epic tribal battles, and travel together on the greatest dinosaur-filled adventure of all time!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 通过数千小时的独特内容，在方舟决定合集里来体验这里才有的一切！，驯服和骑乘原始的野兽，探索蛮荒大陆，与其他玩家组队进行史诗般的部落战役，沉浸在充满空龙的终极冒险中！

games.title: Army of Two™
games.shortDescription: When one man is not enough, it will take an army of two to fight through war, political turmoil and a conspiracy so vast it threatens the entire world.Some multi-player functionalities may no longer be supported.
games.shortDescriptionZh: When one man is not enough, it will take an army of two to fight through war, political turmoil and a conspiracy so vast it threatens the entire world.Some multi-player functionalities may no longer be supported.

games.title: Arx Fatalis
games.shortDescription: This critically acclaimed first-person RPG from Arkane Studios takes the player on an amazing journey into the fantasy world of Arx. As your epic quest unfolds you will explore ancient temples, bustling cities and abandoned mines; unearth legendary artifacts and face terrifying foes.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这款由Arkane Studios发布的第一人称角色扮演游戏广受好评，它将带着玩家在Arx的奇幻世界里，来一场惊奇之旅。随着史诗般的任务展开，你将探索古老的庙宇、熙熙攘攘的城市和废弃的矿场，发现传世宝物，还要直面可怕的敌人。

games.title: As Dusk Falls
games.shortDescription: As Dusk Falls is an original interactive drama from INTERIOR/NIGHT that explores the entangled lives of two families across thirty years. Starting in 1998 with a robbery-gone-wrong in small town Arizona, the choices you make have a powerful impact on the characters’ lives in this uncompromising story of betrayal, sacrifice and resilience. Drive the lives and relationships of multiple characters in a decades-spanning story told across two intense books.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《日落黄昏时》是 INTERIOR/NIGHT 的一款原创剧情互动类游戏，主线探索两个家族在三十年以来错综复杂的关系。这个沉重的故事自 1998 年一起亚利桑那州小镇发生的抢案开始，故事讲述背叛、牺牲和毅力，而您在游戏中所做的每一个选择，都会对角色的人生带来重大的影响。在跨越数十年的故事中，通过两方充满情感和情绪的方式讲述多个角色的生活和关系。

games.title: Ascend to ZERO
games.shortDescription: You control the power of time in Ascend to ZERO! Turn every second into a weapon and fight your way to the top in this action-roguelike!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 掌控时间的力量，将每一秒化为武器，登顶巅峰！时间掌控动作肉鸽游戏《零秒：时光的归途》！

games.title: Asphalt Legends
games.shortDescription: Spark your competitive soul with Asphalt Legends and feel the collective heartbeat of the road! Join forces with other players to speed through intense arcade races, perform jaw-dropping stunts, and charge towards victory while driving the finest hypercars!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《狂野飙车：竞速传奇》中点亮您的竞技之魂，在赛道上感受什么是一体同心！与其他车手合作，在精彩刺激的街头比赛中极速飞驰，完成令人瞠目的特技，驾驶精美绝伦的赛车冲向胜利！

games.title: Assassin's Creed 2
games.shortDescription: An epic story of family, vengeance and conspiracy set in the pristine, yet brutal, backdrop of a Renaissance Italy.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 以文艺复兴时期为背景，在古朴而又残酷的意大利，上演了一部关于家庭、复仇和阴谋的精彩故事。

games.title: Assassin's Creed Brotherhood
games.shortDescription: Live and breathe as Ezio, a legendary Master Assassin, in his enduring struggle against the powerful Templar Order. He must journey into Italy’s greatest city, Rome, center of power, greed and corruption to strike at the heart of the enemy.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 从一代传奇刺客大师艾吉奥的视角，与强大的圣殿骑士团展开斗争。他必须启程前往意大利最伟大的城市罗马，在权力、贪婪和腐败的中心彻底消灭敌人。

games.title: Assassin's Creed Chronicles – Russia
games.shortDescription:
Play as the Assassin Nikolaï Orelov and fight your way through a depiction of 1918 Russia in an iconic propaganda art style.
• Survive the aftermath of October Revolution 
• Experience the thrill of being an Assassin in an exclusive 2.5D modern setting with interactive environmental stealth systems.
• Switch between two playable characters: Nikolaï & Anastasia with their unique playstyles.
games.titleZh: 刺客信条编年史：俄罗斯
games.shortDescriptionZh:
扮演刺客「尼古拉．奥列洛夫」（Nikolaï Orelov），深入 1918 年特殊政治宣传画风下的俄罗斯，一路奋战到底。
• 在十月革命的余波之中求生存
• 在独特的 2.5D 现代场景和互动式环境潜行系统中，体验扮演刺客的刺激感。
• 两名角色可切换：尼古拉和安娜塔西亚，体验不同的游戏风格。

games.title: Assassin's Creed Chronicles – Trilogy
games.shortDescription:
Expand your Assassin’s Creed experience and discover the forgotten stories of three remarkable Assassins in brand-new settings with fresh 2.5D stealth gameplay:

• Experience the thrill of being an Assassin in three exciting & original chronicles
• Live the adventures of three cult Assassins: Shao Jun, Arbaaz and Orelov
• Dive into stunning and stylized living environments
games.shortDescriptionZh:
继续你的《刺客信条》冒险之旅，体验三位伟大刺客被遗忘的故事。全新的游戏设定，新颖的 2.5D 潜行游戏玩法： 

• 在三个惊心动魄的原创编年史中体验身为一名刺客的紧张刺激
• 开始三位偶像级刺客少芸、阿尔巴兹和奥列洛夫的冒险之旅
• 绚丽和风格迥异的生活环境毕竟让你沉浸其中

games.title: Assassin's Creed Chronicles : China
games.shortDescription:
Exact Shao Jun’s vengeance on the Chinese Emperor in stunning 16th century China with fresh 2.5D stealth gameplay:

• Embody a stealthy Assassin with unique combat skills and gear like the Shoe Blade and the Rope Dart
• Discover the story of Shao Jun, the last remaining Assassin of the Chinese Brotherhood
• Dive into a beautiful Chinese setting by travelling across the great empire of China
games.titleZh: 刺客教条：编年史 - 中国
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在震摄人心的 16 世纪中华大地上，亲历刺客少芸与中国皇帝的恩怨情仇并搭配新颖的 2.5D 潜行游戏玩法：
• 你所操作的刺客拥有独特的战斗技巧，拥有靴刀和绳镖等神秘装备。
• 探索少芸的故事，了解中国兄弟会的最后一位刺客的传奇。
• 穿行于伟大的帝国版图，潜入美丽的中国传统建筑。

games.title: Assassin’s Creed Chronicles: India
games.shortDescription:
Embody Arbaaz in his quest for retribution through a colourful depiction of Colonial India in 2.5D stealth gameplay. 

• Travel across an amazing 19th Century India and its legendary landmarks. 
• Experience the thrill of a stealthy assassin with a unique set of skills and weapons such as the double kill moves and the chakram.
• Discover a brand new mode with stealth, speed and assassination rooms
games.titleZh: 刺客教条：编年史 - 印度
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在这个描绘 19 世纪殖民印度的 2.5D 匿踪游戏中，追随「阿尔巴兹」（Arbaaz）踏上复仇之旅。

• 游历 19 世纪精彩的印度及当地著名地标。
• 用双重击杀招式和环刃（Chakram）等独特技巧与武器，体验刺客隐匿刺杀的快感。
• 在匿踪、速度和暗杀三个独特的挑战之室里挑战崭新模式。

games.title: Assassin's Creed Freedom Cry - Standalone
games.shortDescription: Play as Adewale, an ex-slave turned Assassin fighting for freedom with the help of his own Pirate crew.
games.titleZh: 刺客信条：自由呐喊——独立游戏
games.shortDescriptionZh: 成为阿德瓦勒——原是一名奴隶而后成为刺客，在他的海盗船员帮助下为自由而战。

games.title: Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag
games.shortDescription: Discover Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag, the classic pirate action-adventure game from 2013. Command your ship, hunt Templars, and carve your legend as Edward Kenway across the Caribbean's Golden Age of Piracy.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 探索《刺客信条4：黑旗》，这是一款来自 2013 年的经典海盗题材动作冒险游戏。你可以指挥自己的战舰，猎杀圣殿骑士，在加勒比海的海盗黄金时代中，以爱德华·肯威的身份铸就自己的传奇。

games.title: Assassin’s Creed IV Black Flag - Gold Edition
games.shortDescription: It is 1715. Pirates rule the Caribbean, terrorizing navies & humiliating empires. From sinking warships to conquering fortresses, Captain Edward Kenway stopped at nothing to earn his fortune & legend. Yet, the adventures of his first mate have never been revealed. Until now. Get the game & the Season Pass now for the chance to play as Edward’s first mate, who will take you even deeper into the real explosive events of the Golden Age of Pirates.
games.titleZh: 刺客信条IV：黑旗- 黄金版
games.shortDescriptionZh: 时间是 1715 年。海盗统治着加勒比海地区，肆意恐吓海军和羞辱帝国。从击沉战舰到征服要塞，爱德华·肯威船长不惜一切代价巧取豪夺，成为了一代传奇。然而时至今日，他大副的冒险历程却从未公之于众。立即获取游戏本体和季票，就有机会扮演爱德华的大副，他将带你更深入地了解海盗黄金时代真正震撼人心的事件。

games.title: Assassin's Creed Odyssey
games.shortDescription: In this action-adventure game, set sail for Ancient Greece to alter its fate. Fight in visceral battles on land and sea, shape your destiny from outcast to legend, and uncover secrets of your past.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款动作冒险游戏中，扬帆驶向古希腊，改变这个国度的命运。陆海激战，从流浪者蜕变成传奇人物，找出自己过往的秘密。

games.title: Assassin's Creed Origins
games.shortDescription: Explore Ancient Egypt in this action-adventure game. Battle powerful enemies, unveil conspiracies, and discover the origin story of the Assassin’s Brotherhood.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款动作冒险游戏中，尽情探索古埃及。挑战强敌、揭穿阴谋，探索刺客兄弟会的起源故事。

games.title: Assassin's Creed Origins
games.shortDescription: Ancient Egypt, a land of majesty and intrigue, is disappearing in a ruthless fight for power.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 王权和阴谋统治下的古埃及时代正慢慢消失在争权夺位的冷酷之战中。重返刺客兄弟会起源的最初时刻，揭开不为人知的秘密和被遗忘的神秘事件。

games.title: Assassin's Creed Revelations
games.shortDescription: Ezio Auditore walks in the footsteps of the legendary mentor Altair, on a dangerous journey of discovery and revelation.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 艾吉奥·奥迪托雷沿循着传奇导师阿泰尔的脚步，踏上了一段危险的旅途，并在这一过程中揭开秘密、寻得启示。

games.title: Assassin's Creed Rogue
games.shortDescription:
Introducing Assassin’s Creed Rogue, the darkest chapter in the Assassin’s Creed franchise yet. 
As Shay, you will experience the slow transformation from Assassin to Assassin Hunter.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
隆重推出《刺客信条》系列最黑暗的篇章：《刺客信条：叛变》。 
身为“谢伊”，你将体验从刺客身份慢慢地转变为刺客猎人的过程。

games.title: Assassin's Creed Syndicate
games.shortDescription: London, 1868. Lead your underworld organization in the midst of the Industrial Revolution to break the corrupt stranglehold on the city in a visceral adventure filled with action, intrigue, and brutal combat.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 伦敦，1868 年。在工业革命的时代统领黑道组织，不断扩张影响力，在充满暴力、阴谋和战斗的惊心动魄冒险中，打破束缚伦敦的腐败与黑暗。

games.title: Assassin’s Creed Syndicate
games.shortDescription: London, 1868. Lead your underworld organization in the midst of the Industrial Revolution to break the corrupt stranglehold on the city in a visceral adventure filled with action, intrigue, and brutal combat.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 伦敦，1868 年。在工业革命的时代统领黑道组织，不断扩张影响力，在充满暴力、阴谋和战斗的惊心动魄冒险中，打破束缚伦敦的腐败与黑暗。

games.title: Assassin's Creed Unity
games.shortDescription: Paris, 1789. In this action-adventure game, experience the French Revolution through the eyes of Arno Dorian. Become an Assassin and expose the true powers behind the Revolution for the fate of a nation. Rediscover this classic, now in 60 FPS!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 巴黎，1789 年。在这款动作冒险游戏中，以亚诺·多里安的视角，亲历法国大革命的风云。化身刺客，为拯救祖国，揭穿革命幕后黑手的面纱。重温经典之作，感受 60 FPS 带来的别样体验！

games.title: Assassin's Creed Unity
games.shortDescription: Paris, 1789. In this action-adventure game, experience the French Revolution through the eyes of Arno Dorian. Become an Assassin and expose the true powers behind the Revolution for the fate of a nation.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 巴黎，1789 年。在这款动作冒险游戏中，以阿尔诺·多里安的视角，亲历法国大革命的风云。化身刺客，为拯救祖国，揭穿革命幕后黑手的面纱。

games.title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla
games.shortDescription: Play as a Viking warrior in this action-adventure game set in England’s Dark Ages. Explore a dynamic open world, raid your enemies, and grow your settlement to earn your place among the gods in Valhalla...
games.shortDescriptionZh:
本遊戲運用 Smart Delivery 技術，讓玩家能夠遊玩 Xbox One 版本與 Xbox Series X|S 版本

於 Xbox Series X 的 4K 解析度，60 FPS 的環境下，打造屬於你的維京傳奇。

在《刺客教條：維京紀元》化身追求榮耀的傳奇維京劫掠者「埃沃爾」。探索在英格蘭黑暗時代殘酷背景下，動盪卻又美麗動人的開放世界。劫掠敵人、發展聚落、培養政治權力，在英靈殿的諸神之間爭取一席之地。

games.title: Assassin's Creed® Chronicles: China
games.shortDescription:
Exact Shao Jun’s vengeance on the Chinese Emperor in stunning 16th century China with fresh 2.5D stealth gameplay:

• Embody a stealthy Assassin with unique combat skills and gear like the Shoe Blade and the Rope Dart
• Discover the story of Shao Jun, the last remaining Assassin of the Chinese Brotherhood
• Dive into a beautiful Chinese setting by travelling across the great empire of China
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在震摄人心的 16 世纪中华大地上，亲历刺客少芸与中国皇帝的恩怨情仇并搭配新颖的 2.5D 潜行游戏玩法：
• 你所操作的刺客拥有独特的战斗技巧，拥有靴刀和绳镖等神秘装备。
• 探索少芸的故事，了解中国兄弟会的最后一位刺客的传奇。
• 穿行于伟大的帝国版图，潜入美丽的中国传统建筑。

games.title: Assassin's Creed® Chronicles: India
games.shortDescription:
Embody Arbaaz in his quest for retribution through a colourful depiction of Colonial India in 2.5D stealth gameplay. 

• Travel across an amazing 19th Century India and its legendary landmarks. 
• Experience the thrill of a stealthy assassin with a unique set of skills and weapons such as the double kill moves and the chakram.
• Discover a brand new mode with stealth, speed and assassination rooms
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在這個描繪 19 世紀殖民印度的 2.5D 匿蹤遊戲中，追隨「阿爾巴茲」（Arbaaz）踏上復仇之旅。

• 遊歷 19 世紀精彩的印度及當地著名地標。
• 用雙重擊殺招式和環刃（Chakram）等獨特技巧與武器，體驗刺客隱匿刺殺的快感。
• 在匿蹤、速度和暗殺三個獨特的挑戰之室裡挑戰嶄新模式。

games.title: Assassin's Creed® Chronicles: Russia
games.shortDescription: Experience the thrill of being a master Assassin in 2.5D. Sneak and hide to avoid detection and fool enemies using whistles and disguises.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 暢遊 19 世紀俄國的 2.5D 隱蔽類遊戲。

games.title: Assassin's Creed® III Remastered
games.shortDescription:
Assassin's Creed® III Remastered is included for free in Assassin's Creed® Odyssey Season Pass.
Relive the American Revolution or experience it for the first time in Assassin's Creed® III Remastered, with enhanced graphics and improved gameplay mechanics.  Also includes Assassin's Creed Liberation remastered and all solo DLC content.
games.titleZh: 刺客教条 III 重制版
games.shortDescriptionZh:
购买《Assassin's Creed® Odyssey》Season Pass 即可免费享受内含的《Assassin's Creed® III Remastered》经典版.
畫面更棒、遊戲機制更精進的《刺客教條 III 重製版》將帶玩家重新回味或初次體驗美國大革命的年代。更棒的是，另也包含《刺客教條：自由使命 重製版》和所有單人 DLC 內容。

games.title: Assassin's Creed® III Remastered
games.shortDescription: Relive the American Revolution or experience it for the first time in Assassin's Creed® III Remastered!  Also includes Assassin's Creed Liberation remastered and all solo DLC content.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《刺客信条III》高清重制版的增强画面与改进的游戏机制中再次体验美国独立战争。此外，该版本亦包含《刺客信条：解放》高清重制版和所有独立DLC内容。

games.title: Assassin’s Creed® Mirage
games.shortDescription:
Become a deadly Master Assassin in this action-adventure game. Explore the streets of ninth-century Baghdad through the eyes of Basim. Take down your targets while seeking justice as part of the Hidden Ones.

Includes Valley of Memory, a free major update with new story content and 6 hours of gameplay.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在这款动作冒险游戏中，化身致命的刺客大师。以巴辛姆的视角，探索九世纪巴格达的街头巷尾。加入无形者伸张正义，追猎你的目标。

包括免费大型更新“回忆山谷”，带来新的剧情内容与 6 小时的游玩体验。

games.title: Assassin’s Creed® Mirage
games.shortDescription: Become a deadly Master Assassin in this action-adventure game and explore the streets of ninth-century Baghdad through the eyes of Basim. Take down your targets while seeking justice as part of the Hidden Ones.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款动作冒险游戏中化身致命的刺客大师，以巴辛姆的视角，探索九世纪巴格达的街头巷尾。加入无形者伸张正义，追猎你的目标。

games.title: Assassin's Creed® Odyssey
games.shortDescription: Write your own epic odyssey and become a legendary Spartan hero. Forge your destiny in a world on the brink of tearing itself apart. Influence how history unfolds in an ever-changing world shaped by your choices.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在《Assassin's Creed® Odyssey》當中主宰自己的命運。
從一名流浪者蛻變成傳奇人物，踏上這趟奧德賽之旅，找出你過往的祕密並改變古希臘的命運。

games.title: Assassin’s Creed® Rogue Remastered
games.shortDescription: Play the darkest chapter in Assassin’s Creed lore, remastered for next-gen platforms. Witness the cataclysmic events that force a young Assassin to become the most feared Assassin hunter in history. Assassin’s Creed Rogue has also been remastered for Xbox One X (featuring native 4K) and Xbox One (featuring 1080p). Bonus content includes two missions, weapon packs, unique outfits, and more.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 針對次世代平台推出的重製版能讓玩家體驗 Assassin's Creed® 系列作中最黑暗的篇章。扮演英法北美戰爭時期的刺客謝伊，經歷迫使他背叛兄弟會的災難性事件。

games.title: Assassin's Creed® The Ezio Collection
games.developer: Ubisoft Montreal. HD enhancement by VIRTUOS.
games.shortDescription:
Make history as the legendary Master Assassin, Ezio Auditore da Firenze, in this compelling collection including Assassin’s Creed 2, Assassin’s Creed Brotherhood and Assassin’s Creed Revelations acclaimed single-player campaigns plus all DLCs, with enhanced graphics. Also enjoy two short movies, Assassin’s Creed Lineage® and Assassin’s Creed Embers™  for the complete Ezio experience.
Does not include multiplayer content.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
一次擁有《Assassin's Creed 2》、《Assassin's Creed Brotherhood》和《Assassin's Creed Revelations》的完全版合輯現正降臨，以提升的畫質效果享受廣受好評的單人故事劇情及完整追加內容，扮演傳奇刺客大師埃齊歐．奧迪托雷（Ezio Auditore da Firenze）締造偉大歷史。另外並透過額外收錄的【Embers】和【Lineage】兩部完整短片，帶來最完整的埃齊奧系列體驗。
不包含多人連線模式內容

games.title: Assassin's Creed® Valhalla
games.shortDescription: Become a legendary Viking on a quest for glory. Raid your enemies, grow your settlement, and build your political power.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 化身追求榮耀的傳奇維京英雄。劫掠敵人、發展聚落、培養政治權力。

games.title: ASTRONEER
games.shortDescription: Explore and reshape distant worlds! Astroneer is set during the 25th century Intergalactic Age of Discovery, where Astroneers explore the frontiers of outer space, risking their lives in harsh environments to unearth rare discoveries and unlock the mysteries of the universe.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
此游戏是在制品。 可能会随时间更改，亦可能会作为最终产品发布。 请仅在您熟悉此未完成游戏的当前状态下购买。

探索并重塑遥远世界！《ASTRONEER》的舞台设定在淘金热潮兴起的 25 世纪。玩家必须探索外太空边境，冒着生命危险在艰难环境下勘探资源，寻找一夜暴富的机会。

games.title: Atomfall
games.shortDescription: A nuclear disaster has left an area of Britain in tatters. Atomfall, a new survival-action game, will see you explore, scavenge, craft, barter and fight your way through beautifully recreated scenery in search of answers.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 一场核灾难将英国的一部分地区夷为平地。《Atomfall》，一款全新的生存动作游戏，将会见证你在精美重建的景观中施展自己的探索、拾荒、制作、交易和战斗本领，并一路追寻答案。

games.title: Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora
games.shortDescription: In Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora™, you’ll embark on a journey across the open world of the never-before-seen Western Frontier. Reconnect with your lost heritage and discover what it means to become Na’vi as you join other clans to protect Pandora from the formidable forces of the RDA.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《阿凡达：潘多拉边境》中，你将踏上穿越西部边境的旅程，领略潘多拉从未示人的一面。找回你失去的传承，从中发现身为纳威人的意义，然后联合其他部族，抵抗来势汹汹的 RDA，为守护潘多拉而战。

games.title: Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora™
games.shortDescription: Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora™ is a third and first-person action-adventure game set in the never-before-seen Western Frontier of Pandora. Reconnect with your lost heritage and discover what it means to become Na’vi as you join other clans to protect Pandora from the formidable forces of the RDA.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《阿凡达：潘多拉边境™》是一款第一\第三人称动作冒险游戏，背景设在从未展现在世人面前的潘多拉星西部边境。找回你失去的传承，从中发现身为纳威人的意义，然后联合其他部族，抵抗来势汹汹的 RDA，为守护潘多拉而战。

games.title: Avowed Standard Edition
games.shortDescription: Avowed is a first-person fantasy RPG from Obsidian Entertainment.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《宣誓》是黑曜石娱乐推出的一款第一人称奇幻角色扮演游戏。

games.title: Balatro
games.shortDescription:
Balatro is a poker-inspired roguelike deck builder all about creating powerful synergies and winning big.

The poker roguelike. Balatro is a hypnotically satisfying deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping, outrageous combos.

Combine valid poker hands with unique Joker cards in order to create varied synergies and builds. Ea
games.shortDescriptionZh:
Balatro是一款以扑克为灵感的魔幻建牌游戏，你将全情投入于打造强大的增效并取得巨大胜利。
Balatro是一场循环不息的扑克之旅。在这款令人陶醉的策略构建游戏中，你将参与到非法牌局，发掘能够改变局势的小丑牌，引爆一系列令人血脉喷张、疯狂迸发的连锁效应。
将有效的扑克手牌与独特的小丑牌相结合，打造不同的增效和策略。赢得足够的筹码，打破盲注的奸计，同时在游戏过程中揭示隐藏的奖励牌手和牌组。为了到达终极盲注、击败最终赌注并稳操胜券，你需要尽一切可能获取优势。

games.title: Baldur's Gate and Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Editions
games.shortDescription:
Gather your party: the RPG saga returns. Immerse yourself in an epic RPG series where every choice matters. Play over 100 hours of adventure in enhanced editions of Baldur’s Gate and Baldur’s Gate II— plus the full Siege of Dragonspear expansion!

- CONTENT -

BALDUR’S GATE: ENHANCED EDITION
Baldur’s Gate: Enhanced Edition brings you the classic RPG with fresh updates for modern adventurers.

games.title: BALL x PIT
games.shortDescription: BALL x PIT is a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite. Batter hordes of enemies with ricocheting balls and gather the riches of the pit to expand your homestead, generate resources and recruit unique heroes.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《BALL x PIT》这款生存类roguelite游戏中击碎砖石、融合圆球并搭建基地。使用弹性十足的圆球对抗源源不断的敌人，想方设法搜刮深坑中的宝藏以扩建家园、生产资源并招募独特英雄。

games.title: Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden
games.shortDescription: Hunt ghosts as two memorable characters in a story driven Action-RPG where your decisions have dramatic consequences. Solve haunting cases and battle supernatural forces combining Antea’s spiritual powers and Red’s arsenal.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款以故事为驱动的动作角色扮演游戏中，你将扮演两个让人印象深刻的角色去追猎幽灵，你的每个选择都会产生深远的影响；将安提雅的灵魂能力和雷德的武器技能结合起来，解决闹鬼事件并对抗超自然力量。

games.title: Banjo Kazooie: N n B
games.shortDescription: The heroic bear and bird return at last to defend Spiral Mountain from their nemesis Gruntilda. Groundbreaking vehicular platforming awaits in wild new worlds packed with features and faces old and new. Build awe-inspiring vehicles and tackle the Jiggy challenges in any way you see fit!
games.shortDescriptionZh: The heroic bear and bird return at last to defend Spiral Mountain from their nemesis Gruntilda. Groundbreaking vehicular platforming awaits in wild new worlds packed with features and faces old and new. Build awe-inspiring vehicles and tackle the Jiggy challenges in any way you see fit!

games.title: Banjo-Kazooie
games.shortDescription: (Online Interactions Not Rated by the ESRB) Since 1998 you’ve been waiting for this moment. Your chance again to stop Gruntilda the mightily ugly witch from turning Banjo's cute sister, Tooty, into a monster. This is Banjo-Kazooie, the first adventure. Now lovingly enhanced and packed full of its original platforming goodness. All the worlds, all the Jiggies and even the legendary Stop N Swop gameplay if you own Banjo-Kazooie: Nuts and Bolts. Marvelous.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 從 1998 年開始你就在期待這一刻的到來。現在你又有機會阻止醜陋的巫婆 Grunty，不讓她將 Banjo 的妹妹 Tooty 變成怪物。這就是 Banjo-Kazooie，阿邦和阿卡的第一次歡樂冒險。現在你不僅能夠完整體驗，更能享受升級的遊戲樂趣。全部的遊戲世界和拼圖都在這裡，如果你有「阿邦阿卡大冒險：改造大作戰」，還能啟動備受期待的新功能「Stop N Swop」。太棒了！

games.title: Banjo-Tooie
games.shortDescription: The bear and bird’s second outing available in full. Loads of rollicking fun to be had here and with the legendary Stop 'N' Swap feature reinstated. The best use of a backpack in a game ever!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 大熊和大鳥的第二次大冒險，快來下載完整版遊戲！現在就來享受歡樂滿載的經典遊戲，還有傳說中的 Stop'N'Swop 遊戲內容等著你。阿邦的背包在遊戲中將發揮絕佳妙用！

games.title: Barbie™ Horse Trails
games.shortDescription: There’s plenty to unlock and discover in Canterbury Trails Park. Ride along as Barbie™, and Barbie with your horse, Lucky on this wild adventure.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 坎特伯雷步道公园里可以解锁和发现的内容多得很。快来扮演两Barbie™，与马儿吉祥一起踏上这场狂野冒险吧。

games.title: Batman™: Arkham Knight
games.shortDescription: In Batman: Arkham Knight, the explosive finale to the Arkham series, Batman faces the ultimate threat against the city he is sworn to protect.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在阿卡漢爆炸性的最後章節，蝙蝠俠：阿卡漢騎士中，蝙蝠俠俠發誓要保護的城市將要面臨終極威脅。

games.title: Battlefield 3™
games.shortDescription: In Battlefield 3, players will step into the role of the elite U.S. Marines. They will experience heart-pounding single player missions and competitie multiplayer action ranging across diverse locations from around the globe. Powered by the innovative technology of Frostbite 2, Battlefield 3 takes First Person Shooters to a whole new level.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《戰地風雲3》裡，玩家將扮演精銳美軍陸戰隊員。玩家可造訪世界各地，體驗驚心動魄的單人任務以及競爭激烈的多人戰爭。在Frostbite 2創新技術的加持下，《戰地風雲3》將令第一人稱射擊遊戲邁入嶄新境界。

games.title: Battlefield 4
games.shortDescription: Battlefield 4™ is the genre-defining action blockbuster made from moments that blur the line between game and glory - moments found only in Battlefield. With dynamic destructible environments, epic vehicular combat, and the chaos of all-out war, Battlefield 4 gives you the freedom to do more and be more for an unrivaled entertainment experience.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Battlefield 4™ is the genre-defining action blockbuster made from moments that blur the line between game and glory - moments found only in Battlefield. With dynamic destructible environments, epic vehicular combat, and the chaos of all-out war, Battlefield 4 gives you the freedom to do more and be more for an unrivaled entertainment experience.

games.title: Battlefield™ 1 Revolution
games.shortDescription: Join the strong Battlefield community and experience the dawn of all-out war with epic team-based multiplayer battles or through the campaign with compelling War Stories. Battlefield 1 Revolution is the complete package containing both Battlefield 1 base game and Battlefield 1 Premium Pass with four expansion packs.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 加入团结强大的 Battlefield 社区，在史诗规模的团队多人战斗中或通过战争故事构成的战役中体验全面战争的黎明。Battlefield™ 1 Revolution 完整版包含《Battlefield 1》主游戏和包含 4 个扩展包的《Battlefield 1》高级通行证。

games.title: Battlefield™ 2042 Xbox One
games.shortDescription: Battlefield™ 2042 is a first-person shooter that marks the return to the iconic all-out warfare of the franchise.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《战地风云™ 2042》是一款第一人称射击游戏，本作将带领玩家重返该系列标志性的全面战争。

games.title: Battlefield™ 2042 Xbox Series X|S
games.shortDescription: Battlefield™ 2042 is a first-person shooter that marks the return to the iconic all-out warfare of the franchise.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《战地风云™ 2042》是一款第一人称射击游戏，本作将带领玩家重返该系列标志性的全面战争。

games.title: Battlefield™ Hardline
games.shortDescription: Be the law or Break the law  in Battlefield™ Hardline. This action-packed blockbuster combines the intense signature multiplayer moments of Battlefield with an emotionally charged story and setting reminiscent of a modern television crime drama.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在战地风云™：Hardline中化身执法者或犯法者。这款充满动作元素的游戏大作将战地风云多人模式中标志性的紧张时刻与扣人心弦的故事情节和场景相结合，俨然是一部现代风格的犯罪大片。

games.title: Battlefield™ V
games.shortDescription: Enter mankind’s greatest conflict with Battlefield™ V as the series goes back to its roots in a never-before-seen portrayal of World War 2. Take on all-out multiplayer across the world, single player War Stories, and Firestorm – Battle Royale, reimagined for Battlefield.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《战地风云 5》将以前所未见的手法在第二次世界大战中呈现该系列的起源，让你体验人类历史上规模最大的冲突。投身席卷世界的多人模式全面战争、单人模式战争故事，以及为《战地风云》重新定义的大逃杀 – 火线风暴。

games.title: BATTLETECH
games.shortDescription: The year is 3025 and the galaxy is trapped in a cycle of perpetual war, fought by noble houses with enormous, mechanized combat vehicles called BattleMechs. Take command of your own mercenary outfit of `Mechs and the MechWarriors that pilot them, struggling to stay afloat as you find yourself drawn into a brutal interstellar civil war.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 公元 3025 年，各个贵族世家操控巨大的机械化战斗载具互相争斗，使银河系陷入了无休止的战争轮回，这些载具被称为“战斗机甲”。指挥属于您的佣兵机甲装束和操控它们的机甲战士，在这场残酷的星际内战中努力求存。

games.title: Battletoads
games.shortDescription:
The wait is over! Rash, Zitz and Pimple are returning at last to smash-hit their way through an all-new action-packed adventure of choreographed chaos, and couch co-op may never be the same again. 

1-3 players will take control of the Battletoads and team up to storm through wild and unpredictable stages with only one rule – expect the unexpected. Teamwork makes the dream work in a drop-in, drop-out gameplay blast, filled with over-the-top gameplay moments that anyone can enjoy, but only a True ‘Toad’ can master.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
漫长的等待结束了！拉什、赛斯和宾波终于重磅回归，并将开启充满精心设计的混乱场面却激动人心的全新冒险，随时随地可以开始的合作模式也揭开了前所未有的游戏形式！

1 到 3 名玩家将操控忍者蛙，气势汹汹地组队横扫狂野而无法预知的关卡，而贯穿其中的游戏规则只有一个：意外发生的才是意料之中的。团队合作让玩家可以随开随玩，热闹非凡，充满了无数令人无限回味、众人皆宜的游戏瞬间，而这些都尽在真正的“忍者蛙“的掌控之中。

games.title: Beast of Reincarnation
games.shortDescription:
Game Freak's brand-new title: Beast of Reincarnation is an action RPG with a fusion of real-time and turn-based combat. Experience the innovative "one-person, one-dog action RPG" in the beautiful yet harsh world of Beast of Reincarnation. 

What awaits at the end of Emma and Koo's journey?
games.shortDescriptionZh:
Game Freak 诚意新作：《轮回之兽》是一款融合了即时与回合制战斗的动作角色扮演游戏。在美丽而又严酷的《轮回之兽》世界中，享受创新的“一人一狗协作动作角色扮演”体验。

在艾玛和小库的旅程终点会有什么在等待着他们呢？

games.title: Beastro
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Beastro! In this charming fusion of fantasy adventure, not all heroes wield swords… Some prefer the spoon. And, sometimes to save the world you’ve got to start with a really good meal.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 欢迎光临《Beastro》！在这趟奇幻与冒险交织的旅途之中，并不是所有主人公都是手持刀剑……有些手上更爱拿着汤勺。而且，有时候要想拯救世界，需要先美餐一顿。

games.title: Beatdown City Survivors
games.shortDescription: Eradicate hordes of monsters in this survivors style roguelite set in a rotting, destructible city that hates you. Start fires, blow stuff up, electrify water, you name it. Upgrade & craft an arsenal of oddball weapons including pigeons riding boots. Unlock & upgrade offbeat characters & SURVIVE!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款生存类roguelite游戏中，你将置身于一座腐朽且充满敌意的城市，消灭成群的怪物。纵火、炸毁、给水通电，你能想到的都可以做到。升级并打造各种奇葩武器，包括鸽子骑靴。解锁并升级另类角色，努力生存下去！

games.title: Bejeweled 2
games.shortDescription: Rediscover the puzzle phenomenon that conquered the ‘Net--right here on your Xbox 360 console. Set against a backdrop of striking planetary vistas, this sequel offers more than just colorful jewel swapping… Match four of a kind to earn an explosive Power

Enjoy the amazing sights and sounds and engage in endless gem-matching fun, and earn flashy achievement badges as you soar to dazzling new heights!

Enjoy the amazing sights and sounds and engage in endless gem-matching fun, and earn flashy achievement badges as you soar to dazzling new heights!

games.title: Ben 10: Power Trip
games.shortDescription: Evil Hex has cursed Europe – and only Ben 10 can stop him! Explore a 3D world filled with combat, puzzles and secrets as you save the day!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 邪恶的骇尸诅咒了欧洲 - 只有少年骇客能制止他！在你奋力拯救世界的冒险历程中，探索这个充满了战斗、谜题和秘密的 3D 世界！

games.title: Black Jacket
games.shortDescription: The Blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deck builder where you gamble your way out of hell. Stack broken cards, bend the rules, and unleash insane combos. Read your enemy, bribe the ferryman, and escape the afterlife.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 以二十一点为灵魂的 roguelite 牌组构建游戏：在地狱牌桌上豪赌求生。堆叠破规则卡牌、扭曲点数、连击爆发；读懂敌人，攒金币贿赂摆渡人，逃离冥界。

The BLACK™ tactical squad operates under the cloak of complete anonymity and deniability to protect the U.S. from …
games.shortDescriptionZh: Join the world’s most brutal and enigmatic strike force. The BLACK™ tactical squad operates under the cloak of complete anonymity and deniability to protect the U.S. from threats foreign and domestic. It answers to no one, allowing it to carry out covert operations around the globe.

games.title: BlazBlue Entropy Effect X
games.shortDescription: A *roguelite action game* set in the BLAZBLUE universe, featuring striking 2D visuals, stylish, fast-paced combat, and precise, responsive controls.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
本作为《BLAZBLUE》系列衍生的 Roguelite 动作游戏，拥有精美的 2D 画面、多样化的动作表现，以及注重用户体验的出色操控手感。
操控来自《BLAZBLUE》系列和其他世界共 16 位个性鲜明的角色，尽享酣畅淋漓的巅峰动作体验。

games.title: Bleeding Edge
games.shortDescription: Team Up. Cause Chaos. Grab your team and tear it up in Bleeding Edge, an electrifying online brawler where every fighter comes mechanically enhanced for mayhem!
games.shortDescriptionZh: Team Up. Cause Chaos. Grab your team and tear it up in Bleeding Edge, an electrifying online brawler where every fighter comes mechanically enhanced for mayhem!

games.title: BLiNX: The Time Sweeper
games.shortDescription: Blinx: The Time Sweeper is a fast-paced action game featuring a cool, clever new character in wild, warped worlds. The ability to control the flow of time provides a totally new 4-dimensional gaming experience only possible on Xbox.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Blinx: The Time Sweeper is a fast-paced action game featuring a cool, clever new character in wild, warped worlds. The ability to control the flow of time provides a totally new 4-dimensional gaming experience only possible on Xbox.

games.title: Blizzard® Arcade Collection
games.shortDescription: Relax and rewind with the Blizzard® Arcade Collection, featuring faithful reproductions of Blackthorne®, The Lost Vikings®, Rock N Roll Racing®, Lost Vikings® 2 and RPM Racing™ for modern platforms!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在现代平台重温Blizzard® Arcade Collection，享受《黑色荆棘》、《失落的维京人》、《摇滚赛车》、《失落的维京人2》和《RPM赛车》的忠实再现！

games.shortDescription: Relax and rewind with the Blizzard® Arcade Collection, featuring faithful reproductions of Blackthorne®, The Lost Vikings®, Rock N Roll Racing®, Lost Vikings® 2 and RPM Racing™ for modern platforms!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在现代平台重温Blizzard® Arcade Collection，享受《黑色荆棘》、《失落的维京人》、《摇滚赛车》、《失落的维京人2》和《RPM赛车》的忠实再现！

games.title: Blood Dungeon
games.shortDescription: From the creators of Nidhogg, murder hordes of monsters in this 2D platforming autoshooter with a killer soundtrack. Collect Blood, gold, and bones to increase your powers. Can you survive the Blood Dungeon?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Nidhogg》原班人马暗黑巨献，配乐炸裂的全新 2D 平台自动射击力作！尽情掠夺鲜血、白骨、金币，用不断变强的实力爆杀成群妖魔！你，能活着走出这座鲜血地牢吗？

games.title: Blue Prince
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Mt. Holly, where every dawn unveils a new mystery. Navigate through shifting corridors and ever-changing chambers in this genre-defying strategy puzzle adventure. But will your unpredictable path lead you to the rumored Room 46?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 欢迎来到霍利山庄，每逢破晓时分，此处便有奥秘浮出水面。穿梭于变幻莫测的走廊与房间，体验独树一帜的策略解密冒险之旅。一路摸索，能否抵达传言中的46号房？

games.title: Bluey: The Videogame
games.developer: Artax Games and Casual Brothers Ltd.
games.shortDescription: Play a brand-new story set across 4 interactive adventures, explore iconic locations, play your favourite games from the TV show and also play with your friends and family in local multiplayer.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在4个互动冒险中体验全新的故事，探索标志性的地点，玩电视剧里你最喜欢的游戏，也可以在本地多人游戏中与你的朋友和家人一起游戏。

games.title: Bounty Star
games.shortDescription: Bounty Star is a third-person mech brawler about a bounty hunter in a desert world.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Bounty Star 是一款采用越肩视角的第三人称动作游戏，结合了机甲战斗以及可自由定制的轻度耕作和基地建设玩法。玩家将扮演一位名叫 Clem 的退伍军人，她一身伤痕累累，但战斗力仍然强大，她是天才的格斗家和专家级的机甲师。

games.title: Brawlhalla
games.shortDescription: An epic platform fighter for up to 8 players online or locally. Try casual free-for-alls, ranked matches, or invite friends to a private room. And it's free! Play cross-platform with millions of players on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android and Steam! Frequent updates. Over fifty Legends.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Brawlhalla》是一款經典免費遊玩的格鬥遊戲。立即加入這款免費休閒遊戲，內容包含排名賽及與朋友自訂房間一同遊玩的模式。超過百萬玩家、不斷持續更新、超過 40 位獨特傳奇角色。為「Halls of Valhalla」的榮耀而戰！

games.title: Crysis
games.shortDescription: What begins as a simple rescue mission becomes the battleground of a new war as alien invaders swarm over a North Korean island chain. Armed with a powerful Nanosuit, become invisible to stalk enemy patrols, or boost your strength to lay waste to vehicles. An advanced AI controls your enemies, so play smart. One wrong move out here could be your last.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 外星入侵者大举侵入朝鲜列岛，使得原本简单的救援任务演变成一场新的战斗。 装备强大的纳米装甲，悄无声息地跟踪敌方巡逻队，或是释放强大力量摧毁车辆。 敌人由先进的 AI 控制，你需要以智取胜。 一招失误，便可能满盘皆输。

games.title: Crysis 2
games.shortDescription: The world has been ravaged by a series of climatic disasters and society is on the verge of breakdown. Now the aliens have returned with an invasion force bent on nothing less than the total annihilation of mankind. One supersoldier wielding the Nanosuit 2, will make the last stand to save humanity.  Note:  Crysis 2 Multiplayer has been shut-down.  See https://www.ea.com/service-updates/2018.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 世界饱受各种气候灾难的蹂躏，社会濒临土崩瓦解的边缘。 外星人再次入侵地球，不彻底清除人类绝不罢休。 一名掌握纳米装甲 2 科技的超级战士将为拯救人类做出最后一搏。  注意：《Crysis 2》多人模式已关闭。  请参阅 https://www.ea.com/service-updates/2018。

games.title: Crysis® 3
games.shortDescription: The fate of the world is in your hands. New and old enemies threaten the peace you worked so hard to achieve 24 years ago. It won't be easy, but your Nanosuit helps you clear a path to victory. Craft a stealthy attack to defeat your opponents quietly, or decimate the enemy with a blaze of brute force. There's no wrong way to save the world.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 世界的命运掌握在你手中。 你 24 年前付出巨大努力才得以实现的和平正在遭受新老敌人的威胁。 这并不容易，但纳米装甲可以帮助你走向胜利。 进行隐秘进攻，消无声息地击败对手，或是火力全开杀戮敌人。 只要能拯救世界，方式无对错之分。

games.title: Dante's Inferno™
games.shortDescription: Based on the immensely influential classic poem, Dante’s Inferno takes you on an epic quest of vengeance and redemption through the Nine Circles of Hell.   You are Dante, a veteran of the Crusades who must chase his beloved Beatrice and try to free her soul from Lucifer’s grasp. As your pursuit takes you deeper into the pits of Hell, you must battle ever more fierce and hideous monsters—while also facing your own sins, a dark family past, and your unforgivable war crimes.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Dante’s Inferno》受到经典诗歌的影响，将带您前往地狱的九界踏上一段复仇和救赎的史诗之旅。   您将扮演十字军老兵 Dante，追寻心爱的 Beatrice，并尝试从 Lucifer 的魔爪中解救她的灵魂。 您的一路追寻将带您进入地狱的深渊，您必须与更凶残可怕的怪兽战斗——同时也将面对内心的罪恶，黑暗的家族历史以及无法被原谅的战争罪行。

games.title: Date Everything!
games.shortDescription:
Find the object of your affection

Date Everything! is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?
games.shortDescriptionZh:
找到心仪的对象

《Date Everything!》是一款沙盒约会模拟器，把你的家变成游戏的舞台，并在此邂逅 100 名全语音的可约会角色吧！让浪漫流连于床笫、烟雾报警器和……压倒性的生存恐惧之间？你准备好应约尽约了吗？

games.shortDescription: A mind-bending, time travel, cartoon puzzle adventure game in which three unlikely friends work together to prevent an evil mutated purple tentacle from taking over the world!

games.title: DayZ
games.shortDescription: The post-soviet country of Chernarus is struck by an unknown virus, turning the majority population into frenzied infected. Fighting over resources has bred a hostile mentality among survivors, driving what’s left of humanity to collapse. You are one of the few immune to the virus - how far will you go to survive?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 后苏联国家黑俄罗斯突遭某种未知病毒的袭击，导致绝大多数人口变成了狂暴的感染者。为了争夺资源，敌对情绪在幸存者之间蔓延，使得残存的人类秩序逐渐崩塌。作为为数不多的病毒免疫者之一 —— 你在这趟生存之旅中能走多远？

games.title: Dead by Daylight
games.shortDescription: Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits. Pick a side and step into a world of tension and terror with horror gaming's best asymmetrical multiplayer.

games.title: Dead Island 2
games.shortDescription:
The much-loved zombie saga is back! Dead Island 2 is a thrilling First-Person Action RPG with a unique formula of horror, dark humor and over the top zombie-slaying. 

A deadly virus is spreading across Los Angeles, turning its inhabitants into zombies. Bitten, infected, but more than just immune, as you uncover the truth behind the outbreak, you'll discover who - or what - you are. Survive, evolve and become the ultimate Zombie Slayer.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
众人热爱的丧尸传奇回来了！《Dead Island 2》是款刺激的第一人称动作角色扮演游戏，有着恐怖、黑色幽默与夸张的丧尸砍杀调制而成的独特配方。

有个致命的病毒正在洛杉矶四处传染，将宿主转变成饥饿的丧尸。您被咬、遭到感染，但得到了超乎免疫的能力，在揭开传染爆发背后的真相时，您将查明自己究竟是谁…或者是什么东西。存活、进化，然后成为终极丧尸杀手。

Engineer Isaac Clarke is sent to repair the Ishimura's communications array, but he arrives to find a living nightmare-the ship is a floating bloodbath, the crew unspeakably mutilated and infected by an ancient alien scourge. Clarke's repair mission becomes one of survival as he fights not just to save himself, but to

games.title: Dead Space™ 2
games.shortDescription: Engineer Isaac Clarke returns for another blood-curdling adventure in the sequel to the critically acclaimed Dead Space™. After waking from a coma on a massive space city known as “The Sprawl”, the lone survivor of a horrific alien infection finds himself confronting a catastrophic new nightmare. Battling dementia, hunted by the government, and haunted by visions of his dead girlfriend, Isaac will do whatever it takes to save himself and dominate the gruesome onslaught. With an arsenal of tools…
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在轟動全球的《絕命異次元》電玩遊戲續集中，工程師伊薩克．克拉克（Isaac Clarke）再度踏上另一段恐怖的驚悚之旅。在巨大太空城市「The Sprawl」內，這位恐怖外星感染病的唯一倖存者從昏迷中甦醒，卻發現迎接自己的是宛如災難的可怕新夢魘。不但得與惱人的失智症纏鬥，還受到政府的通緝獵殺，更得面對死去女友的陰魂不散，伊薩克必須不計代價拯救自己，設法在可怕的襲擊中取得優勢。手持肢解死靈變體（Necromorph）的各式工具，憑藉著油然而生的果決意志力，我們的工程師將為太空再掀恐怖高潮。                                                          2011年，夢魘再臨！

games.title: Dead Space™ 3
games.shortDescription: Dead Space 3 brings Isaac Clarke and merciless soldier John Carver on a journey across space to discover the source of the Necromorph plague and uncover the secrets that lay within Tau Volantis.  Play alone as Isaac Clarke or with a friend as John Carver in seamless drop in, drop out co-op feature. Amplify the action with Kinect and add voice to your arsenal in single player or co-op.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《絕命異次元3》讓Isaac Clarke和鐵石心腸的士兵John Carver踏上穿梭太空的旅程，尋找Necromorph禍害的根源，發掘隱藏在Tau Volantis星球上的祕密。玩家可獨自扮演Isaac Clarke，或使用無縫接軌的即入即離合作功能與扮演John Carver的朋友同玩遊戲。搭配Kinect，無論玩單人或合作遊戲，皆可強化精采的遊戲內容，還可用您的聲音作為利器。

games.title: Dead Space™ Ignition
games.shortDescription: In Dead Space Ignition you must survive the initial Necromorph outbreak on the Sprawl. The game blends an interactive comic presentation with three unique hacking games: Hardware Crack, System Override, and Trace Route. You’ll receive unlocks in Dead Space 2, including an exclusive suit. Can you survive the events leading up to Dead Space 2?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 向活動經銷商預購《絕命異次元2》即可免費下載前傳遊戲。*在《絕命異次元：異形入侵》中完成首次破解及儲存遊戲，即可啟用《絕命異次元2》解開項目。《絕命異次元：異形入侵》將以Sprawl做為舞台，讓玩家捲入死靈變體大舉入侵的事件之中並設法存活下來。該遊戲將漫畫風格劇情與三個獨特駭客破解小遊戲結合在一起。你將可獲得《絕命異次元2》的解開項目，包括一套獨特服裝。你能否在《絕命異次元2》的前傳事件中存活下來？*免費下載需事先預訂，並自活動經銷商處取得獨特兌換碼。若不想預購《絕命異次元2》，也可單獨購買《絕命異次元：異形入侵》。

games.title: Dead Static Drive
games.shortDescription: Grand Theft Cthulhu.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Grand Theft Cthulhu.

games.title: Death Howl
games.shortDescription: Journey through the sorrowful spirit world in a soulslike deck builder. Craft cards and claim powerful totems to defeat the woeful spirits lurking in the mystical lands. Unravel the tale of a grieving mother in her desperate attempt to defy death and bring back her son.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在类魂卡牌构筑游戏《死亡呼啸》中，勇闯哀伤满溢的灵魂世界。打造卡牌，获取强大的图腾，击败潜藏在神秘土地上的哀怨之灵。揭开一位悲痛的母亲与死抗争、誓要逆天改命拯救爱子的悲壮篇章。

games.title: DEATH STRANDING DIRECTOR'S CUT
games.shortDescription: From legendary game creator Hideo Kojima comes a genre-defying experience, now expanded in this definitive DIRECTOR’S CUT. As Sam Bridges, your mission is to deliver hope to humanity by connecting the last survivors of a decimated America. Can you reunite the shattered world, one step at a time?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 知名游戏制作人小岛秀夫在《死亡搁浅导演剪辑版》中，给玩家带来了颠覆传统的游戏体验。玩家将扮演山姆·布里奇斯（Sam Bridges），你的任务就是将这残破的美国中最后的幸存者们联合起来，为人类带来希望。你能一步一步地将这破碎的世界重新连接起来吗？

games.title: DEATHLOOP
games.shortDescription: DEATHLOOP is a next-gen FPS from Arkane Lyon, the award-winning studio behind Dishonored. In DEATHLOOP, two rival assassins are trapped in a mysterious timeloop on the island of Blackreef, doomed to repeat the same day for eternity. As Colt, the only chance for escape is to end the cycle by assassinating eight key targets before the day resets. Learn from each cycle - try new paths, gather intel, and find new weapons and abilities. Do whatever it takes to break the loop.
games.shortDescriptionZh: DEATHLOOP是一款次世代第一人称射击游戏，由屡获殊荣的Arkane里昂工作室开发。此工作室曾打造好评如潮的《Dishonored》系列。本游戏中，两名敌对刺客受困于黑礁岛神秘的时间循环，注定要永远重复同一天。对于柯尔特来说，唯有赶在时间重置之前刺杀八名关键目标，从而结束时间循环，他才有机会逃脱。从每次循环中汲取教训：不断尝试新路径、发掘信息并寻找新的武器和能力。不惜一切代价打破循环。

games.title: Deep Rock Galactic
games.shortDescription: Deep Rock Galactic is a 1-4 player co-op FPS featuring badass space Dwarves, 100% destructible environments, procedurally-generated caves, and endless hordes of alien monsters.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Deep Rock Galactic 是一款多人合作科幻型第一人称射击游戏，设有了不起的矮人、100% 可破坏的环境、由程序生成的洞穴以及无数外星怪物群体。

games.title: Denshattack!
games.shortDescription: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 驾驶电车旋转跳跃、花式炫技、磨轨滑行，在这场离经叛道的快节奏狂飙中，穿越色彩缤纷的日式反乌托邦世界。击败对手帮派，摧毁黑心的巨型企业，凭借高超技巧、极速飞驰与张扬风采，夺回属于你的轨道！

games.title: Descenders
games.shortDescription: Descenders is extreme downhill freeriding for the modern era, with procedurally generated worlds, and where mistakes have real consequences. Will you lead your team to glory and become the next legendary Descender?
games.shortDescriptionZh: Descenders is extreme downhill freeriding for the modern era, with procedurally generated worlds, and where mistakes have real consequences. Will you lead your team to glory and become the next legendary Descender?

games.title: Descenders Next (Game Preview)
games.shortDescription:
This game is a work in progress. It may or may not change over time or release as a final product. Purchase only if you are comfortable with the current state of the unfinished game. 

Grab your board and master the mountain! Descenders Next is the ultimate extreme sports game, with sprawling snowy peaks, winding dirt tracks, and tons of parks to conquer. Will you and your friends become the Next Ultimate Descenders?
games.shortDescriptionZh:
此游戏是在制品。 可能会随时间更改，亦可能会作为最终产品发布。 请仅在您熟悉此未完成游戏的当前状态下购买。

拎起你的滑板，驾驭高峰与山巅！《下一代速降王者》是终极的极限运动游戏，这里有延绵的雪山，有蜿蜒的土路，还有数不胜数的公园等你来征服。你和朋友能否成为极限速降的下一代王者？

games.title: Diablo III: Reaper of Souls – Ultimate Evil Edition
games.shortDescription: This Ultimate Evil Edition contains both Diablo III and the Reaper of Souls expansion set, together in one definitive volume. Rise as one of humanity's last defenders - crusader, barbarian, witch doctor, demon hunter, monk, or wizard - and collect legendary loot while mastering devastating new powers and abilities.
games.titleZh: 暗黑破坏神 III：夺魂之镰(终极邪恶版)
games.shortDescriptionZh: 終極邪惡版是《暗黑破壞神 III》和奪魂之鐮資料片的合集。你將擔任人類的最後守護者：聖教軍、野蠻人、巫醫、狩魔獵人、武僧或秘術師，收集傳奇裝備，並且操控威力強大的全新技能來消滅敵人。

games.title: Diablo®
games.shortDescription: 1997’s Diablo set the stage for a new type of game that combined fast-paced action, deep character customization, intense multiplayer combat, and dark gothic fantasy in one bone-chilling package.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 1997’s Diablo set the stage for a new type of game that combined fast-paced action, deep character customization, intense multiplayer combat, and dark gothic fantasy in one bone-chilling package.

games.title: Diablo® II: Resurrected™
games.shortDescription: Evil has survived. Relive the epic adventure that defined the action RPG genre for decades.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 邪魔死灰复燃。重温数十载内动作角色扮演游戏的经典之作，踏入史诗级的冒险。

games.title: Diablo® II: Resurrected™ PC
games.shortDescription: Evil has survived. Relive the epic adventure that defined the action RPG genre for decades.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 邪魔死灰复燃。重温数十载内动作角色扮演游戏的经典之作，踏入史诗级的冒险。

games.title: Diablo® III: Reaper of Souls™ – Ultimate Evil Edition PC
games.shortDescription: This Ultimate Evil Edition contains both Diablo III and the Reaper of Souls expansion set, together in one definitive volume. Rise as one of humanity's last defenders - crusader, barbarian, witch doctor, demon hunter, monk, or wizard - and collect legendary loot while mastering devastating new powers and abilities.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 終極邪惡版是《暗黑破壞神 III》和奪魂之鐮資料片的合集。你將擔任人類的最後守護者：聖教軍、野蠻人、巫醫、狩魔獵人、武僧或秘術師，收集傳奇裝備，並且操控威力強大的全新技能來消滅敵人。

games.title: Diablo® IV - Standard Edition
games.shortDescription:
Diablo® IV is the next-gen action RPG experience with endless evil to slaughter, countless abilities to master, nightmarish Dungeons, and legendary loot.
 
This is only the beginning for Diablo® IV, with new events, stories, Seasons, rewards, and more looming on the horizon.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
Diablo® IV 带来了次时代的动作角色扮演游戏体验，无穷无尽的恶魔等你屠戮，数不胜数的技能待你掌握，还有噩梦横行的地下城和传奇战利品等你探索。
 
 这只是 Diablo® IV 的起点，更多活动、故事、赛季、奖励和精彩内容还将陆续推出。

games.title: Diablo® IV PC
games.shortDescription: Diablo® IV is the next-gen action RPG experience with endless evil to slaughter, countless abilities to master, nightmarish Dungeons, and legendary loot.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Diablo® IV带来了次时代的动作角色扮演游戏体验，无穷无尽的恶魔等你屠戮，数不胜数的技能待你掌握，还有噩梦横行的地下城和传奇战利品等你探索。

games.title: Dice A Million
games.shortDescription:
You like big numbers? Sure, got you covered.
Dice A Million is a roguelike deckbuilder about rolling dice to try and get to a million points. That's the whole point. (get it?!)

You're trapped in this dice rolling facility, so let's get rolling and try to escape. Combine the effects of more than 120 different dice and discover powerful synergies. Get through ever-increasing debts and challenging b
games.shortDescriptionZh:
喜欢大数字吗？当然，这儿应有尽有。

《一掷百万》是一款roguelike构筑类游戏，目标是通过摇骰子的方式达成一百万点。巧妙搭配超过100种不同的骰子并发掘它们之间的强力组合吧。用你手中精心搭配的骰子组合去冲破不断上升的目标，并击败令人生畏的boss吧。

你有能力让运气站在你这一边吗？

光靠搭配骰子还不足以让你激发它们全部的潜能。用超过80枚具有被动效果的独特戒指来装点你的手吧！它们永远处于生效状态，还能对你的骰子施加超强的效果。戴上几个拉风的戒指去秀一手操作吧！

最重要的是…
把这游戏玩坏吧 （是的我们就是那种游戏）

games.title: DIRT 5
games.shortDescription: Let Loose in DIRT 5 -  the boldest off-road racing experience ever, with a star-studded Career, four-player split-screen, innovative online modes, livery editor and more. Blaze a trail on global tracks, covering gravel, ice, snow and sand, with cars ranging from rally icons, to trucks, to GT heroes.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在DIRT 5中尽情释放自我——有史以来最大胆的越野赛体验，明星云集的职业生涯，四人分屏模式，创新的在线模式，涂装编辑器以及更多精彩内容。驾驶着经典拉力赛车或是卡车亦或是GT英雄车，在遍及全球覆盖碎石、冰、雪和沙子的各种赛道上驰骋。

games.title: DiRT Rally 2.0
games.shortDescription: DiRT Rally 2.0 dares you to carve your way through a selection of iconic rally locations from across the globe, in the most powerful off-road vehicles ever made, knowing that the smallest mistake could end your stage.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《DiRT Rally 2.0》你将驾驶史上最强力的越野车接受挑战，在精心挑选出的全世界最具代表性的拉力赛道上披荆斩棘，牢记即使最小的失误也能导致赛段的失败。

games.title: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut
games.shortDescription: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut is a groundbreaking role playing game. You’re a detective with a unique skill system at your disposal and a whole city to carve your path across. Interrogate unforgettable characters, crack murders or take bribes. Become a hero or an absolute disaster of a human being.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《極樂迪斯可》是一款極具創新性的開放世界RPG。扮演身懷絕技的警探，穿梭在城市街區間，譜寫屬於自己的篇章。訊問那些讓你無法忘卻的角色，勘破凶案，或是受賄沉淪。當英雄，還是做敗類，由你來定。

games.title: Dishonored 2
games.shortDescription: Reprise your role as a supernatural assassin in Dishonored 2 – the follow up to Arkane Studio's first-person action blockbuster and winner of more than 100 'Game of the Year' awards, Dishonored. Play your way in a world where mysticism and industry collide. How will you combine your character's unique set of powers, weapons and gadgets to eliminate your enemies?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《Dishonored 2》中再次扮演神秘刺客角色，Arkane Studios 卖座的第一人称动作游戏、曾获超过 100 项年度最佳游戏的《Dishonored》带着续作强势回归。以自己的方式，游走这个神秘主义和工业互相碰撞的世界。你会选择成为艾蜜莉‧考德温女皇，还是皇家圣卫科尔沃‧阿塔诺呢？你能隐匿行踪完成所有任务，或充分利用残忍的战斗系统，或是将二者结合呢？你会怎样组合角色的能力、武器和工具来消灭敌人呢？在进行游戏的每个精心手绘的任务时，根据你选择不同，故事的结果也将不同。

games.title: Dishonored 2
games.shortDescription: Reprise your role as a supernatural assassin in Dishonored 2 – the next chapter in the award-winning saga by Arkane Studios. Play your way in a world where mysticism and industry collide. How will you combine your character's unique set of powers, weapons and gadgets to eliminate your enemies?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《Dishonored 2》中再次扮演神秘刺客角色 - 它是 Arkane Studios 所创作、获奖项肯定的冒险故事的下一章。以自己的方式，游走这个神秘主义和工业互相碰撞的世界。你会选择成为艾蜜莉‧考德温女皇，还是皇家圣卫科尔沃‧阿塔诺呢？你能隐匿行踪完成所有任务，或充分利用残忍的战斗系统，或是将二者结合呢？你会怎样组合角色的能力、武器和工具来消灭敌人呢？在进行游戏的每个精心手绘的任务时，根据你选择不同，故事的结果也将不同。

games.title: Dishonored® Definitive Edition
games.shortDescription: Arkane Studios’ Dishonored®, winner of over 100 Game of the Year awards, and all of its additional content - Dunwall City Trials, The Knife of Dunwall, The Brigmore Witches and Void Walker’s Arsenal - come to the next generation in Dishonored® Definitive Edition!
games.shortDescriptionZh: Arkane Studios’ Dishonored®, winner of over 100 Game of the Year awards, and all of its additional content - Dunwall City Trials, The Knife of Dunwall, The Brigmore Witches and Void Walker’s Arsenal - come to the next generation in Dishonored® Definitive Edition!

games.title: Dishonored® Definitive Edition (PC)
games.shortDescription: Dishonored®, winner of over 100 Game of the Year awards is an innovative first person action game that casts you as a supernatural assassin driven by revenge. The Definitive Edition includes the award winning game and all 4 DLCs.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Dishonored》获得了100多项最佳年度游戏奖项，这是一款新颖的第一人称动作游戏，你将扮演一名一心想要复仇的超能刺客。决定版包含游戏本体和全部4个DLC。

games.title: Dishonored®: Death of the Outsider™
games.shortDescription: From the award-winning developers at Arkane® Studios comes Dishonored®: Death of the Outsider, the first standalone adventure in the critically-acclaimed Dishonored® series. Be a badass supernatural assassin and take on the role of notorious Billie Lurk as she reunites with her mentor Daud in order to pull off the greatest assassination ever conceived.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Dishonored®: Death of the Outsider》由屡获殊荣的游戏开发商Arkane® Studios推出，这是好评游戏系列《Dishonored®》的首款独立冒险游戏。化身强大的超能力刺客，扮演恶名昭彰的比莉‧勒克，与恩师多德重聚，完成一场最惊人的暗杀行动。

games.title: Dishonored®: Death of the Outsider™ (PC)
games.shortDescription: From the award-winning developers at Arkane® Studios comes Dishonored®: Death of the Outsider, the first standalone adventure in the critically-acclaimed Dishonored® series. Be a badass supernatural assassin and take on the role of notorious Billie Lurk as she reunites with her mentor Daud in order to pull off the greatest assassination ever conceived.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Dishonored®: Death of the Outsider》由屡获殊荣的游戏开发商Arkane® Studios推出，这是好评游戏系列《Dishonored®》的首款独立冒险游戏。化身强大的超能力刺客，扮演恶名昭彰的比莉‧勒克，与恩师多德重聚，完成一场最惊人的暗杀行动。

games.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley
games.shortDescription: Explore a world filled with the magic of Disney as you discover rich stories and build the perfect neighborhood alongside Disney and Pixar heroes and villains in this new life-sim adventure game. Welcome to Disney Dreamlight Valley.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款生活模拟冒险游戏中探索充满迪士尼魔法的世界，体验丰富的剧情，同迪士尼和皮克斯的英雄与反派一起打造完美的社区。

games.title: Disneyland Adventures
games.shortDescription: Disneyland Adventures allows children and Disney fans of all ages to explore Disneyland park in 4K Ultra HD and HDR, enjoy immersive adventures based on 18 popular attractions, engage in 100 challenging quests, and interact with 35 beloved Disney characters.  Disneyland Adventures is your ticket to the magical world of Disneyland right in your living room.
games.shortDescriptionZh: “Disneyland Adventures”能让大大小小的迪士尼粉丝，在 4K Ultra HD 及 HDR 的高清画面中探索迪士尼乐园，尽情体验根据 18 个知名游乐设施所设计的冒险旅程、进行 100 个富挑战性的任务，并与备受喜爱的 35 个迪士尼角色互动。“Disneyland Adventures”就像一张从您的客厅前往迪士尼魔法世界的直达车票。

games.title: Dome Keeper
games.shortDescription: Defend against waves of alien monsters in this unique roguelike action miner. Dig for resources, collect useful gadgets, and upgrade equipment to increase odds of survival – just hurry back before your dome is destroyed!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款独特的 roguelike 采矿动作游戏中抵御一波又一波外星怪物的攻击。挖掘资源，收集有用的配件并升级装备，不断提高你存活下来的可能性——记得在穹顶被摧毁前及时赶回来就行！

games.title: Donut County
games.shortDescription:
Donut County is a story-based physics puzzle game where you play as an ever-growing hole in the ground. Meet cute characters, steal their trash, and throw them in a hole.

The PC version of this game does not support Xbox Live
games.shortDescriptionZh:
Donut County 是一款叙事型物理解谜游戏。在游戏中，玩家将扮演地上一个不断变大的地洞。让我们一起来认识各种可爱的角色、偷偷拿走他们的垃圾并丢进地洞里。

本游戏的 PC 版本不支持 Xbox Live

games.title: DOOM
games.shortDescription: Now includes all three premium DLC packs (Unto the Evil, Hell Followed, and Bloodfall), maps, modes, and weapons, as well as all feature updates including Arcade Mode, Photo Mode, and the latest Update 6.66, which brings further multiplayer improvements as well as revamps multiplayer progression. Developed by id Software, the studio that pioneered the first-person shooter genre and created multiplayer Deathmatch, DOOM returns as a brutally fun and challenging modern-day shooter experience.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 現包括全部三款高級DLC包（「Unto the Evil」、「Hell Followed」和「Bloodfall」）、地圖、遊戲模式和武器，以及包括街機模式、拍照模式等所有功能更新，還有最新的6.66更新內容，為玩家帶來進一步改善的多人連線，以及多人連線進度翻新。 第一人稱射擊遊戲始祖、開發多人遊戲死鬥的 id Software 再度出手，《DOOM》帶著殘暴惡趣和高難度現代射擊體驗重磅回歸。

games.title: DOOM + DOOM II
games.shortDescription: Developed by id Software, and originally released in 1993, DOOM pioneered and popularized the first-person shooter, setting a standard for all FPS games. The critically acclaimed sequel, DOOM II, followed in 1994.  Now the definitive, newly enhanced versions of DOOM + DOOM II are available as a combined product.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 由id Software开发、并于1993年首次发布的《DOOM》开创并普及了第一人称射击游戏，为所有FPS游戏树立了标杆。备受赞誉的续作《DOOM II》紧随其后，于1994年推出。如今，《DOOM》和《DOOM II》的最终全新增强版也已作为组合产品推出。

games.title: DOOM 3
games.shortDescription: A demonic invasion has overwhelmed the Union Aerospace Corporation's Mars research facility. As one of only a few survivors, you must fight your way to hell and back against a horde of demons in this award-winning horror/action FPS and reimagining of the original DOOM.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 一次大型的恶魔入侵摧毁了联合航天公司（UAC）的火星研究设施，造成了巨大的混乱与无限的恐惧。这款备受赞誉的恐怖题材第一人称射击游戏是对初代《DOOM》的重新演绎，作为仅剩的幸存者之一，你必须杀入地狱，与恶魔大军血战到底。

games.title: DOOM 64
games.shortDescription: Fight against demons in your crusade to hunt down the Mother of Demons and stop Hell's invasion. As you battle through more than 30 action-packed levels, be on the lookout for enhanced weapons and secrets to help you put an end to the demonic threat.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在追捕恶魔之母征伐途中，击溃恶魔，阻止地狱入侵。当你在逾30个凶猛激燃的关卡中战斗时，别忘了搜寻强化武器和秘密，好帮助你终结恶魔的威胁。

games.title: DOOM Eternal Standard Edition
games.shortDescription:
Hell’s armies have invaded Earth. Become the Slayer in an epic single-player campaign to conquer demons across dimensions and stop the final destruction of humanity.

The only thing they fear... is you.

Experience the ultimate combination of speed and power in DOOM Eternal - the next leap in push-forward, first-person combat.

Discover the Slayer’s origins and his enduring mission to RAZE HELL.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
地狱军团入侵了人世间，在恢弘的单人剧情模式中扮演毁灭战士，在各个次元歼灭恶魔，制止人类最终的毁灭。

它们唯一所惧怕的……就是你。

在《DOOM Eternal》中体验速度与力量的终极结合，感受紧张刺激的划时代第一人称射击游戏。

揭开毁灭战士的来源，探索其夷平地狱的恒久使命。
