games.title: DOOM: The Dark Ages
games.shortDescription: Developed by id Software, DOOM: The Dark Ages is the prequel to the critically acclaimed DOOM (2016) and DOOM Eternal that tells an epic cinematic story worthy of the DOOM Slayer’s legend. In this third installment of the modern DOOM series, players will step into the blood-stained boots of the DOOM Slayer, in this never-before-seen dark and sinister medieval war against Hell.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 由 id Software 开发的《DOOM: The Dark Ages》是大受好评的《DOOM》(2016) 及《DOOM Eternal》前传，描写毁灭战士传奇的壮阔电影级故事。在现代《DOOM》系列的第三部作品中，玩家将扮演脚踏鲜血的毁灭战士，在这场前所未见、凶险万分的中世纪战争中对抗地狱大军。

games.title: Dragon Age: Origins
games.shortDescription: From the makers of Mass Effect comes the dark fantasy epic: You are a Grey Warden, one of the last of a legendary order of guardians. With the return of mankind's ancient foe and the kingdom engulfed in civil war, you have been chosen by fate to unite the shattered lands and slay the archdemon once and for all. (1) Immerse yourself in a shattered world on the brink of annihilation; (2) Experience complex moral decisions that have game-changing consequences; (3) Sculpt your hero in your own imag…
games.shortDescriptionZh: From the makers of Mass Effect comes the dark fantasy epic: You are a Grey Warden, one of the last of a legendary order of guardians. With the return of mankind's ancient foe and the kingdom engulfed in civil war, you have been chosen by fate to unite the shattered lands and slay the archdemon once and for all. (1) Immerse yourself in a shattered world on the brink of annihilation; (2) Experience complex moral decisions that have game-changing consequences; (3) Sculpt your hero in your own imag…

games.title: Dragon Age™ 2
games.shortDescription: You are one of the few who escaped the destruction of your home. Now, forced to fight for survival in an ever-changing world, you must gather the deadliest of allies, amass fame and fortune, and seal your place in history. This is the story of how the world changed forever.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 你是家鄉毀滅後逃過一劫的少數倖存者。現在，面對這個不斷變動的世界，你被迫為了生存而戰。你必須召集最厲害的盟友、累積名聲與財富，在歷史上奠定一席之地。這是一段如何永遠改變世界的故事。

games.title: Dragon Age™: Inquisition
games.shortDescription: The epic role-playing series from BioWare takes a thrilling leap forward with Dragon Age™: Inquisition. Beautiful vistas and incredible new possibilities await you.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《闇龍紀元：異端審判》讓出自BioWare的史詩角色扮演系列向前跨出撼人的一大步。等著您的是不可思議的全新可能性。

games.title: Dragon Age™: The Veilguard
games.shortDescription: Unite the Veilguard and defy the gods in Dragon Age™: The Veilguard, an immersive single player RPG.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在沉浸式单人 RPG 游戏《龙腾世纪™: 影障守护者》中，团结影障守护者，反抗诸神。

games.title: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2
games.shortDescription: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 is the ultimate Dragon Ball gaming experience, packed with thrilling action, epic battles, and endless customization options. Create your own character, explore Conton City and team up with iconic characters from the series as a teacher to train and be ready to battle against formidable enemies to rescue the flow of History!
games.shortDescriptionZh:
※本产品另有「数字豪华版」「数字特别版」供您选购。请勿重复购买。

属于你的故事、你的自创角、你的七龙珠世界──

《DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2》是一款动作魄力十足、战斗壮烈，并且具有无限自定义要素的七龙珠游戏。快到游戏内建立自创角探索“肯特都”，并与各个以老师身分登场的角色组队训练，挺身战斗，守护七龙珠的历史吧！
随着游戏的发展，将可以自由编辑角色的外表、能力、招式等内容，创造出充满个人特色的强大战士！
除此之外，《DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2》内还具有连机游玩模式，可跟世界各地的玩家展开史诗级的战斗，或是参加袭击头目战，一同对抗邪恶的敌人！
现在就前往持续更新带来新发现及新体验的肯特都吧！

属于你的战士
可利用多样的自定义项目，创造出你原创的风格及个性的角色。设定种族、外观、能力甚至是招式，创造出你独一无二的战士吧。

无

games.title: DreamWorks Gabby’s Dollhouse: Ready to Party
games.shortDescription: Throw a party with Gabby and the Gabby Cats. Explore magical worlds – enjoy fun activities, minigames and rewards playing solo or with a friend.
games.titleZh: DreamWorks 盖比的娃娃屋：准备开派对
games.shortDescriptionZh: 与盖比和盖比猫一起举办派对，探索魔法世界——单人/双人畅享趣味活动、小游戏和各种奖励。

games.title: DREDGE
games.shortDescription: DREDGE is a single-player fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and dredge the depths for long-buried secrets. Explore a mysterious archipelago and discover why some things are best left forgotten.
games.shortDescriptionZh: DREDGE is a single-player fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and dredge the depths for long-buried secrets. Explore a mysterious archipelago and discover why some things are best left forgotten.

games.title: Drop Duchy - Complete Edition
games.shortDescription: Build your duchy piece by piece in this refreshing hybrid rogue-lite game. Use block-dropping mechanics to collect resources, recruit troops to fight against belligerent armies, and let every block shape your realm, leading your path to victory!
games.titleZh: 方块公国 (Drop Duchy) - 完整版
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这款轻度类Rogue游戏融入了方块落下消除机制以及其他多类游戏元素，令人耳目一新。你身为一方公爵，需要堆叠方块建设领地，收集资源，集结军队，迎战咄咄逼人的敌军，带领公国走向最后的胜利！

games.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 25 Xbox One
games.shortDescription: EA SPORTS FC™ 25 gives you more ways to win for the club. Team up with friends in your favourite modes with the new 5v5 Rush, and manage your club to victory as FC IQ delivers more tactical control than ever before.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《EA SPORTS FC™ 25》将为您带来更多为俱乐部奋勇争胜的方式。在您最喜爱的模式中通过全新 5 对 5 Rush 与好友并肩作战，借助 FC IQ 以前所未有的强大战术掌控力引领您的俱乐部走向胜利。

games.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 25 Xbox Series X|S
games.shortDescription: EA SPORTS FC™ 25 gives you more ways to win for the club. Team up with friends in your favourite modes with the new 5v5 Rush, and manage your club to victory as FC IQ delivers more tactical control than ever before.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《EA SPORTS FC™ 25》将为您带来更多为俱乐部奋勇争胜的方式。在您最喜爱的模式中通过全新 5 对 5 Rush 与好友并肩作战，借助 FC IQ 以前所未有的强大战术掌控力引领您的俱乐部走向胜利。

games.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 26 XBOX One
games.shortDescription: Log in to EA SPORTS FC™ 26 by 16 September to get a 99 OVR Player Pick! Choose three 99 OVR Player Items from a pool of 20.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 于 9 月 16 日前登录《EA SPORTS FC™ 26》，即可获得一次 99 总评球员挑选机会！从 20 件 99 总评球员物品中挑选 3 件获取。

games.title: EA SPORTS FC™ 26 XBOX Series X|S
games.shortDescription: Log in to EA SPORTS FC™ 26 by 16 September to get a 99 OVR Player Pick! Choose three 99 OVR Player Items from a pool of 20.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 于 9 月 16 日前登录《EA SPORTS FC™ 26》，即可获得一次 99 总评球员挑选机会！从 20 件 99 总评球员物品中挑选 3 件获取。

games.title: EA SPORTS™ College Football 25
games.shortDescription: In EA SPORTS™ College Football 25 experience explosive gameplay variety across 134 FBS schools and immerse yourself in the iconic atmospheres of college football as you chase college greatness.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《EA SPORTS™ College Football 25》中，体验 134 所 FBS 学校多样化的劲爆游戏玩法，沉浸于大学橄榄球的标志性氛围中，追求大学橄榄球的辉煌。

games.title: EA SPORTS™ College Football 26
games.shortDescription: Bring Glory Home in EA SPORTS™ College Football 26 and experience the world of college football. Whatever path to greatness you choose, from high school recruit to the Heisman, or as a coach, you can forge your legacy.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《EA SPORTS™ College Football 26》中带来荣耀，体验大学橄榄球的世界。从高中新秀到海斯曼奖得主，或作为一名教练，无论选择哪条通往伟大的道路，您都可以打造属于自己的传奇。

games.title: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 26
games.shortDescription: BUILT FROM SUNDAYS
games.shortDescriptionZh: 由星期日所构建。

games.title: EA SPORTS™ PGA TOUR™
games.shortDescription: The exclusive home of the Majors, EA SPORTS™ PGA TOUR™ features Pure Strike for superior golf gameplay powered by ShotLink®, and unrivaled access to the world’s most exclusive golf courses.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《EA SPORTS™ PGA TOUR™》汇集了四大赛事，由 ShotLink® 技术加持的 Pure Strike 旨在提供优质的高尔夫游戏，还有无与伦比的高尔夫球场体验。

games.title: EA SPORTS™ WRC
games.shortDescription: Build the car of your dreams in our biggest rally game ever, EA SPORTS™ WRC, the all-new official videogame of the FIA World Rally Championship, the first developed by the award-winning team behind the DiRT Rally series.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在我们有史以来规模最大的拉力赛游戏《EA SPORTS™ WRC》中打造您梦寐以求的赛车。本作是 FIA 世界拉力锦标赛的全新官方电子游戏，首次由屡获殊荣的 DiRT 拉力赛系列的幕后团队开发。

games.title: Easy Delivery Co.
games.shortDescription: Easy Delivery Co. is a relaxing driving game with strange secrets. Chill out, make deliveries and get to know the mysterious residents of this scenic mountain town, all while earning well below minimum wage.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《黑猫速递》作为一款轻松惬意的送货游戏，藏着一些古怪的秘密。你在这座风景如画的山城，将一边享受送货时光，结识本地神秘的居民，一边领着远低于最低标准的工资。

games.title: Echo Generation 2
games.shortDescription: Embark on a sci-fi deckbuilding RPG odyssey. Build your crew, master powerful decks, and uncover the truth behind a growing cosmic threat. Deal the cards. Defy the cosmos. Embrace the adventure.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在這款牌組構築角色扮演遊戲，你將踏上驚心動魄的科幻旅程。召集隊友，駕馭強力牌組，應對逐漸升溫的宇宙危機，發掘背後真相。準備踏上熱血冒險，憑一手好牌對抗星際威脅！

games.title: Egging On
games.shortDescription: Scramble across dangerous levels where one crack may send you back to the start.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 跌跌撞撞地跳过危机四伏的关卡，但凡掉下来一次，就会回到起点。

games.title: Enlisted
games.shortDescription: In Enlisted, you are not only commanding a single soldier, but an entire squad! This MMO squad based shooter recreates the key battles of the bloodiest war of the 20th century, with hundreds of soldiers, tanks and aircraft taking part in each battle.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《从军》游戏中，玩家不仅能够操纵单名士兵在一线拼杀，更能指挥一整支小队达成战术目标——《从军》是一款多人在线小队射击游戏，忠实还原了风云激荡的 20 世纪多场著名战役的战斗情景。游戏中每场战斗的规模多达上百人，双方均有大量坦克与空战单位登场，打造独一无二的大战场体验！

games.title: Enlisted Xbox One
games.shortDescription: Enlisted is a squad-based first person MMO shooter covering key battles from World War II. The game carefully recreates weapons, military vehicles and the atmosphere of that era, while demonstrating really massive clashes of numerous soldiers, tanks and aircraft with artillery and naval support.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Enlisted is a squad-based first person MMO shooter covering key battles from World War II. The game carefully recreates weapons, military vehicles and the atmosphere of that era, while demonstrating really massive clashes of numerous soldiers, tanks and aircraft with artillery and naval support.

games.title: Escape Simulator
games.shortDescription: First-person puzzler you can play solo or in an online co-op. Explore a set of highly interactive escape rooms. Move furniture, pick up and examine everything, smash pots and break locks! Play thousands of community-made rooms through the level editor.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 密室逃脱模拟器是一款第一人称解谜游戏。你可以单人游玩，或是线上多人合作（最好是2～3人，但是多一些人也无妨）。探索一个接着一个的交互式密室。你可以移动家具、打碎各种瓶子、解开各种锁、把你所能看到的东西全部捡起来仔细查看！也支持社区利用关卡编辑器制作的各种密室。

games.title: Escape the Backrooms
games.shortDescription: Escape the Backrooms is a 1-4 player co-op horror exploration game. Traverse 30+ eerie backrooms levels while avoiding entities and other dangers. Try to escape but be warned: survival isn't guaranteed.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《逃离后室》是一款支持1至4名玩家联机的恐怖探索游戏。穿越30多个诡异的后室关卡，同时躲避各种异怪和其他危险。尝试逃离，但请谨记：生死难料。

games.title: Eternal Strands
games.shortDescription: Fight epic, towering creatures while blending magical abilities with an arsenal of powerful weapons to keep the world from crumbling in this third-person, action-adventure game.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款第三人称动作冒险游戏中，与史诗般的巨型生物战斗，同时将魔法技能搭配威力强大的武器库，防止这个世界濒临崩溃。

games.title: Evil West
games.shortDescription: A dark menace consumes the Old West. In solo or coop, fight with style in visceral, explosive combat against bloodthirsty monstrosities. Eradicate the vampiric hordes with your lightning-fueled gauntlet and become a Wild West Superhero.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 一股暗黑势力吞噬了‘古老西部’。即可单打独斗又可组团奇袭，玩家各凭本事、无所不用其极，激烈对战嗜血怪物。装备闪电充能护手，歼灭吸血鬼老巢，成为‘西大荒超级英雄’。

games.title: Evil West (Windows)
games.shortDescription: A dark menace consumes the Old West. In solo or coop, fight with style in visceral, explosive combat against bloodthirsty monstrosities. Eradicate the vampiric hordes with your lightning-fueled gauntlet and become a Wild West Superhero.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 一股暗黑势力吞噬了‘古老西部’。即可单打独斗又可组团奇袭，玩家各凭本事、无所不用其极，激烈对战嗜血怪物。装备闪电充能护手，歼灭吸血鬼老巢，成为‘西大荒超级英雄’。

games.title: F1® 24
games.shortDescription: Be One of the 20 and Drive like the Greatest in EA SPORTS™ F1® 24, the official videogame of the 2024 FIA Formula One World Championship™.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在 2024 赛季世界一级方程式锦标赛™官方电子游戏《EA SPORTS™ F1® 24》中成为二十精英之一，效仿传奇尽情驰骋。

games.title: F1® 25
games.shortDescription: This Story is Yours. Leave your mark on the world of racing in F1® 25, the official video game of the 2025 FIA Formula One World Championship™, featuring a revamped My Team mode, the thrilling third chapter of Braking Point and more!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 书写您自己的故事：在 2025 赛季国际汽联世界一级方程式锦标赛™官方电子游戏《F1® 25》中为赛车界留下您的印记。焕然一新的我的车队模式、扣人心弦的《刹车点》第三章等精彩内容等您体验！

games.title: Fable Anniversary
games.shortDescription: Fable Anniversary is a spectacular HD remaster of the original Fable with all-new models, textures, lighting, achievements, The Lost Chapters content, and more!
games.shortDescriptionZh: Fable Anniversary 是一款將初代 Fable 以高畫質重製的曠世鉅作，內含全新的遊戲模組與材質、光影運算、成就系統、 The Lost Chapters 的精彩內容，以及更多豐富內容！

games.title: Fable II
games.shortDescription: Fable II is the highly-anticipated sequel to the wildly successful original that sold more than three million copies, offering even more choices and building on the core gameplay theme of Fable, where your every decision continually defines who you become. Set 500 years after the original, Fable II delivers an epic story and innovative real-time gameplay, including a massive amount of freedom and choice to explore a vast collection of dungeons, catacombs, and taverns in the world of Albion.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 神鬼寓言 2 是暢銷三百萬片遊戲鉅作神鬼寓言的續集，500 年後史詩般的故事情節，延續遊戲核心故事主軸，更多的抉擇和因果關係影響您的未來。嶄新的即時遊戲，更高的自由度，讓您盡情探索遊戲世界中的地城、墓穴，還有阿爾比恩世界中的酒店。

games.title: Fable III
games.shortDescription: Fable III is the next blockbuster installment in the highly praised Fable franchise. Lead a revolution to take control of Albion, fight alongside your people, and experience love and loss while preparing to defend the kingdom against a looming threat. Your choices as ruler will lead to consequences felt across the entire land.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Fable III is the next blockbuster installment in the highly praised Fable franchise. Lead a revolution to take control of Albion, fight alongside your people, and experience love and loss while preparing to defend the kingdom against a looming threat. Your choices as ruler will lead to consequences felt across the entire land.

games.title: Fallout
games.shortDescription: You've just unearthed the classic post-apocalyptic role-playing game that revitalized the entire CRPG genre. Make the right decisions or you could end up as another fallen hero in the wastelands…
games.shortDescriptionZh: 您刚刚发现了这款振兴整个CRPG类游戏的经典后末世角色扮演游戏。做决策时须深谋远虑，否则您可能会成为又一个殒没于废土的英雄……

games.title: Fallout 2
games.shortDescription:
Fallout® 2 is the sequel to the critically acclaimed game that took RPG'ing out of the dungeons and into a dynamic, apocalyptic retro-future.

Mastering your character's skills and traits for survival, Fallout® 2 will challenge you to endure in a post-nuclear world.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《Fallout》的出现让RPG摆脱了地牢类型，进入了充满生气的末日复古未来阶段，而《Fallout® 2》正是这款游戏嘉作的续作。

掌握所选角色的技能和生存特质，以应对《Fallout® 2》中后核灾时代世界所带来的挑战。

games.title: Fallout 3
games.shortDescription: Vault-Tec engineers have worked around the clock on an interactive reproduction of Wasteland life for you to enjoy from the comfort of your own vault. Fallout 3 includes an expansive world, unique combat, shockingly realistic visuals, tons of player choice, and an incredible cast of dynamic characters. Every minute is a fight for survival against the terrors of the outside world – radiation, Super Mutants, and hostile mutated creatures.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Vault-Tec engineers have worked around the clock on an interactive reproduction of Wasteland life for you to enjoy from the comfort of your own vault. Fallout 3 includes an expansive world, unique combat, shockingly realistic visuals, tons of player choice, and an incredible cast of dynamic characters. Every minute is a fight for survival against the terrors of the outside world – radiation, Super Mutants, and hostile mutated creatures.

games.title: Fallout 3: Game of the Year Edition
games.shortDescription:
Prepare for the Future™
With Fallout 3: Game of the Year Edition, experience the most acclaimed game of 2008 like never before. Create a character of your choosing and descend into an awe-inspiring, post-apocalyptic world where every minute is a fight for survival.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
Prepare for the Future™
《Fallout 3》年度版为您献上2008年最受欢迎的游戏，收获前所未有的体验。根据您的选择创造角色，深入令人生畏、每一分钟都须为生存而奋战的末日世界。

games.title: Fallout 4
games.shortDescription:
From Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of Starfield and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, comes Fallout 4. A landmark in open-world RPG design and winner of over 200 ‘Best Of’ honors, including the DICE and BAFTA Game of the Year.

You are the sole survivor of Vault 111, emerging into a world reduced to ash by nuclear war. Every moment is a battle for survival, every decision shapes the future. Rebuild, reshape, and reclaim the Wasteland—your way.

Welcome home.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《Fallout 4》由屡获殊荣的《Starfield》与《The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim》创作团队Bethesda Game Studios倾力打造。它不仅是开放世界角色扮演游戏的扛鼎之作，还夺得了包括DICE与BAFTA年度游戏在内的200余项“最佳游戏”大奖。

作为111号避难所唯一的幸存者，你将踏入这个被核战摧毁殆尽的世界。每一秒钟你都必须为生存而战，而你的每个决定都将让未来截然不同。按照你的方式重建文明、改变环境并拯救这片废土。

欢迎回家。

games.title: Fallout 76
games.shortDescription: Twenty-five years after the bombs fall, you and your fellow Vault Dwellers emerge into post-nuclear America. Join millions of players as you explore, build, quest, and triumph in a massive open-world multiplayer adventure.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在核弹爆炸的25年后，你和其他避难所居民进入了核爆之后的美国。加入数百万玩家的行列，在这款规模庞大的开放世界多人冒险游戏中探索、追寻、建设并战胜强敌。

games.title: Fallout 76 (PC)
games.shortDescription: Twenty-five years after the bombs fall, you and your fellow Vault Dwellers emerge into post-nuclear America. Join millions of players as you explore, build, quest, and triumph in a massive open-world multiplayer adventure.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在核弹爆炸的25年后，你和其他避难所居民进入了核爆之后的美国。加入数百万玩家的行列，在这款规模庞大的开放世界多人冒险游戏中探索、追寻、建设并战胜强敌。

games.title: Fallout Tactics
games.shortDescription:
Tactical Squad-Based Combat comes to the Fallout® Universe!
In these dark times, the Brotherhood - your Brotherhood - is all that stands between the rekindled flame of civilization and the howling, radiated wasteland.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《Fallout®》世界打响了基于战术小队的战斗！
在这样的黑暗时期，您那些钢筋铁骨的兄弟将协助您在这片炼狱般的辐射废土上重新点燃文明之火。

games.title: Fallout: New Vegas
games.shortDescription: Experience all the sights and sounds of fabulous New Vegas, brought to you by Vault-Tec, America's First Choice in Post Nuclear Simulation. Explore the treacherous wastes of the Great Southwest from the safety and comfort of your very own vault: Meet new people, confront terrifying creatures, and arm yourself with the latest high-tech weaponry as you make a name for yourself on a thrilling new journey across the Mojave wasteland. A word of warning, however - while Vault-Tec engineers have prepa…

games.title: Fallout: New Vegas Ultimate Edition
games.shortDescription:
Welcome Back to New Vegas

With the introduction of the Ultimate Edition, Bethesda Softworks offers you the chance to double-down and get the complete package of New Vegas fun. Including the full suite of add-on content: Dead Money, Honest Hearts, Old World Blues and Lonesome Road.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
欢迎回到《New Vegas》

随着终极版的推出，Bethesda Softworks为您提供享受《New Vegas》完整游玩体验的机会。内含全套追加内容：《Dead Money》、《Honest Hearts》、《Old World Blues》和《Lonesome Road》。

games.title: FAR CRY 3
games.developer: Ubisoft Montreal, MASSIVE Entertainment & Ubisoft Shanghaï
games.shortDescription: Far Cry 3 is an open world first-person shooter set on an island unlike any other. A place where heavily armed warlords traffic in slaves. Where outsiders are hunted for ransom. And as you embark on a desperate quest to rescue your friends, you realize that the only way to escape this darkness… is to embrace it
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《孤岛惊魂3》是一款开放世界第一人称射击游戏，背景设定是一座与众不同的岛屿。为了解救朋友，你踏上了一段艰难的旅程，而你意识到要逃离这个地狱的唯一办法竟然是融入其中

games.title: FAR CRY 3 BLOOD DRAGON
games.shortDescription:
Welcome to an 80s vision of the future taking place on a bizarre open world island crawling with evil, now on the current generation of consoles. Become Sergeant Rex Colt, a cyber commando. Get the girl, kill the bad guys, save the world.

- As Sergeant Rex Colt, you are part man, part machine, all American. You are a state-of-the-art Mark IV cyber commando on a mission of vengeance.
- Experience updated graphics and gameplay to allow players to experience every cliché of this VHS-era vision of the nuclear future.
- Take down the enemy with ninja stars, guns, or even just good old explosives. Your battle. Your way. Their tough luck.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 体验广受好评（也是粉丝最爱）的生化题材射击游戏《极地战嚎 3：血龙》－现已登上最新世代平台。扮演半人、半机械、全美制的英雄角色「雷克斯．寇特中士」。你的任务是？击败前指挥官以及他的无情杀手生化人大军。任务达成前绝不善罢甘休。

games.title: Far Cry 3 Blood Dragon Classic Edition
games.shortDescription:
Far Cry 3 Blood Dragon Classic Edition is THE 80s-style sci-fi cyber shooter, taking place on a bizarre open world island crawling with evil – now on the current generation of consoles.

Now available in 60 FPS on Xbox Series X|S.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 時間是 2007 年，依然是未來。透過「經典版」暢玩廣受好評的《極地戰嚎 3：血龍》——把妹、擊殺壞人並拯救世界

games.title: Far Cry 3 Classic Edition
games.shortDescription: (Re-)experience Far Cry 3 Classic Edition, now available in 60 FPS on Xbox Series X|S. Create your own adventure in a single-player, open world island of danger and discovery as you journey through the dark side of humanity.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《Far Cry®3》经典版在当代的游戏主机上重现洛克群岛。
发现岛上的血腥秘密；利用环境优势；对抗凶残而疯狂的居民以拯救你的朋友。
小心这座美丽又神秘的疯狂岛屿——想要逃出生天，你需要的可不只是运气而已！

games.title: FAR CRY 4
games.shortDescription: THE SEQUEL TO THE BEST-RATED SHOOTER OF 2012* Built from the legendary DNA of its award-winning predecessor, Far Cry® 4 delivers the most expansive and immersive Far Cry® experience ever in an entirely new and massive open world. With integrated drop-in/drop-out open world co-op play, Far Cry 4 re-imagines the cooperative experience for the next generation. You’ll now be able to discover and explore the living open world of Kyrat together. *Based on Metacritic on 12/18/2012
games.shortDescriptionZh: 你是艾杰·格尔。你来到隐藏在喜马拉雅山间的凯拉特，并被卷入一场推翻变态独裁者贝根·明暴虐政权的内战。

games.title: Far Cry New Dawn
games.shortDescription:
Dive into a transformed vibrant post-apocalyptic Hope County, Montana, 17 years after a global nuclear catastrophe.
Lead the fight against the Highwaymen, as they seek to take over the last remaining resources
games.shortDescriptionZh:
于世界核灾 17 年之后，深入在末日后彻底改变的蒙大拿希望郡。
领导对抗拦路强盗，不让他们夺走仅剩的资源

games.title: FAR CRY PRIMAL
games.shortDescription:
The award-winning Far Cry franchise returns with its innovative open world gameplay, bringing together massive beasts, breathtaking environments, and unpredictable savage encounters.
Welcome to the Stone Age, a time of danger and adventure, when giant mammoths and sabretooth tigers ruled the Earth. As the last survivor of your hunting group, rise above extinction and unite your tribe.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
獲獎無數的《Far Cry》系列，帶著創新的開放世界、匯聚大量的野獸、令人嘆為觀止的環境，以及難以預測的蠻荒遭遇回來了。
歡迎來到石器時代，這是個充滿危險與冒險的時代，而此時的地球則由巨大的長毛象和劍齒虎所主宰，人類還在努力想要爬上食物鏈的頂端。做為狩獵隊的最後生還者，你必須克服絕種的危機並團結你的部落。

games.title: FAR CRY PRIMAL
games.shortDescription:
The award-winning Far Cry franchise returns with its innovative open world gameplay, bringing together massive beasts, breathtaking environments, and unpredictable savage encounters.
Welcome to the Stone Age, a time of danger and adventure, when giant mammoths and saber-toothed tigers ruled the Earth, and humanity is struggling to climb the food chain. As the last survivor of your hunting group, you will have to rise above extinction and unite your tribe.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
獲獎無數的《Far Cry》系列，帶著創新的開放世界、匯聚大量的野獸、令人嘆為觀止的環境，以及難以預測的蠻荒遭遇回來了。
歡迎來到石器時代，這是個充滿危險與冒險的時代，而此時的地球則由巨大的長毛象和劍齒虎所主宰，人類還在努力想要爬上食物鏈的頂端。做為狩獵隊的最後生還者，你必須克服絕種的危機並團結你的部落。

games.title: Far Cry® 4
games.shortDescription: Fight to liberate a war-torn Himalayan region in this open world first-person shooter. Wield a deadly arsenal, dominate land and sky with gyrocopters and war elephants, and take on enemy territory solo or in co-op.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 凯兰特隐藏在高耸如云的喜马拉雅山脉中，是一个被传统和暴力所笼罩的国家。您所扮演的是艾杰·格尔。您前往凯兰特是为了满足母亲的遗愿，可却发现自己被卷入了一场旨在打倒独裁者贝根·明并推翻其压迫政权的内战。探索和穿行在这个广阔的开放世界，当心潜伏于每一个角落的危险和意外。在这里，每一个决定都是至关重要的，每一秒都在发生一个新的故事。欢迎来到凯兰特。

games.title: Far Cry® 5
games.shortDescription: Fight a fanatical cult in this open world first-person shooter. Engage in intense combat, free hostile territory, recruit loyal followers and animal allies, and liberate Hope County solo or in full 2-player co-op.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在這款開放世界第一人稱射擊遊戲中，對抗狂熱邪教。投入激烈戰鬥、解放遭敵對勢力控制的地區、招募忠誠追隨者與動物盟友，並獨自或透過完整 2 人合作模式解放「希望郡」。

games.title: Far Cry® 5
games.shortDescription:
Far Cry comes to America in the latest installment of the award-winning franchise.

Hope County, Montana, has been overrun by a fanatical doomsday cult – The Project at Eden’s Gate – led by Joseph Seed and his siblings, the Heralds. Upon your arrival, you must spark the fires of resistance to liberate the community.  Pre-order now to get the Doomsday Prepper Pack!
games.shortDescriptionZh:
"现在预购即可取得“毁灭日预备组合包”，内含预备服装、枪枝以及载具涂装，再加上额外的消耗品。

欢迎来到蒙大拿州希望郡，一个充满自由与勇士的土地，同时也是名为“伊甸之门”著名毁灭日邪教的所在地。挺身对抗邪教领袖约瑟夫．席德、他的兄弟与使者，藉此燃起反抗的烽火并解放受陷的人民。"

games.title: Far Cry® 6
games.shortDescription:
Enter the adrenaline-filled world of a modern-day guerrilla revolution. With stunning vistas, visceral gunplay, and a huge variety of gameplay experiences, there's never been a better time to join the fight. 

Play the Far Cry® 6 FREE TRIAL and discover why GAME INFORMER calls it "A nonstop thrill ride from start to finish." And, when you buy the full game, all of your progression will be saved.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 欢迎来到雅拉，一个冻结在时间之中的热带天堂。作为雅拉的总统，安东·卡斯蒂约决心利用一切手段恢复这个国家往日的荣耀。而他的儿子迭戈，也在亦步亦趋地跟随他不义的步伐。成为一名游击战士，推翻他们的邪恶统治！

games.title: Far Cry® New Dawn
games.shortDescription:
Dive into a transformed, vibrant, post-apocalyptic Hope County, Montana, 17 years after a global nuclear catastrophe.
Lead the fight against the Highwaymen as they seek to take over in the latest installment of Far Cry.

Pre-order now to get the exclusive Unicorn Trike skin.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
於世界核災 17 年之後，潛入徹底變化的末日後希望郡
與倖存者夥伴一起，領導對抗新的危險威脅——攔路強盜，與他們橫行霸道的頭目雙胞胎戰鬥。

games.title: FARCRY 6
games.shortDescription: Lead the revolution alone or with a friend in this first-person open world guerrilla shooter. Fight with improvised weapons, travel however you can, and build your rebel network to take down Castillo's regime.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款第一人称开放世界游击射击游戏中，你将独自或与好友一同领导战斗。使用自制武器，想尽一切办法展开行动，建立你的反抗军网络，推翻卡斯蒂约的掌控。

games.title: Farming Simulator 25
games.shortDescription:
Farming Simulator 25 invites you to join the rewarding farm life. Whether you build your legacy single-handedly or cooperatively in multiplayer - you decide: This Farm is Your Farm!

New features include: 

* Three maps in North America, East Asia & Central Europe
* Crops: Rice, spinach, peas & green beans
* Animals: Goats, water buffalo & baby animals
* 400+ machines from 150+ agricultural brands
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《Farming Simulator 25》邀请你加入回报丰厚的农场生活。无论你是独自游戏，还是多人合作，你都将打造属于你的农场，它的未来由你决定！ 

新内容包括：

*北美、东亚和中欧的三张地图
*作物：水稻、菠菜、豌豆和四季豆
*牲畜：山羊、水牛和幼畜
*来自150多个农业品牌的400多种机械
*天气事件（龙卷风和冰雹）以及改进的效果
*地面改变和GPS辅助转向
*新的生产链、农场商店及建筑
*许多农务体验上的质量提升

games.title: FBC: Firebreak
games.shortDescription: Purchase FBC: Firebreak and invite your friends to play the full game for free on any platform. FBC: Firebreak is a three-player cooperative first-person shooter set within a mysterious federal agency under assault by otherworldly forces.
games.shortDescriptionZh: FBC：《Firebreak》是一款第一人称多人合作射击游戏，故事发生在一个遭受异世界势力猛烈攻击的神秘联邦机构中。机构总部在长达一年的围困中已濒临崩溃，只有联邦控制局最全能的小队 Firebreak 能带着他们精良的装备和勇敢的决心闯入这栋建筑，解决诡异危机、恢复秩序、狂轰乱炸，从危险边缘杀出一条血路。

games.title: Fe
games.shortDescription:
Run, climb and glide your way through a dark Nordic forest and explore its living, breathing ecosystem filled with secrets and mystical creatures.

Become Fe and discover a world that you will never want to leave.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在一座幽暗的北欧风格森林中四处奔跑、攀爬乃至滑翔，探索那里生机盎然、藏满各种秘密和神奇生物的生态系统。

化身为“Fe”，探索一片令您流连忘返的新天地。

games.title: Feeding Frenzy
games.shortDescription: Slurp, gulp, and crunch your way along the Frenzy Coast! The rules are simple: eat anything smaller than you; swim clear of everything else.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Slurp, gulp, and crunch your way along the Frenzy Coast! The rules are simple: eat anything smaller than you; swim clear of everything else.

games.shortDescription: Fight Night Champion combines the sweet science of boxing with the cinematic experience of a Hollywood blockbuster movie.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Fight Night Champion combines the sweet science of boxing with the cinematic experience of a Hollywood blockbuster movie.

games.title: Firefighting Simulator - The Squad
games.shortDescription: Fire alert incoming! With Firefighting Simulator-The Squad, you can become part of a major US city's firefighting team and experience how it feels to fight fires.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 火警响了！在《模拟消防英豪：小分队》中，你可以化身美国一座重要城市里的消防队队员，体验一把灭火的感觉。

games.title: FixForce
games.shortDescription: Leap, climb, and launch your friends in this chaotic co-op extraction platformer for up to 6 players! Use your drill-wrench to build your way across a vibrant post-apocalyptic world, find replacement parts, and fix broken machines.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款支持最多6人的混乱合作撤离平台游戏中，跳跃、攀爬，还能弹射队友！使用钻头扳手在生机盎然的后末日世界搭建通路，寻找替换零件，修复故障机器。

games.title: Fogpiercer
games.shortDescription: Fight through the fog in this sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder where clever positioning, explosive chain-reactions, and the environment itself can make the difference between life and death.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款类Rogue科幻卡牌构筑游戏中，穿越致命迷雾，巧妙的战略位置、强烈的连锁反应，以及战场的环境本身，都可能决定生死。

games.title: Football Manager 26
games.shortDescription: Step into the dugout and experience the future of football management.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 站在替补席前全面体验未来足球经理生涯。

games.title: Football Manager 26 Console
games.shortDescription: Step into the dugout and experience the future of football management
games.shortDescriptionZh: 亲临教练席，全面体验未来足球经理生涯。

games.title: FOR HONOR - Standard Edition
games.shortDescription: For Honor is a groundbreaking team-based PvP melee fighting game where Knight, Samurai, Viking, Wu Lin, and more face each other in endless battles. Choose amongst an ever-evolving cast of legendary heroes with unique fighting styles, and prove yourself in intense 4v4, 2v2, or 1v1 combat.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《荣耀战魂》是一款开创性的多人团队近战 PVP 游戏。骑士、武士、维京人、武林以及更多阵营将在永无止境的沙场中相互厮杀。你可以从阵容不断扩充、拥有独门招式的传奇英雄中做出选择，在激烈的 4v4、2v2 或是 1v1 对决之中证明你的实力。

games.title: FOR HONOR : MARCHING FIRE EDITION
games.shortDescription:
The Wu Lin faction comes to For Honor! Get instant access to four new heroes from the Far East: the Tiandi, the Jiang Jun, the Nuxia, and the Shaolin.

THE FOR HONOR BASE GAME IS REQUIRED TO PLAY THE MARCHING FIRE EXPANSION.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
包含《For Honor®》主遊戲，以及《Marching Fire™》資料片。
參與戰爭的紛亂，選擇你的陣營：騎士、維京人、武士或武林戰士；遊玩包含 PvP、PvE、合作模式或劇情戰役等，刺激多元的遊戲模式。

games.title: For Honor Standard
games.shortDescription: For Honor is a groundbreaking team-based PvP melee fighting game where Knights, Samurai, Vikings, Wu Lin, and more clash in endless battles. Pick unique heroes and master intense 4v4, 2v2, or 1v1 battles.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《荣耀战魂》是一款开创性的多人团队近战 PVP 游戏。骑士、武士、维京人、武林以及更多阵营将在永无止境的沙场中厮杀。挑选独具特色的英雄，征服紧张刺激的 4v4、2v2 与 1v1 对战。

games.title: For The King II
games.shortDescription: Battle against Fahrul's tyrannical Queen alone or as a party of four players in the sequel to For The King, the massively popular turn-based roguelite tabletop RPG. Will you unravel the once beloved Queen's terrible secret?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 孤身一人或者是以至多四名玩家的队伍勇敢对抗统治法汝的残暴女王，一切尽在广受好评的回合制Roguelike桌面RPG游戏《为了吾王》的续作。究竟你能否解开那位曾经备受爱戴的女王背后的可怕秘密？

games.title: Fortnite
games.shortDescription:
Everything you love, all in Fortnite. 

Drop into the action you love or discover something new with your squad. Be the last player standing in Battle Royale. Get nostalgic in Fortnite OG. Go tactical in Reload. Headline Fortnite Festival. Explore the worlds of LEGO Fortnite. There is always something new for you and your friends.

Play thousands of games made by developers like deathruns, tycoons, racing, zombie survival and more! Or, build your own games with Unreal Editor for Fortnite (UEFN) or Fortnite Creative tools for everyone to play.  Each game has an individual age rating so you can find what’s right for you.

games.title: Forza Horizon 5 Standard Edition
games.shortDescription: Limitless driving fun in an ever-evolving open world.
games.titleZh: 极限竞速：地平线 5 标准版
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在不断变化的开放世界中享受无拘无束的驾驶乐趣。

games.title: Forza Horizon 6 Standard Edition
games.shortDescription: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend in Forza Horizon's biggest open world driving adventure yet.
games.titleZh: 极限竞速：地平线 6 标准版
games.shortDescriptionZh: 驾驶超过 550 辆真实存在的赛车，探索日本的绝美风光，在 极限竞速：地平线 有史以来最宏大的冒险中成为竞速传奇。

games.title: Forza Motorsport Standard Edition
games.shortDescription: Race over 500 real-world cars including modern race cars and more than 100 cars new to Forza Motorsport. Make every lap count across 30 living tracks with multiple layouts to master and fan-favorite locations Fujimi Kaido, Nürburgring Nordschleife and Sunset Peninsula, each featuring live on-track scoring, fully dynamic time-of-day with weather and unique driving conditions that ensure no two laps ever look or play the same. Celebrate 20 Years of Forza Motorsport in the 20th Anniversary Tour and obtain special rewards.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 驾驶超过500辆真实世界的汽车，包括现代赛车和100辆以上的极限竞速新车。在粉丝最喜爱的地点，包括布兰兹哈奇、戴通纳、纽博格林北赛道以及赛百灵国际赛道等，重返27条实际存在的赛道和众多赛道布局，跑出价值。每一圈都有实时赛道评分、完全动态的时间与天气和独特的驾驶环境，从而确保玩家不会有千篇一律之感。

games.title: FragPunk
games.shortDescription: FragPunk is a new fast-paced 5v5 hero-based first-person shooter featuring power-up cards that bend the rules of combat!
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《界外狂潮》是一款全新的多人战术射击游戏，玩家将化身能力各异的界外之子，通过碎片卡改写战斗规则，逆转战场局势——此刻，规则由你定义！

捏碎规则，出奇制胜 
投身于界外狂潮的战斗，用海量碎片卡彻底打破战场法则！
调转枪口，痛击队友？先别急——对友军开枪就能提升攻速，战友情，此刻无需多言；
生命垂危，亟需治疗？不要紧——下蹲生蛋，吃掉即可恢复血量，“打鸡血”，从未如此具象！
卡组间配合与克制的极致博弈，为经典爆破模式注入全新战术维度。
所有卡牌，永久免费。即刻加入，体验界外战场的无限可能！ 

界外之子，破界来袭 
火箭狂人、陷阱大师、隐形刺客、机甲天才……
界外之子们风格各异，不同技能，让你应对界外战场各种突发状况。 
每赛季持续更新！

打破平局，以一挑五 
比赛平局，苦战加时？不如来场激动人心的“点球大战”！
选择上兵伐谋，田忌赛马？还是做个真正勇士，以一敌五？
枪法与意识的纯粹对决，

games.title: Frog Sqwad
games.shortDescription: Up to 8 player co-op extraction puzzle-platformer where you swing, jump, catapult your friends, and eat eat EAT until you grow into a humongous Megafrog. Squad up with your frog friends and storm the Sewers for the glory of the Swamp King!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这是一款最多支持8人合作的撤离式解谜平台游戏。你可以摆荡、跳跃、把朋友弹射出去，还能一路吃吃吃，长成超大巨蛙。快和蛙蛙伙伴组队，在下水道横冲直撞，为沼泽之王的荣耀而战吧！

games.title: Full Throttle Remastered
games.shortDescription: A classic graphic adventure game from industry legend Tim Schafer, telling the story of Ben Throttle, the butt-kicking leader of biker gang the Polecats who gets caught up in a tale of Motorcycles, Mayhem, and Murder.
games.shortDescriptionZh: A classic graphic adventure game from industry legend Tim Schafer, telling the story of Ben Throttle, the butt-kicking leader of biker gang the Polecats who gets caught up in a tale of Motorcycles, Mayhem, and Murder.

games.title: Gang Beasts
games.shortDescription: Gang Beasts is a silly multiplayer party game with surly gelatinous characters, brutal slapstick fight sequences, and absurd hazardous environments, set in the mean streets of Beef City.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Gang Beasts》是一款蠢萌的多人组队游戏，背景设定在牛肉城的穷街陋巷中，各色各样的橡胶小人在荒诞而危险的场景中横冲直撞，大打出手。

games.title: Gears 5 Game of the Year Edition
games.shortDescription:
The complete Gears 5 experience in one bundle. Get the celebrated campaign, recharged multiplayer and Hivebusters campaign expansion as part of the Game of the Year Edition.  
 
Gears 5 Game of the Year Edition includes: 
•	Gears 5 base game 
•	Halo: Reach Character Pack  
•	30 days of Boost 
•	Gears 5: Hivebusters expansion
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在一个捆绑包中体验完整的 Gears 5。获取年度游戏版本，体验广受欢迎的战役、更加精彩的多人游戏和蜂巢破坏者扩充内容。

Gears 5 年度游戏版内含：
•	Gears 5 基础游戏
•	《光环：致远星》角色包
•	30 天加速器
•	Gears 5：蜂巢破坏者扩充内容

games.title: Gears of War
games.shortDescription: A Nightmare from Below. A Hero from Within.The planet lies in ruin - cities crumbling, Man’s greatest works fallen. Humanity is cornered, nowhere to run. The Locust Horde has risen, and they won’t stop coming. They won’t stop killing.The Coalition is desperate for soldiers. The sick, the wounded, the imprisoned are all that remain. An inmate named Marcus Fenix, once left to die, is now charged with keeping humanity alive. He can take comfort in but one fact: The human race isn’t extinct. Yet

games.shortDescription: Gears of War returns, stunningly remastered and modernized for Windows 10 with up to 4K resolution and unlocked refresh rates. Gears of War: Ultimate Edition for Windows 10 is loaded with content including five campaign chapters not on the Xbox 360 version.

games.shortDescription: Gears Tactics is the fast-paced, turn-based strategy game from one of the most-acclaimed video game franchises – Gears of War. Outnumbered and fighting for survival, recruit and command your squad to hunt down an evil mastermind who makes monsters.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Gears Tactics 来自广受欢迎的电子游戏 Gears of War，是一款快节奏、回合制的策略类游戏。招募并指挥你的小队，前去击杀制造怪物的邪恶主谋，并在以寡击众的战斗中存活下来。

games.title: Generation Zero®
games.shortDescription: Generation Zero is a stealth-action shooter where you wage guerilla warfare against lethal mechanical enemies. Explore a vast open world map inspired by the Swedish Cold War era, take part in the resistance alone or with up to three friends in seamless co-op.

games.shortDescription: GOALS is a fast, responsive soccer game built for pure skill, real competition, and a global community. Gameplay first, free to play, crossplay and unique players. No excuses - just soccer.

games.title: Goat Simulator 3
games.shortDescription:
Pilgor’s baaack! 

Gather your herd and venture forth into Goat Simulator 3; an all-new, totally realistic, sandbox farmyard experience. Invite up to three friends in local or online co-op, create carnage as a team, or compete in mini-games and then not be friends anymore.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
Pilgor重出江湖！
 
召集伙伴一起进入《Goat Simulator 3》的世界，在极具真实感的农场沙盒场景中体验一场全新冒险。最多可邀请三位好友进行本地游戏或线上合作，既可组队厮杀，也能在小游戏中拼个你死我活，当然，恐怕从此连朋友都没得做。

games.title: Grim Fandango Remastered

games.shortDescription: The world is a vast, beautiful, and dangerous place – especially when you have been shrunken to the size of an ant. Can you thrive alongside the hordes of giant insects, fighting to survive the perils of the backyard?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这个世界广阔、美丽又危险，尤其是在你已缩小成一只蚂蚁大小的时候。你能和一群巨型昆虫一起茁壮成长，并为了生存而与后院的危险作斗争吗？

games.shortDescription:
Two years ago, you shrank to the size of an ant—now it’s happening again, but it’s not the same
You survived shrinking once—can you handle an even bigger challenge?
Shrink down again in this co-op, survival adventure game.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
两年前，你缩成了蚂蚁大小——现在情况再次发生，但已经有点不一样了
你缩小过一次还幸存了下来——你能应对更大的挑战吗？
在这款合作生存冒险游戏中再次缩小。

games.shortDescription: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
作为 Supergiant Games 的首款续作，这款游戏汲取了前作神话级类 rogue 地城探索游戏的精髓，扎根于希腊神话中的冥界和关于巫术的传说，注定会为你带来酣畅淋漓、无穷无尽的全新体验。

在冥界之外奋勇战斗
作为冥界王女，你将探索更为宏大深邃的神话世界，在奥林匹斯众神的鼎力相助下与时间泰坦抗衡。随着你的每一次失利、每一次成功，这个扣人心弦的故事也将逐渐展开……

games.title: Halls of Torment
games.shortDescription:
Slay hordes of terrifying monsters in this horde survival roguelite.
Descend into the Halls of Torment where the Lords of the underworld await you.
Treasures, magical trinkets, and a growing cast of heroes will grant you the power
to vanquish these horrors from beyond. How long can you survive?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款生存肉鸽游戏中，对抗恐怖的怪物大军。进入苦痛殿堂，盘踞在地底的领主等你去挑战。宝藏、魔法饰品和不断增添生力军的英雄阵容，都将赋予你足够的力量迎战可怕的威胁。你能够存活多久呢

games.title: Halo 5: Guardians
games.shortDescription:
Halo 5: Guardians delivers epic multiplayer experiences that span multiple modes, full-featured level building tools, and the most dramatic Halo story to date. With multiple massive FREE content releases since launch, Halo 5: Guardians offers more content, more multiplayer mayhem, and more variety than any Halo ever released!

*Online multiplayer requires Xbox Live Gold membership (sold separately)
games.shortDescriptionZh:
光环 5：守护者献上史诗级多人游戏体验，不只横跨多种模式，还有功能完整的关卡创建工具，并呈现迄今为止最精彩绝伦的光环故事。光环 5：守护者上市以来已推出多次大规模免费内容更新，为游戏增添更多内容、掀起更大的多人游戏狂潮，成为光环系列史上最丰富多样的游戏！

*如要使用在线多人游戏，您必须拥有 Xbox Live 金会员资格 (需另购)

games.title: Halo Infinite
games.shortDescription: From one of gaming's most iconic sagas, Halo is bigger than ever with a dynamic free to play multiplayer experience.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 作为游戏界最具代表性的传奇之一，Halo 如今的规模胜过以往任何时候，还有丰富多样的免费多人游戏体验。

games.title: Halo Wars 2: Standard Edition
games.shortDescription:
Real-time strategy makes an explosive return to the Halo universe in Halo Wars 2. Lead Spartans, Warthogs and other classic Halo fighting forces in a brutal war against a terrifying new enemy on the biggest Halo battlefield ever.

Set in the Viking age, a broken Celtic warrior embarks on a haunting vision quest into Viking Hell to fight for the soul of her dead lover. 

Created in collaboration with neuroscientists and people who experience psychosis, Hellblade: Senua’s Sacrifice will pull you deep into Senua’s mind.

games.title: Inscryption
games.shortDescription: Inscryption is an inky black card-based odyssey that blends the deckbuilding roguelike, escape-room style puzzles, and psychological horror into a blood-laced smoothie. Darker still are the secrets inscrybed upon the cards...
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《邪恶冥刻Inscryption》是一部墨黑色卡片主题的冒险史诗，融合了Roguelike牌组构建、密室逃脱以及心理恐怖元素，为玩家献上一杯血腥的冰沙奶昔。比玩法更黑暗的，是卡牌上冥刻的内容……

games.title: INSIDE
games.shortDescription: Hunted and alone, a boy finds himself drawn into the center of a dark project.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 孤身只影且遭到追击，男孩发现自己身陷于某个黑暗计划之中。

games.title: Iron Brigade
games.shortDescription: (Online Interactions Not Rated by the ESRB) Join the Mobile Trench Brigade!  Use a combination of mobile firepower and stationary defenses to protect humanity from the evil Monovision menace.  March side by side with allies from around the world as you fight your way through Europe, Africa, and the Pacific.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 加入行動戰壕軍團 (Mobile Trench Brigade)！您將結合行動火力與固定式防禦工事，保護人類不受邪惡生物 Monovision 的威脅。快來與世界各地的盟軍在歐洲、非洲、太平洋地區等戰場上並肩作戰！

games.title: It Takes Two - Digital Version
games.shortDescription:
It Takes Two uses Smart Delivery technology - buy the game once and play it on Xbox One or Xbox Series X|S.

Embark on the craziest journey of your life in It Takes Two, a genre-bending co-op adventure. Invite a friend to join for free with Friend’s Pass* across an abundance of gleefully disruptive gameplay challenges with a heartfelt story.
games.titleZh: 双人成行 - 数字版本
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《双人成行》使用智能分发技术——购买一次，即可在 Xbox One 或 Xbox Series X|S 上玩。

加入《双人成行》，一款别开生面的合作冒险游戏，踏入生命中最疯狂的旅程。通过好友通行证*邀请好友免费畅玩，共同体验各种搞笑又颠覆想象的游戏挑战，并从中发现真挚的情感。

games.title: Jetpac Refuelled
games.shortDescription: Purchase the full version of Rare's Jetpac Refuelled to access a wide spectrum of game features. Open up a vast array of levels, engage in battle over Xbox Live, post to the Leaderboards and play for new Achievements. The original 1983 classic is also included. Provides at least 500% of your recommended daily intake of laser-based alien extinction. PAL TV’s must be capable of displaying a 60hz signal.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 趕快購買完整版的 Rare「Jetpac Refuelled」，立即體驗經典太空遊戲。您可以挑戰無數的關卡、沉迷 Xbox Live 的戰鬥，並獲取更好的成就以刷新排行榜。無論是在 60hz 全螢幕高解析的電視上玩全新改版的太空遊戲，或是重溫 1983 年經典畫面，您將會享受到超乎想像的娛樂效果。

games.title: Joy Ride Turbo
games.shortDescription: Introducing Joy Ride Turbo, a controller-based arcade racer delivering precision handling, speed and crazy stunt mayhem! In the new Stunt Park, show off your skills or explore and find collectibles that unlock cars, giving you an edge for faster races and death-defying stunts. Plus, race new tracks and old favorites in Battle Race, Pro Race & Time Trial. Supports 4-player split-screen or race up to 8 on Xbox LIVE. With Joy Ride Turbo, everyone’s in the driver’s seat in this madcap kart racer.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 向您介紹 Joy Ride Turbo，這是由控制器操控的賽車遊戲，帶給您精確的操控性、刺激的競速，以及瘋狂的特技！您將在全新的極限公園裡展現自己的高超技術，或是四處探索，尋找可收集的物品來解除新賽車的鎖定，讓您能跑得更快、使出更酷炫的花式動作。此外，您還能在全新賽道與您喜愛的舊賽道上進行 3 種模式的遊戲：戰鬥賽車、專業賽車以及計時賽。Joy Ride Turbo 支援 4 人分割畫面遊戲，以及最多 8 人的 Xbox LIVE 線上遊戲。Joy Ride Turbo 就是適合全家大小的賽車遊戲！

games.title: Junkster
games.shortDescription: Junkster is a 3D action platformer with an awesome building mechanic. Plucky, little construction bot, UM-13 has crash-landed on a dangerous junkyard planet. Armed only with his trusty robo-wrench, Um must repair his ship and recover his lost cargo of precious human artifacts.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Junkster》是一款拥有出色建造机制的3D动作平台游戏。勇敢的小建筑机器人UM-13坠毁在一个危险的垃圾星球上。UM必须修理飞船并找回遗失的人类珍贵文物。

games.title: Jurassic World Evolution 3
games.shortDescription: Build your own Jurassic World like never before. Nurture generations of awe-inspiring dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 打造您自己的侏罗纪世界，奇妙体验再度升级。幼年恐龙系列首次登场，恐龙世代相传的大业就在你手中。在全球范围内广泛打造史前公园，借助强大的全新创意工具让想象力插上翅膀。

games.title: Kabuto Park
games.shortDescription: Kabuto Park is a cute and short bug collection game.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
来兜虫公园尽享夏日乐趣！捕捉萌到没边的虫子，悉心培养，在这款捉虫游戏拿下“夏日斗虫大赛”的冠军吧！升级装备，寻找更稀有、强大、闪亮的小虫子伙伴吧！

《兜虫公园》是一款小品级捉虫游戏，童趣满满。化身小姑娘花奈，享受一个月快乐的暑假时光。寻找、捉到最厉害的虫子，精心培养、升级，组建战队，跟其他小朋友的虫子一较高下，争夺“夏日斗虫大赛”的冠军。

在这充满夏日氛围的2-4个小时，享受宁静的捉虫时光，参与热闹的斗虫比赛。

逛公园，抓虫子🦋✨
甲虫！蝴蝶！蜜蜂！蜻蜓！还有其他虫子！兜虫公园里生活着40多种昆虫，就等你来探索。看准时机挥动捕虫网，一个一个收入你的“麾下”。

拿下天下最小的相扑比赛💪🪲
根据虫子的属性、技能或者外观挑选合适的选手组建战队，让其他小朋友看看谁才是最厉害的训虫师！入选战队的每只虫子都会为你的牌组引入新牌，这些牌在对决时可以供你“武装”战队。想尽一切办法，把对手推到

games.title: Kameo
games.shortDescription: Unleash the powers within you! An epic adventure from legendary developer Rare, Ltd.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Unleash the powers within you! An epic adventure from legendary developer Rare, Ltd.

games.title: Keeper
games.shortDescription: Keeper is a story told without words, in which a long-forgotten lighthouse is awakened and embarks upon an unexpected journey into realms beyond understanding.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Keeper》是一部无言的故事，一座被遗忘已久的灯塔悄然苏醒，踏上了一段通往未知世界的奇异旅程。

games.title: KILL IT WITH FIRE! 2
games.shortDescription: Embark on an epic co-op spider-hunting crusade! It's time to KILL IT WITH FIRE!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 参与一场史诗级的合作猎蛛圣战！再一次燃烧吧，小蜘蛛！

games.title: Killer Instinct 2 Classic
games.shortDescription:
Killer Instinct 2 Classic is included in the Season 2 Ultra Edition bundle.  To play KI 2 Classic, you must purchase Season 2 Ultra Edition. 
Killer Instinct 2 Classic is a complete port of the original arcade hit from 1996.  This enhanced version for Xbox One features competitive multiplayer over Xbox LIVE, an enhanced training & practice mode, and achievements.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
Season 2 Ultra Edition同捆包内含Killer Instinct 2 Classic。如果想体验KI 2 Classic，您需要购买Season 2 Ultra Edition。
Killer Instinct 2 Classic完全秉承了1996年红极一时的经典街机游戏原作的内容和风格。在本次Xbox One版本中拥有新的视觉效果并支持Xbox LIVE对战功能，全新的训练&练习模式及成就。

games.title: Killer Instinct Classic
games.shortDescription: The smash arcade classic returns in all its glory! Shadowy conglomerate Ultratech has organized a merciless fighting tournament of unprecedented scope and brutality. Lured by Ultratech’s promises or driven by their own motives, fighters from all over the world have gathered to compete, including a mysterious warrior monk, a disgraced heavyweight boxing champion, a convict made of living flame, and the reanimated skeleton of an ancient warrior.  Who among them has a true Killer Instinct?

games.title: Killer Instinct: Anniversary Edition
games.shortDescription: Killer Instinct Anniversary Edition is the ultimate fighting game for Xbox Series X|S.  Includes all 29 Fighters and all premium content ever released for Killer Instinct. Fight in 4K resolution and 60 FPS on Xbox Series X and Compatible PCs. Enjoy improved matchmaking, balance updates, and cross-play with Windows 11 PC. Join the fight club and unleash your killer instinct!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Killer Instinct: Anniversary Edition》是 Xbox X|S 系列上的终极格斗游戏。包括《Killer Instinct》发行以来的所有 29 位格斗家以及全部高级内容。在 Xbox X 系列和兼容的 PC 上以 4K 分辨率和 60 FPS 进行格斗吧。享受改进版的匹配机制、平衡性调整以及 Windows 11 PC 端的跨平台游戏。加入格斗俱乐部，释放你的杀手本能吧！

games.title: Killer Instinct: Anniversary Edition
games.shortDescription: Killer Instinct is the ultimate fighting game for Xbox!  Experience 4K visuals and 60 FPS on Xbox Series X and Compatible PCs. Enjoy improved matchmaking and cross-play with Windows 11 PC. Fight on!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Killer Instinct》是 Xbox 上的终极格斗游戏！在 Xbox X 系列和兼容的 PC 上以 4K 分辨率和 60 FPS 体验格斗的乐趣吧。享受改进版的匹配机制以及 Windows 11 PC 端的跨平台游戏。让战斗继续！

games.title: Kiln
games.shortDescription: An online multiplayer, pottery party brawler where teams of colorful spirits sculpt ceramic battle armor on a pottery wheel, and the size and shape of your pots determine your play-style and abilities
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这是一款在线多人“陶艺派对”格斗游戏。五彩斑斓的神灵队伍齐聚一堂，在陶轮上亲手捏塑陶瓷战甲。你手下陶器的尺寸与形状，将直接决定你的战斗风格与独特技能。

games.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance
games.shortDescription: (Re)discover Henry’s saga, from the start! Experience Kingdom Come: Deliverance, the iconic story-driven open-world RPG set in medieval Bohemia.
games.shortDescriptionZh: （再次）从头开始探索亨利的史诗传奇！体验背景设在中世纪波希米亚的剧情导向开放世界经典RPG：《Kingdom Come: Deliverance》。

games.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance
games.shortDescription: Kingdom Come: Deliverance is a story-driven open-world RPG that immerses you in an epic adventure in the Holy Roman Empire. Avenge your parents' death as you battle invading forces, go on game-changing quests, and make influential choices. Explore majestic castles, deep forests, thriving villages and countless other realistic settings in medieval Bohemia!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 你是亨利，一名铁匠之子。你被卷入激烈的内战中，眼睁睁看着一群入侵者践踏你的村庄，屠杀你的家人。勉强逃过这场浩劫，你拿起剑挺身反击。为你的双亲报仇，并协助击退侵略的势力！

games.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
games.shortDescription: A thrilling story-driven action RPG set in a richly detailed open world of 15th-century Medieval Europe. Experience the ultimate medieval adventure through the eyes of young Henry as you embark on an epic journey.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 走进 15 世纪的欧洲，体验丰富多彩的开放世界，畅玩这款精彩的叙事驱动型角色扮演游戏，开启究极中世纪冒险，扮演年轻的亨利，踏上一场史诗级的旅程。

games.title: Kingdom Two Crowns
games.shortDescription: Build your kingdom and explore three unique lands covered in mysterious forests filled with secrets and mystery. Kingdom Two Crowns is an atmospheric micro strategy game wrapped in modern pixel art aesthetics. It’s easy to pick up and play with an in-depth campaign mode playable in solo or co-op.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 建造你的王国，探索秘林之中三片各不相同的神秘土地。《王国：两位君主》是一款氛围浓厚的像素画风微策略游戏，美术风格精美而现代。游戏上手容易，战役模式可以让你深入体验游戏，单人或者合作均可。

games.title: Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light
games.shortDescription: Experience the first ever co-op action-adventure game featuring Lara Croft. Team up with a friend or go at it alone as you traverse and solve deadly traps, fight hordes of undead enemies, and collect over 60 artifacts and relics.  Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light offers fast-paced action and breathtaking visuals shown through an isometric view.

games.title: Lara Croft and the Temple of Osiris
games.shortDescription: Lara Croft and the Temple of Osiris is the sequel to the critically-acclaimed Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light, and the first-ever four-player co-op experience with Lara Croft. Featuring stunning visuals and a brand-new story, players must work together to explore the temple, defeat hordes of enemies from the Egyptian underworld, solve devious puzzles, and avoid deadly traps. All the while, players will compete for treasure, powerful artifacts, and ultimate bragging rights.

于1999年发售的《圣剑传说 Legend of Mana》如今仍受众多“圣剑传说”粉丝喜爱。
本作品历经25年之后，将以HD Remaster的形式登陆Xbox。

games.shortDescriptionZh:
在这款与众不同的全新大作中，一口气体验所有九部传奇系列电影。拥有超过300个可玩角色、100多种载具和23个星球等你探索。一个遥远的星系，从未如此有趣！

EPIC EMOTIONAL DRAMA

BEST-IN-CLASS RPG ACTION

从“人生低谷”东山再起的男人——春日一番，以及面临“人生最后”之战的男人——桐生一马。
由两位主角演绎的超大作RPG，系列至高的感人故事 。

games.shortDescription:
A new legend begins as you step into the steel toe boots of Goro Majima, a man who has lost his memory and reinvents himself as a pirate on the open sea.

Embark on an over-the-top, modern-day pirate adventure with an ex-yakuza, now pirate captain and his crew as they engage in exhilarating combat on land and sea in the hunt for lost memories and a legendary treasure.

games.shortDescriptionZh: 扮演一只个性十足的好奇小猫，踏上寻找回家之路的大冒险！探索这座巨大的城市，结交各色的流浪动物朋友，戴上可爱的帽子装扮，顺便再制造一点小混乱...谁让搞怪捣蛋是我们猫咪的拿手好戏呢？

games.title: Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition
games.shortDescription: (Re)-Discover the dark whimsical tale of Little Nightmares, now enhanced in stunning 4K and 60 FPS. Play as Six, a lone child trapped in The Maw, a massive vessel inhabited by monstrous, distorted versions of adults. Sneak, hide, and survive in a world where your childhood fears come to life.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
"在60 FPS、4K分辨率的惊艳表现之下，再次跃入黑暗又怪诞的《小小梦魇》。
贪颚号──那是一艘巨大的船只，里头有很多可怕又扭曲的大人盘据其中，而你将化为小六，一名被困在船里的小孩子。
那些儿时梦魇即将重现眼前，做好潜行、躲藏的准备，从贪颚号逃出生天吧。"

games.title: Little Nightmares II Enhanced Edition
games.shortDescription:
Return to a world of charming horror in Little Nightmares II, a suspense adventure game in which you play as Mono, a young boy trapped in a world that has been distorted by the humming transmission of a distant tower.

Together with his new friend Six, Mono sets out to discover the disturbing secrets of The Signal Tower, if they can make it past a gallery of new threats and enemies.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
重回那令人着迷的恐怖世界──
在《小小梦魇2》的悬疑冒险旅途中，您将化身为小男孩摩诺，身处在电波笼罩之下，因此变得扭曲的世界里。

摩诺将与新结交的朋友小六携手合作，揭发讯号塔暗藏的秘密……但必须先克服迎面而来的威胁与敌人。

games.title: Little Rocket Lab
games.shortDescription: Transform your childhood home as you build brilliant factories and forge lifelong friendships, then reach for the skies and finally finish your family's dream - your mother's precious rocket ship. Roll up your sleeves, it turns out that saving this town really IS rocket science!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 改造童年的家园，建设气派的工厂，培养一辈子的友谊，然后展望九天，最终圆了家人的梦想，完成妈妈珍爱的火箭飞船。卷起袖子加油吧，挽救这个小镇真的像制造火箭一样，没有那么简单!

games.title: Lost in Random™
games.shortDescription: Play the odds in Lost in Random™, a gothic fairytale-inspired action adventure where every citizen’s fate is determined by the roll of a dice.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《Lost in Random™》中让幸运女神垂青于你，这是一款哥特童话风格的动作冒险游戏，这个王国中每个公民的命运都由掷骰决定。

games.title: Lost Records: Bloom & Rage
games.shortDescription: Embark on a new narrative journey by the creators of Life is Strange. Film your summer of 1995 and create memories of a lifetime with your new friends. 27 years later, confront the dark secrets that made you all promise to never speak again after that fateful summer.
games.titleZh: 遗失的纪录：绽放与愤怒
games.shortDescriptionZh: 踏上《奇异人生》创作者的全新叙事之旅。拍摄1995年的夏天，与新朋友一起创造终生难忘的回忆。27年后，重新面对黑暗的秘密。这个秘密曾让你们所有人发誓在那个宿命的夏天之后对此缄口不提。

games.title: Luna Abyss
games.shortDescription: Luna Abyss is a single player story driven action-adventure with fluid platforming and bullet hell combat. Follow the journey of Fawkes, a prisoner of Luna caught between a cryptic prophecy and their prison sentence.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《月之深渊》是一款以故事线为驱动的单人动作冒险游戏，游戏的核心是平台跳跃和弹幕射击。在月球上的神秘预言和牢狱之灾的困境中，跟随囚犯福克斯一起完成TA的冒险。

games.title: Madden NFL 25 Xbox One
games.shortDescription: NOTHING HITS LIKE MADDEN
games.shortDescriptionZh: 无可匹敌的《MADDEN》冲击力

games.title: Madden NFL 25 Xbox Series X|S
games.shortDescription: NOTHING HITS LIKE MADDEN
games.shortDescriptionZh: 无可匹敌的《MADDEN》冲击力

games.title: Manor Lords (Game Preview)
games.shortDescription: Manor Lords is a medieval strategy game featuring in-depth city building, large-scale tactical battles, and complex economic and social simulations. Rule your lands as a medieval lord – the seasons pass, the weather changes, and cities rise and fall.
games.titleZh: 庄园领主 Manor Lords (游戏预览版)
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《庄园领主》是一款中古时期策略游戏，具备深入详尽的城市建造、富有战术深度的大规模战斗，以及复杂的经济和社会模拟。以中古时期领主的身分统治你的土地——坐看季节更迭，天气变化，城市兴衰。

games.title: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion
games.shortDescription: A cosmic battle awaits! Choose between 15 Marvel Super Heroes in this frenetic action beat ‘em up to fight against the deadly Annihilation Wave threatening the galaxy. From New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone, the future of the Marvel Universe will be fought for across the stars!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 一场宇宙大战即将打响！在这款紧张刺激的清版过关动作游戏中，从15位漫威超级英雄中选择你的角色，对抗威胁银河系的致命湮灭波。从纽约市到负空间的深处，关乎漫威宇宙未来的激战将在星际间展开！

games.title: Mass Effect
games.shortDescription: You are Commander Shepard of the SS Normandy, an elite agent in humanity’s Systems Alliance Military. Explore the galaxy with your hand picked squad of combat, tech and biotic specialists as you race against time to stop a madman bent on galactic destruction. Download new systems and worlds to visit! Meet new characters and encounter never before seen alien species! Find new weapons, armor and items as you experience a whole new adventure!
games.shortDescriptionZh: You are Commander Shepard of the SS Normandy, an elite agent in humanity’s Systems Alliance Military. Explore the galaxy with your hand picked squad of combat, tech and biotic specialists as you race against time to stop a madman bent on galactic destruction. Download new systems and worlds to visit! Meet new characters and encounter never before seen alien species! Find new weapons, armor and items as you experience a whole new adventure!

games.title: Mass Effect 2
games.shortDescription: Across the galaxy, entire human colonies are vanishing. As Commander Shepard, you will recruit anelite team of the galaxy’s most dangerous and skilled experts, and lead them on an assault into themost dangerous area of the galaxy - from which you might not return. Download new equipment andmissions to continue your adventure even after the main story is complete. They say the mission issuicide. Prove them wrong.

games.title: Mass Effect™ 3
games.shortDescription: Mass Effect 3 plunges you into an all-out galactic war to take Earth back from a nearly unstoppable foe – and how you fight that war is entirely up to you.  With over 40+ perfect review scores, USA Today heralds Mass Effect 3 as "the first true blockbuster of the year."
games.shortDescriptionZh: 並非所有人都能倖免。人稱「收割者」的古老外星種族大舉入侵，打算讓一切飛灰湮滅。地球被佔領，銀河危在旦夕，只有你能阻止它們。失敗唯有毀滅一途。

games.title: Mass Effect™ Legendary Edition
games.shortDescription: The Mass Effect™ Legendary Edition includes single-player base content and over 40 DLC from the highly acclaimed Mass Effect, Mass Effect 2, and Mass Effect 3 games, including promo weapons, armors, and packs – remastered and optimized for 4K Ultra HD.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《质量效应》传奇版将包含单人基础内容及广受赞誉的《质量效应》《质量效应2》及《质量效应3》三部曲系列超过 40 款 DLC，更有多种促销武器、装甲，及各种组合包等你来拿——所有内容，全部重置优化新升级，4K Ultra HD，等你体验。

games.title: Mass Effect™: Andromeda
games.shortDescription: Mass Effect: Andromeda travels deep into the Andromeda Galaxy, far beyond the Milky Way. There, you will lead our fight for a new home in hostile territory where we are the aliens. This is the story of humanity’s next chapter, and your choices throughout the game will ultimately determine our survival in the Andromeda Galaxy.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Mass Effect: Andromeda》将深入远在银河系之外的仙女星系。 你将率队深入险境，为建立新的家园而战——在那里，我们才是外星人。 这是一部关于人类未来篇章的传奇故事，你在游戏过程中所做的选择将最终决定我们在仙女星系的生死存亡。

games.title: MASSIVE CHALICE
games.shortDescription: MASSIVE CHALICE is a tactical strategy game set on an epic timeline from Double Fine Productions. As the Immortal Ruler of the Nation, you'll take command of its heroes, forge marriages to strengthen your Bloodlines, and battle a mysterious enemy known as the Cadence in a war lasting hundreds of years.
games.shortDescriptionZh: MASSIVE CHALICE 是由 Double Fine Productions 设於长期战争的战术性策略游戏。作为国家的永生统治者，你将对其英雄下达命令、建立姻亲来加强你的血族、以及与神秘敌人 Cadence 展开一场持续数百年的战争。

games.title: MAVRIX by Matt Jones
games.shortDescription: The Ultimate Playground For Riders! Discover mountains and trails with limitless control and build your own career. Pull huge tricks or race through the global rankings! Nail challenges to secure sponsorship deals with real world brands. Are you ready?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 专为骑手打造的究极游乐场！摆脱束缚，利用自由的操控能力尽情探索高山与骑行路线，一步步打造自己的职业生涯。表演惊人特技，或者在全球排行榜中全力冲刺！征服各式各样的挑战并拿下来自真实品牌的赞助商合约。你准备好了吗？

games.title: Max: The Curse of Brotherhood
games.shortDescription:
Max: The Curse of Brotherhood is a classic action-adventure. At its core it is a platformer filled with puzzles. Max must start on a quest to save his brother who is kidnapped to a hostile world. His only chance to succeed is to stay courageous and use the powers of his marker to manipulate the environment. 
Unleash the many powers of the Marker and beat the evil kidnapper!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 麦克斯：兄弟魔咒 是一款充满刺激和创意解谜的动作冒险游戏。为了拯救他的弟弟 Felix，只带着一支魔法麦克笔的 麦克斯  必须勇敢面对并克服充满邪恶和敌意的奇幻世界。一起加入 麦克斯 的伟大冒险旅程吧！

games.title: MechWarrior 5: Clans
games.shortDescription: In MECHWARRIOR 5: CLANS, players become new Smoke Jaguar pilots in the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. Lead a five-mech "Star" squad across diverse planets, engaging in an expansive campaign with immersive gameplay and intricate combat. Customize BattleMechs with cutting-edge technology and explore strategic options.
games.shortDescriptionZh: In MECHWARRIOR 5: CLANS, players become new Smoke Jaguar pilots in the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. Lead a five-mech "Star" squad across diverse planets, engaging in an expansive campaign with immersive gameplay and intricate combat. Customize BattleMechs with cutting-edge technology and explore strategic options.

games.title: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries
games.shortDescription:
BE YOUR OWN WEAPON OF WAR

Welcome to the year 3015! It’s a hell of a time to be alive. Humanity has colonized thousands of star systems, war is everywhere, and the battlefields of the future are dominated by hulking machines known as BattleMechs. It’s dangerous work for the elite pilots of these metal monstrosities, but that’s why a power hungry MechWarrior like you came here, right? If you’re looking to blast, wreck, stomp - and profit - step inside!

games.title: Medal of Honor Airborne
games.shortDescription: Take to the skies in Medal of Honor Airborne, where your choices will turn the tide of WWII.  Starting with your jump from a C-47, every choice you make can seal your fate.  In the air, control your parachute to select the landing spot that brings you the greatest strategic advantage.  On the ground, explore the open, vertical environment for positions that will provide you a tactical edge against your enemies.  Then, head onto Xbox LIVE for furious multiplayer battles in three different modes,

games.title: Medieval Dynasty
games.shortDescription: Hunt, survive, build and lead in the harsh Middle Ages: Create your own Medieval Dynasty and ensure its long-lasting prosperity or die trying!

games.title: Microsoft Bubble
games.shortDescription: Pop into action with Microsoft Bubble - a classic bubble-shooting game with an upgraded edge. Elevate your skills with endless levels, explosive power-ups, challenging objectives & evolving missions. Unlock Xbox Achievements, reach your high score, or catch a break with bubble-popping fun!

games.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) Standard 40th Anniversary Edition
games.shortDescription:
From light planes to wide body jets to gliders and helicopters, fly highly detailed and accurate aircraft in the Microsoft Flight Simulator 40th Anniversary Edition. The world is at your fingertips.

The Standard 40th Anniversary Edition features 37 airplanes, gliders, and helicopters with unique flight models, 25 handcrafted airports, 4 classic commercial airports, 14 heliports and 15 glider airports.

games.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 - Standard Edition
games.shortDescription: Pursue your aviation career throughout the world with dynamically-generated missions ranging from Medevac and Search & Rescue to Aerial Firefighting and Passenger Transport. Compete against other pilots in the iconic Reno and Red Bull Air Races. Enhanced physics and aircraft systems and a groundbreaking flight planner create an unparalleled simulation experience. Explore the most detailed digital twin of the world to date with real-time air and ship traffic and a vast array of animals. Set out on your global adventure with our largest fleet of aircraft as Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 takes simulation to new heights of authenticity and realism.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在全球范围内探索你的飞行生涯，完成从医疗撤离、搜救，到空中消防和客运等动态生成的任务。在标志性的雷诺和红牛空中竞赛中与其他飞行员一决高下。增强的物理和飞机系统以及突破性的飞行规划器，共同打造了这无可比拟的模拟体验。探索迄今为止细节更为逼真的数字孪生世界，体验实时的空中和海上交通，以及丰富多样的动物生态。随着《Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024》将模拟体验提升至前所未有的真实性和逼真度，敬请驾驶我们庞大的机队踏上你的全球探险之旅。

games.title: Microsoft Jewel
games.shortDescription:
Microsoft Jewel is the ultimate Match-3 game!

Make matches to fill the meter & collect Bonus Jewels. Conquer fresh Daily Challenges, unlock Xbox Achievements, and dazzle in the brilliance of a high score!
games.shortDescriptionZh:
Microsoft Jewel is the ultimate Match-3 game!

Make matches to fill the meter & collect Bonus Jewels. Conquer fresh Daily Challenges, unlock Xbox Achievements, and dazzle in the brilliance of a high score!

games.title: Microsoft Mahjong
games.shortDescription: Microsoft Mahjong is the classic tile-matching game now updated with Daily Challenges, a new look and feel, and over 40 puzzles!
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在 Microsoft Mahjong 中，于美观的背景与舒缓的音效中配对麻将牌，找到内心的平静。选择适合你的难度和棋盘，享受舒缓的游戏体验。清除所有麻将牌即可获胜，并召唤麻将龙，为你带来好运与喜悦，一同庆祝！

参与每日挑战可体验更多匹配麻将牌的乐趣。每天都有五 (5) 个新谜题，在金色牌、闪电牌、匹配攻击、得分攻击和经典玩法等有趣的游戏模式中，锻炼你的思维。赢得奖带，完成完美一局。可以撤消、重新洗牌或缩放，调整游戏，找到最适合你的平衡。

使用 Microsoft 帐户登录，获得成就、与好友竞争，并跟踪个人统计信息。
登录后会保存进度，这样就可以在任意 Windows 设备上继续上次的游戏。

现在就开始享受 Microsoft Mahjong 带来的平静时光吧。

games.title: Microsoft Solitaire Collection
games.shortDescription:
Join millions of players worldwide in the most played Solitaire game in history - including even MORE great games to play!

Enjoy classic Solitaire game modes everyone loves - Klondike Solitaire, Spider Solitaire, FreeCell Solitaire, TriPeaks Solitaire & Pyramid Solitaire. Keep your mind sharp increasing your Difficulty, completing Daily Challenges, playing Weekly Rewards, or climbing the leaderbo
games.shortDescriptionZh:
與全球數百萬玩家一起加入有史以來最常玩的紙牌遊戲，現在還有更多好玩的遊戲!

享受每個人都喜歡的傳統紙牌遊戲玩法 - Klondike Solitaire、Spider Solitaire、FreeCell Solitaire、TriPeaks Solitaire 和 Pyramid Solitaire。 保持頭腦敏銳以提高難度、完成每日挑戰、獲得每週獎勵，或攀登活動排行榜。透過經驗值升級、收集獎盃和成就等以慶祝獲勝!

此外，還可以探索其他隨時可玩的精彩三消類和街機風格遊戲 - Microsoft Bubble、Jewel、Gravity Blocks、Gem Drop 和 Mahjong 3D。

 使用 Microsoft 或 Xbox 帳戶登入，可儲存您的進度、收集獎勵以及跨裝置玩遊戲。
Microsoft Solitaire Collection 有這麼多好玩的遊戲，是適合任何人

games.title: Minecraft
games.shortDescription: Explore randomly generated worlds and build amazing things from the simplest of homes to the grandest of castles. Play in creative mode with unlimited resources or mine deep into the world in survival mode, crafting weapons and armor to fend off the dangerous mobs.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 探索随机生成的世界，建��不可思议的事物，从最简单的住宅，到最宏伟的城堡。您可以在创意模式中享用无限资源，也可以到生存模式中挖掘整个世界，合成武器和护甲，抵御各种危险生物。

games.title: Minecraft Dungeons
games.shortDescription: Fight your way through an all-new action-adventure game, inspired by classic dungeon crawlers and set in the Minecraft universe! Up to four friends can play together, or you can brave the dungeons alone. Battle new-and-nasty mobs across action-packed, treasure-stuffed, wildly varied levels, all in an epic quest to defeat the evil Arch-Illager!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款以经典的地下城爬行者为灵感、以《我的世界》为背景的全新动作冒险游戏中杀出一条血路！独自挑战地下城，或者和好友一起组队！至多四名玩家可以组队，一起通关惊险刺激、宝藏满满且风格各异的各个关卡，而这一切都是为了一项史诗级的使命：拯救村民，打倒邪恶的 Arch-Illager！

games.title: Minecraft Dungeons for Windows + Launcher
games.shortDescription:
Please note that if you purchase the game on the Microsoft store, you will also need to access and play your game through the Microsoft store.

Fight your way through an all-new action-adventure game, inspired by classic dungeon crawlers and set in the Minecraft universe! Up to four friends can play together, or you can brave the dungeons alone. Battle new-and-nasty mobs across action-packed, treasure-stuffed, wildly varied levels, all in an epic quest to defeat the evil Arch-Illager!

games.shortDescriptionZh:
请注意，如果您是在 Microsoft 商店购买的游戏，您需要通过 Microsoft 商店才能访问并开启游戏。

在这款以经典的地下城爬行者为灵感、以《我的世界》为背景的全新动作冒险游戏中杀出一条血路！至多四名玩家可以一起组队，或者您也可以独自挑战地牢。在惊险刺激、宝藏多多、风格各异的关卡中与邪恶的新生物作战。而这一切都是为了一项伟大的使命：击败邪恶的奇厄教主！

games.title: Minecraft Legends
games.shortDescription: The piglins’ Nether corruption is spreading across the Overworld, scorching everything it touches. Are you the hero who will protect this gentle land? Plan your strategy and face the piglins in epic battles – but be warned: they always fight back. Take on piglin bases by day and defend your allies after dusk. Explore lush biomes filled with treasures and perils, meet new friends, and reunite with
games.shortDescriptionZh:
猪灵的下界腐化之力正在吞噬主世界，烧毁它所接触的一切。你是保卫这片温柔土地的英雄吗？制定战略，在史诗般的战斗中对抗猪灵 - 但要注意：它们总是会反击。白天攻占猪灵基地，黄昏后保护你的盟友。探索充满宝藏和危险的郁郁葱葱的生物群系，结识新朋友，并与友好的生物结盟。有小安粒站在你的阵营，剩下要做的就是拯救世界。

以前所未有的方式体验《我的世界》宇宙和主世界中的史诗传奇

与新朋友和友好的生物结盟，然后在史诗般的战斗中冲锋在前，对抗凶猛的猪灵，保卫主世界

穿越一个郁郁葱葱、充满活力的世界，这个世界资源丰富，每次都有不同的体验

挑战你的朋友或在激烈的战斗中与他们组队，保卫村庄，同时带领你的单元摧毁对手的定居点

Plan your strategy and face the piglins in epic battles – but be warned: they always fight back. Take on piglin bases by day and defend your allies after dusk. Explore lush biomes filled with treasures and perils, meet new friends, and reunite with

games.shortDescription: Minecraft Preview is only available to players who own Minecraft. Preview allows you to experience unreleased Minecraft features, fresh from the development team at Mojang Studios!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《我的世界》预览版可让您体验未发布的功能，这些功能由 Mojang Studios 的开发团队全新打造！

games.title: Minecraft Preview for Windows
games.shortDescription: Minecraft Preview is only available to players who own Minecraft. Preview allows you to experience unreleased Minecraft features, fresh from the development team at Mojang Studios!

games.title: Minecraft: Java & Bedrock Edition for PC
games.shortDescription:
CREATE 
Build whatever you can imagine in your own infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough. 

EXPLORE   
Discover biomes, resources and mobs, and craft your way through a world filled with surprises in the ultimate sandbox game. 

SURVIVE  
Experience unforgettable adventures as you face mysterious foes, traverse exciting landscapes, and travel to perilous dimensions. 

PLAY TOGETHER  
H
games.shortDescriptionZh:
创造
充分发挥想象，在不受束缚的世界中打造超凡事物，每一次游戏都会带来独一无二的体验。

探索 
探索各种生物群落、丰富资源和迥异的生物，在这款出色的沙盒游戏中打造一个充满惊奇的世界。

生存
迎战神秘敌人，穿越激荡人心的风景，踏上险象环生的异世界之旅，感受难忘的冒险旅程。

共同畅玩
在《Bedrock Edition》中，即使与朋友们相隔千里，也能跨平台在主机、移动设备和 PC 端和他们畅享游戏之乐。也可加入其他 Minecraft 玩家的队伍，在 PC、Mac 和Linux 上的《Java Edition》中共同冒险*。既能在《Bedrock Edition》中的社区服务器上与数百万玩家交流互动，也可订阅 Realms Plus 或 Realms for Java，与多达 10 位好友在私人服务器上尽享游戏时光。

体验更多精彩
在 Minecraft Marketplace 上获取

games.title: Minishoot' Adventures
games.shortDescription: Fly into a charming handcrafted world and go on an adventure that mixes up open exploration with crispy twin-stick shooter action.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
飞进手工打造的迷人世界，开始一场开放式探索和爽快双摇杆射击动作的冒险。
从光亮的地上世界一路杀到最幽深的洞穴，改良你的飞船，击败地下城中的首领，救出自己的朋友！

逆天改命者回来了……
他的爪牙从地下世界出现，你的村庄被摧毁，你所有的朋友现在都困在腐化的水晶中……踏上拯救世界的旅程，我们希望在这趟弹幕冒险中，将开放探索的简单乐趣和完整爽快的射击游戏体验融为一体。

开始紧张的战斗
控制一艘快速灵敏的飞船，在手工打造的遭遇战中火力全开，感受水晶剔透的美学和爽快的游戏体验。在紧张的弹幕战斗中击败首领，无论是新手还是老玩家都能找到适合自己的难度。

独自冒险
闯进全手动制作的世界，这里有许多相互关联之处可以让你探索。华丽的洞穴、古老的庙宇和沉没的城市，还有其中独有的宝藏、挑战和秘密都在等待你的探索。

夺回被盗的力量
找到原始力量，这将提升你的战斗和探索能力，同时你还能在解锁新路径和揭示新捷径的

games.title: MIO: Memories in Orbit
games.shortDescription: Play as android MIO in this mesmerizing metroidvania where you explore the Vessel, an enormous technological ark overgrown with machines gone rogue. Uncover its secrets, enhance MIO's abilities, and save the spaceship and its residents from oblivion.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款迷人的银河恶魔城类游戏中扮演机器人MIO，探索这艘长满茂密植被、仪器全部失灵的巨大科技方舟。揭开飞船的秘密，强化MIO的能力，拯救飞船和船上的居民远离湮灭。

games.title: Mirror's Edge™
games.shortDescription: In a city where information is heavily monitored, where crime is just a memory, where most people have sacrificed freedom for a comfortable life, Some choose to live differently. Some. like you, are Runners, phenomenally agile messengers who deliver sensitive information for a price. You are a Runner called Faith. Murder has come to this city. And now you are being hunted.
games.shortDescriptionZh: In a city where information is heavily monitored, where crime is just a memory, where most people have sacrificed freedom for a comfortable life,Some choose to live differently. Some. like you, are Runners, phenomenally agile messengers who deliver sensitive information for a price.You are a Runner called Faith. Murder has come to this city. And now you are being hunted.

games.title: Mirror's Edge™ Catalyst
games.shortDescription:
ONLINE FEATURES FOR THIS TITLE HAVE BEEN DISCONTINUED. 

Mirror's Edge™ Catalyst raises the action-adventure bar through fluid, first person action and immerses players in Faith's origin story as she fights for freedom within the city of Glass.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
此游戏的在线功能已终止。

《镜之边缘：Catalyst》通过流畅的第一人称动作达到了动作冒险游戏的新高度，让玩家沉浸在 Faith 的起源故事中，在 Glass 城中为自由而战。

games.title: Mistfall Hunter
games.shortDescription:
Mistfall Hunter is a dark fantasy extraction ARPG.
Combine skills, talents, and gear for each class in thrilling combat! Whether you team up or go solo, one thing remains certain—only by fighting your way through can you return with a full haul. Good luck, Gyldhunter.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《雾影猎人》是一款黑暗奇幻动作搜打撤游戏。
根据不同职业精心搭配技能、天赋、装备，领略第三人称视角下的精彩动作战斗！或与队友密切配合，或孤身一人加入战场，唯有杀出重围，方能满载而归。猎金人，祝你好运。

games.title: Mixtape
games.shortDescription:
Mixtape - Nothing but the hits. 
On their last night together, three friends embark on one final adventure. Play through a mixtape of memories, set to the soundtrack of a generation.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在齐聚的最后一晚，三位好友踏上了最后一次冒险之旅。伴着混音带走过青春记忆，陶醉在属于一代人的经典旋律中。

games.title: MONOPOLY 2024
games.shortDescription: MONOPOLY® is back with a fresh look and an improved game experience. Buy, sell, trade properties, and grow your empire in a fully animated 3D city that transforms from sunlit days to stormy nights as you play.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《MONOPOLY®》（地产大亨）带着全新外观和更棒的游戏体验回来啦。购买、销售，交易地产，让你的帝国在 3D 动画城市中不断壮大，在游玩期间，它还会从阳光明媚的白天转换为狂风暴雨的黑夜。

games.title: Monopoly Madness
games.shortDescription: Rediscover the MONOPOLY you love in a way you’ve never seen before. With shorter rounds, race other players across the chaotic streets of Monopoly City, collect resources, buy and upgrade properties, mess with your opponents and avoid their tricks to win the race for riches. This is Madness!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 用你前所未见的方式重新探索你挚爱的 MONOPOLY®。现在每一回合的时长更短了，你可以尽情穿越 Monopoly Town 混乱的街道，收集资源，购买并升级地产，给对手制造混乱，避开他们的诡计，在金钱的较量中取胜。这就是狂乐的派对！

games.title: MONOPOLY Madness
games.shortDescription: Rediscover the MONOPOLY you love in a way you’ve never seen before. This is Madness!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 透过前所未见的方式重新探索你喜爱的《MONOPOLY®》。这就是《MONOPOLY 地产大享：疯乐 》！

games.title: Monster Sanctuary
games.shortDescription:
Monster taming meets metroidvania. Collect, train and battle monsters in a lovely side-view pixel world.

Choose your spectral familiar and follow in your ancestors’ footsteps to become a Monster keeper and save the Monster Sanctuary.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
Monster taming meets metroidvania. Collect, train and battle monsters in a lovely side-view pixel world.

Choose your spectral familiar and follow in your ancestors’ footsteps to become a Monster keeper and save the Monster Sanctuary.

games.title: Monster Sanctuary (Windows Version)
games.shortDescription:
Master the Monster Sanctuary!

Delve deep into the Metroidvania inspired world of Monster Sanctuary, explore the expansive lands and call upon your monsters to lend their aid in and out of combat! Use their unique skills to fly, ride and brute force your way through environmental puzzles and precise platforming! The world is yours to traverse as you see fit, are you ready to take on the Sanctuary?
games.shortDescriptionZh:
