games.title: Monster Train 2
games.shortDescription: Monster Train returns with all new clans, new enemy factions, new challenges, new modes and more! Defend your Pyre in the classic three-tiered, vertical gameplay that made the original roguelike deckbuilder a hit.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《怪物火车》续作归来，准备好迎接全新氏族、敌对派系、挑战、模式以及更多！感受享誉盛名的roguelike牌组构建机制，在经典的三层式纵向战场中保护自己的薪火。

games.title: Monsters are Coming!
games.shortDescription: Beware, Monsters are Coming! In this Tower-Survivor rogue-lite, you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes. Gather resources, fortify defences, and boost potential through enhanced player progression. Will you reach the Ark?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 打起十二分精神——魔怪来袭！在这款塔防生存轻度 rogue 游戏中，你的任务便是抵御凶残怪潮，保护一座时刻移动的城市。搜集资源、巩固防御，通过角色成长系统不断提升实力，你是否能抵达那座拱门？

games.title: Moonlighter
games.shortDescription: Moonlighter is an Action RPG with rogue-lite elements that demonstrates two sides of the coin – revealing everyday routines of Will, an adventurous shopkeeper that secretly dreams of becoming a hero.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
每一次冒险都会有所收获
在一次考古挖掘中，发现了一组古门。不久，人们便发现这些古道通往不同的王国和维界。挖掘遗址附近，还发现了一座叫尼罗卡的商业小村庄 — 为英勇无畏的冒险家呈献不可估量的宝藏。

《夜勤人》(Moonlighter) 是一款采用大量类 rogue 元素的动作角色扮演游戏，展现了威尔的日常生活。威尔是个敢作敢为的掌柜，做着一个英雄梦。

看店
在尼罗卡村做生意时，你可以甩卖商品、精心定价、管理金库、招募售货员和升级商店。不过你得小心谨慎 — 有些人很阴险，可能会偷窃你的贵重商品！

有格调地战斗
打败各种敌人和 boss，揭开艰难而深奥的战斗机制。战斗的深奥程度取决于武器、天时、地利、敌人和商品的辅助效果。自如地培养自己专属的战斗风格。

重振村庄
在重振这座小商业村庄的繁荣时，了解其他村民。协助建立新业务，看着业务在这尼罗卡的田园村庄逐渐发展。

games.title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
games.shortDescription: Experience an action-RPG with roguelike elements where you live the double life of an adventurer and a merchant. Dive into vibrant dimensions to fight enemies, gather loot, and manage your backpack. Rebuild your shop and turn profits into gear for the next adventure!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 体验这款融合 Roguelike 元素的动作角色扮演游戏，同时扮演冒险家与商人，尽享双重人生。踏入异彩纷呈的多维世界，迎战敌人、搜刮战利品、打理行囊，重振你的店铺，把利润化为装备，奔赴下一场冒险！

games.title: Mortal Kombat™ 1
games.shortDescription: Discover a reborn Mortal Kombat™ Universe created by the Fire God Liu Kang. Mortal Kombat™ 1 ushers in a new era of the iconic franchise with a new fighting system, game modes, and fatalities!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 探索由火神刘康打造，并重生后的“真人快打™”宇宙。《真人快打™ 1》将以全新的战斗系统、游戏模式和必杀终结，开启本系列的新纪元！

games.title: MOTORSLICE
games.shortDescription:
Parkour through the ruins of a megastructure, climb massive bosses, and hunt down every construction equipment in this slice of life action-adventure with immaculate vibes.

Play as a girl named ‘P’, and use everything at her disposal to escape from deadly traps. Run, climb, slide, crouch, wall run, perform stunts, and even use your chainsaw to cross impossible distances.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在这款氛围绝佳的生活风动作冒险游戏中，在充满各种巨型建筑的废墟间进行跑酷，攀爬巨型机械头目，并猎杀所有建筑设备。

扮演一位名叫“P”的女孩，利用手头的一切来逃离致命陷阱。奔跑、攀爬、滑行、蹲伏、贴墙跑、表演特技，甚至使用电锯跨越看似无法逾越的距离。

games.title: Moving Out 2
games.shortDescription: Moving Out is back and wackier than ever, and now with ONLINE PLAY! Return to Packmore and use your moving skills across brand new dimensions and some old favourites. Help rebuild Smooth Moves and become an all-star F.A.R.T. (Furniture Arrangement & Relocation Technician)!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Moving Out》回来了，并且比之前更古怪，现在还有在线游玩模式！回到 Packmore 利用您的搬家技术在全新的维度与一些旧爱中穿梭。协助重建 Smooth Moves 并成为 F.A.R.T. (家具规划与搬家师傅) 的明星员工！

games.title: My Friend Peppa Pig
games.shortDescription: Start a fun-filled adventure with Peppa Pig. Create your style, meet favorite characters, and play in Peppa’s world. It’s just like being in the TV show!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 与小猪佩奇踏上乐趣无穷的冒险之旅。打造你的风格、结交你最喜爱的角色，并在佩奇的世界中尽情游玩。简直就像是踏入了电视节目一样！

games.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT
games.shortDescription: Dive into the legends of the Far East in NARAKA: BLADEPOINT; team up with friends in fast-paced melee fights for a Battle Royale experience unlike any other. Find your playstyle with a varied cast of heroes with unique skills. More than 20 million players have already joined the fray, play free now!
games.shortDescriptionZh: Dive into the legends of the Far East in NARAKA: BLADEPOINT; team up with friends in fast-paced melee fights for a Battle Royale experience unlike any other. Find your playstyle with a varied cast of heroes with unique skills. More than 20 million players have already joined the fray, play free now!

games.title: Need for Speed Rivals
games.shortDescription: Erase the line between single player and multiplayer in this street-racing rivalry between Cops and Racers. Seamlessly join a world where your friends are already racing and chasing
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这场警察与车手之间的街头竞速对决模糊了单人游戏与多人游戏间的界限。无缝加入您的好友已经开始比赛和追逐的世界。

games.title: Need for Speed™
games.shortDescription:
Become an icon of urban car culture in Need for Speed™, Race in and explore a huge nocturnal open world, express your style with authentic car customization and become immersed in a story staring real world legends like Magnus Walker and Ken Block.

Need For Speed is an online game. 
An Internet connection speed of 192 Kbps or higher is required.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在Need for Speed™ 中成为成为都市汽车文化的代表。竞速并探索广阔的夜间开放世界，用真实的汽车改装来表现您的风格，并沉浸于由现实世界的传奇Magnus Walker和Ken Block主演的故事。 

Need for Speed是网络游戏。
需要192 Kbps或更高的网络连接速度。

games.title: Need for Speed™ Heat
games.shortDescription: Hustle by day and risk it all at night in Need for Speed™ Heat, a thrilling race experience that pits you against a city’s rogue police force as you battle your way into street racing’s elite.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Need for Speed™ Heat》让您全天候制霸街头，这是一次惊心动魄的赛车体验，你将在与城市腐败警察的对抗中，一路披荆斩棘，成为街头赛车的精英。

games.title: Need for Speed™ Hot Pursuit Remastered
games.shortDescription: Feel the thrill of the chase and the rush of escape behind the wheels of the world’s hottest high-performance cars in Need for Speed™ Hot Pursuit Remastered. Unleash a savage sense of speed in heart-pumping, socially competitive racing experience.
games.titleZh: 极品飞车：热力追踪重制版
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《极品飞车：热力追踪》重制版让你感受追逐的快感和脱逃的乐趣，从驾驶全世界最热门的高性能跑车中感受到狂野的速度激情。

metacritic.title: Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit Remastered

games.title: Need for Speed™ Payback
games.shortDescription: Need for Speed™, one of the world’s bestselling video game franchises, returns with a vengeance in the new action-driving blockbuster, Need for Speed Payback.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Need for Speed™》是全球最畅销的游戏系列之一，《Need for Speed Payback》是该系列的最新大作，游戏以复仇为主题，场面火爆。

games.title: Need for Speed™ Unbound
games.shortDescription: Race against time, outsmart the cops, and take on weekly qualifiers to reach The Grand, Lakeshore's ultimate street racing challenge. Pack your garage with precision-tuned, custom rides and light up the streets with your style and a vibrant global soundtrack.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 与时间赛跑，智胜警察，参加每周排位赛，才能参加盛大赛事：Lakeshore 终极街头挑战大赛。用精准调校的定制赛车装满您的车库，并用您的风格和充满活力的全球音乐点亮街道。

games.title: New MONOPOLY®
games.shortDescription: NEW MONOPOLY® is back with a fresh look and an improved game experience. Buy, sell, trade properties, and grow your empire in a fully animated 3D city that transforms from sunlit days to stormy nights as you play.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《NEW MONOPOLY®》带着全新外观和更棒的游戏体验回来啦。购买、销售，交易地产，让你的帝国在 3D 动画城市中不断壮大，在游玩期间，它还会从阳光明媚的白天转换为狂风暴雨的黑夜。

games.title: New Super Lucky's Tale
games.shortDescription: Jump, burrow, and tail swipe your way to victory in this love letter to classic 3D platformers!
games.shortDescriptionZh: Jump, burrow, and tail swipe your way to victory in this love letter to classic 3D platformers!

games.title: NHL® 25 Xbox Series X|S
games.shortDescription: EA SPORTS™ NHL® 25 is powered by ICE-Q, a new gameplay intelligence system that gives you the time and space to control every inch of the ice. Experience true hockey intelligence.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《EA SPORTS™ NHL 25》基于全新智能游戏玩法系统 ICE-Q 打造，赋予您控制每一寸冰球场的时间与空间。体验确凿无疑的冰球智能吧。

games.shortDescriptionZh:
由ATLUS倾情奉上，青春RPG系列游戏最新作《P5R》再度登场。主角是因为某些原因转学至“东京”的高中的少年。白天是普通的高中生。放学后则化身为盗取堕落大人们扭曲欲望的怪盗。
个性丰富的同伴们渴望的“改变社会”会迎来怎样的结局…？
收录《女神异闻录５ 皇家版》中总计超过40个的付费DLC，游戏一开始就可以游玩！

games.title: Phoenix Point
games.shortDescription: Phoenix Point puts the player in the midst of a desperate fight to take back the earth from a mutating, alien menace. Featuring turn-based, tactical combat and resource management on a global scale, Phoenix Point offers endless replayability and a brutal challenge.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《Phoenix Point》将玩家置于殊死的战斗中，目标是从变异的外星威胁势力手中夺回地球。《Phoenix Point》的地图程序化生成，回合制战术战斗和全球范围内的资源管理，将带来无限的可重玩性，为玩家提供严酷的挑战。

在一场全球性的环境灾难后，潘多拉病毒现世，造成包括人类在内的大量生物发生可怕的变异。由于无法阻止病毒的蔓延，多数人类文明已灰飞烟灭，地球上只留存有较小的孤立飞地，被主体部分和广阔的土地分隔开来。Phoenix Project 是应对全球灾难的古老保障项目，也是团结人类、夺回地球的唯一希望。

前往在 Phoenix Point 的项目基地，领导 Phoenix Project 的开展。研发新科技和工艺，计划行动，建立联盟，团结全球，或者毁灭你的敌手。拯救星球并重建文明？这一切都取决于你，但外星威胁可能会远比你看到的多。

* 变异外星人的威胁：直面不断变

games.title: Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare
games.shortDescription:
Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare digs into the trenches with an explosive new Co-op and Multiplayer action experience. Blast zombies and plants across a mine-blowing world that delivers the depth of a traditional online shooter blended with the refreshing humor of Plants vs. Zombies. 
KEY FEATURES:
24-player multiplayer 
4-player online co-op                      Exclusive Modes for Xbox One

KEY FEATURES:

4-player online co-op                      Exclusive Modes for Xbox One

games.title: Plants vs. Zombies: Battle for Neighborville™
games.shortDescription: Kick some grass in Plants vs. Zombies Battle for Neighborville, the wackiest shooter yet! Unearth 20 fully customizable character classes at launch in one social region, three free-roam regions, one PvE mode, six PvP modes, including Battle Arena, and more!
games.titleZh: 植物大战僵尸: 和睦小镇保卫战
games.shortDescriptionZh: 到《植物大战僵尸: 和睦小镇保卫战》中大显身手吧，这里有最疯狂的射手！您可在一个公共地区，三个可自由移动的地区，一个玩家对战环境模式，以及六种玩家对战模式中使用 20 个可定制的角色类别，包括在 Battle Arena 和其他地区也可使用。

metacritic.title: Plants vs. Zombies: Battle for Neighborville

games.title: Plants vs. Zombies™ Garden Warfare 2
games.shortDescription: The battle for Suburbia grows to crazy new heights in Plants vs. Zombies™ Garden Warfare 2! In this hilarious, action-packed shooter, you can attack as the plants or defend as the zombies in the all-new 24-player Herbal Assault mode, or choose your side in 4-player co-op or Solo Play to sow the seeds of victory!
games.titleZh: 植物大战僵尸：花园战争2
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《Plants vs. Zombies™ Garden Warfare 2》中，争夺郊区的战斗愈演愈烈！在这款热闹欢快、动作火爆的射击游戏中，您可以在全新的24人草药袭击(Herbal Assault)模式中作为植物进行攻击或作为僵尸进行防守，也可以在4人合作或单人游戏中选择您的阵营并播下胜利的种子！

games.title: PlateUp!
games.shortDescription: Cook and serve your dishes, design and decorate your restaurants, and expand your culinary kingdom with new unlocks, abilities and dishes in procedurally-generated locations. Classic cooking action with permanent roguelite progression. Hire your friends - or do it all yourself!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 烹饪并端上菜肴，设计并装饰餐厅，在程序生成的各个地点获取新的解锁、技能以及菜肴从而拓展你的美食王国。永久Roguelite进行模式和经典烹饪游戏的结合。雇佣好友 - 或者自己搞定一切！

games.title: Police Simulator: Patrol Officers
games.shortDescription: POLICE SIMULATOR: PATROL OFFICERS offers a Simulation Mode for veteran players looking for the most authentic experience, as well as a Casual Mode for players who want a more relaxing patrol around the streets of Brighton.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《POLICE SIMULATOR:PATROL OFFICERS》提供模拟和休闲两种模式：模拟模式适合那些追求最真实体验的经验丰富的玩家；休闲模式则适合那些想在Brighton街头更轻松地巡逻的玩家。

games.title: PowerWash Simulator 2
games.shortDescription: PowerWash Simulator is back, bubbling with fresh locations, soap-erior equipment and splashy features. Effortlessly transform soiled surroundings into clean, serene scenes, solo or with pals. Satisfaction is a spray away!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《冲就完事模拟器》强势回归，带来崭新地点、登峰“皂”极的清洁设备和亮点四射的特色玩法。无论是独自工作还是与小伙伴共事，都能轻松将脏污环境变得清爽宜人。想获得满足感？洒洒水啦！

games.title: Prey
games.shortDescription: In Prey, you are the subject of an experiment but things have gone terribly wrong. Your ability to survive a hostile alien onslaught will depend on your wits, weapons, and newfound abilities.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《Prey》的世界，你是一項實驗的受試對象，但是情況突然生變。你必須憑著智慧、武器和新獲得的能力，在外星生物發動的惡意突擊中生存下來。

games.title: Prey
games.shortDescription: In Prey, you are the subject of an experiment but things have gone terribly wrong. Your ability to survive a hostile alien onslaught will depend on your wits, weapons, and newfound abilities.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《Prey》中，你是某一个实验的对象，但有个环节却严重出错。如果想在恶意满盈的外星生物环伺攻击中存活下来，就必须全仰赖你的智慧、武器和新发现的能力。

games.title: Prince of Persia The Lost Crown
games.shortDescription: Dash into a stylish and thrilling action-adventure platformer set in a mythological Persian world where the boundaries of time and space are yours to manipulate. Play as Sargon and evolve from sword-wielding prodigy to extraordinary legend as you master acrobatic combat and unlock new Time Powers and unique super abilities.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款风格奇特、惊险刺激的动作冒险平台游戏中，你将踏入奇幻的波斯世界，一手操控时与空的界限。扮演萨尔贡，掌握战斗技巧，解锁全新的时之力和独特技能，从挥舞刀刃的奇才成长为传奇人物。

metacritic.title: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown

games.title: Prince of Persia The Lost Crown
games.shortDescription: Dash into a stylish and thrilling action-adventure platformer set in a mythological Persian world where the boundaries of time and space are yours to manipulate. Play as Sargon and evolve from sword-wielding prodigy to extraordinary legend as you master acrobatic combat and unlock new Time Powers and unique super abilities.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款风格奇特、惊险刺激的动作冒险平台游戏中，你将踏入奇幻的波斯世界，一手操控时与空的界限。扮演萨尔贡，掌握战斗技巧，解锁全新的时之力和独特技能，从挥舞刀刃的奇才成长为传奇人物。

metacritic.title: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown

games.title: Psychonauts
games.shortDescription: A PSYCHIC ODYSSEY THROUGH THE MINDS OF MISFITS, MONSTERS, AND MADMEN
games.shortDescriptionZh: A PSYCHIC ODYSSEY THROUGH THE MINDS OF MISFITS, MONSTERS, AND MADMEN.

games.title: Psychonauts (Windows 10)
games.shortDescription: A PSYCHIC ODYSSEY THROUGH THE MINDS OF MISFITS, MONSTERS, AND MADMEN
games.shortDescriptionZh: A PSYCHIC ODYSSEY THROUGH THE MINDS OF MISFITS, MONSTERS, AND MADMEN

games.title: Psychonauts 2
games.shortDescription: Combining quirky missions and mysterious conspiracies, Psychonauts 2 is a platform-adventure game with cinematic style and tons of customizable psychic powers.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《意航员 2》是一款平台游戏，在这段充满离奇任务和诡秘阴谋的冒险中，玩家将能欣赏到电影风格的画面并体验众多可定制的超能力。

games.title: Quake
games.shortDescription: Developed by the award-winning id Software, Quake® is the ground-breaking, original dark fantasy first-person shooter that inspires today’s retro-style FPS games. Now, experience the authentic, updated, and visually enhanced version of the original.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Quake®由屡获殊荣的id Software开发，这是一款极具开创性的原创黑暗幻想第一人称射击游戏，启发了现今的许多复古风格第一人称射击游戏。事不宜迟，快来游玩这款原创游戏，体验原汁原味的乐趣，同时享受更新内容和视觉增强效果。

games.title: Quake 4
games.shortDescription: As part of the elite Rhino Squad, you must spearhead Earth’s military invasion of a hostile alien homeworld. But, in this desperate war for humanity’s survival against an unrelenting enemy, you may discover that the only way to defeat them...is to become one of them.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在载誉无数的id Software和Raven Software打造的劲爆FPS中，身先士卒，率军杀入外星世界。

games.title: Quake II
games.shortDescription: You are humanity’s last hope to stop the Strogg, a hostile alien race waging war against Earth. Play this military sci-fi FPS, now enhanced for modern platforms and feature-complete with all-new campaign content, Quake II 64, online multiplayer and co-op support, and more.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 邪恶的外星种族Strogg正在攻打地球，而你是人类阻止他们的最后希望。这款军事科幻第一人称射击游戏现已经过优化，适配现代游戏平台，并补齐了任天堂64版《Quake II 》战役内容、加入在线多人游戏和合作模式的支持，以及诸多内容。

games.title: Quake III Arena
games.shortDescription: The greatest warriors of all time and space have been summoned to battle for the amusement of an ancient alien race. Wield a variety of guns and power-ups as you fight for glory against ruthless combatants in this fast-paced single-player and multiplayer FPS.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 古往今来的最强勇者们应召参战，为一个古老的外星种族带来娱乐。这款快节奏的第一人称多人射击游戏需要玩家掌握各种枪械和道具，与无情的对手作战，争夺荣誉。

games.title: Quantum Break
games.shortDescription: A blockbuster game with time-amplified action and a suspenseful storyline brought to life in a way never done before by fusing gameplay and a gripping live action show. Time itself becomes fractured in a time travel experiment, Jack Joyce fights the secretive Monarch Solutions to put things right before it’s too late. The actions you take and choices you make shape your experience in the show, creating a new and unique entertainment experience.
games.shortDescriptionZh: A blockbuster game with time-amplified action and a suspenseful storyline brought to life in a way never done before by fusing gameplay and a gripping live action show. Time itself becomes fractured in a time travel experiment, Jack Joyce fights the secretive Monarch Solutions to put things right before it’s too late. The actions you take and choices you make shape your experience in the show, creating a new and unique entertainment experience.

games.title: Quantum Break
games.shortDescription: From Remedy Entertainment, the masters of cinematic action games such as Max Payne and Alan Wake, comes Quantum Break, a time-amplified suspenseful blockbuster. The Quantum Break experience is part game, part live action show—where decisions in one dramatically affect the other.
games.shortDescriptionZh: From Remedy Entertainment, the masters of cinematic action games such as Max Payne and Alan Wake, comes Quantum Break, a time-amplified suspenseful blockbuster. The Quantum Break experience is part game, part live action show—where decisions in one dramatically affect the other.

games.title: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
games.shortDescription: Command the checkpoint in a collapsing city. Screen survivors, manage scarce resources, and hold back the undead. Every choice matters and one mistake could unleash the plague beyond your walls.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在一座濒临崩溃的城市里指挥检查站，筛查幸存者，管理紧缺资源，抵御不死者的入侵。你的每一个决定都举足轻重，一招不慎就可能让瘟疫肆虐入侵。

games.title: Rabbids Invasion : The Interactive TV Show
games.shortDescription:
RABBIDS® INVASION, the kids’ hit animated TV show, is now a video game!
Kids can watch a selection of 20 episodes to play and interact with the Rabbids.

Over 400 Wacky Full-Motion Activities
Have a virtual egg battle with the Rabbids, try to match their poses, scream out the iconic “bwaah”…

Play With Family and Friends 
Become the champion of the episode or ally with the other players to unlock new content!

Augmented Reality
Interact and dance with the Rabbids in your own living room!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在全球廣受喜愛的熱門電視動畫影集 Rabbids Invasion【瘋狂兔子】，現正成為可互動遊玩的電玩遊戲！藉由體感操作的遊戲方式，小孩們現在可在家裡客廳遊玩動畫影集的精選內容、並且在多人模式中經歷各式滑稽搞笑的挑戰，與親朋好友一同以全新的方式共度狂歡時光。

games.title: Rabbids®: Party of Legends
games.shortDescription: Embark on a legendary journey with the Rabbids in this hilarious party game! Join them on an incredible quest, filled with hilarious moments and colorful characters. Gather with friends and family and enjoy a multitude of ridiculously fun mini-games in the most epic Rabbids party yet.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在這款滑稽逗趣的派對遊戲中，與瘋狂兔子一起踏上傳奇旅程！和他們一同展開難以置信的任務，其中滿是歡樂時刻與各式角色。與親朋好友齊聚一堂，在至今最生猛的瘋狂兔子派對中，暢玩多款荒謬逗趣的小遊戲吧！

games.title: Rabbids®: Party of Legends
games.shortDescription: Embark on a legendary journey with the Rabbids in this hilarious party game! Join them on an incredible quest, filled with hilarious moments and colorful characters. Gather with friends and family and enjoy a multitude of ridiculously fun mini-games in the most epic Rabbids party yet.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款滑稽逗趣的派对游戏中，与疯狂兔子一起踏上传奇旅程！和他们一同展开难以置信的任务，其中满是欢乐时刻与各式角色。与亲朋好友齐聚一堂，在至今最生猛的疯狂兔子派对中，畅玩多款荒谬逗趣的小游戏吧！

games.title: RAGE
games.shortDescription: Rule the Wasteland in RAGE - the new title from the Inventors of the First-Person Shooter, id Software.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Rule the Wasteland in RAGE - the new title from the Inventors of the First-Person Shooter, id Software.

games.title: RAGE 2
games.shortDescription: Dive headfirst into a dystopian world devoid of society, law, and order. RAGE 2 brings together two studio powerhouses – Avalanche Studios, masters of open world insanity, and id Software, creators of the first-person shooter – to deliver a carnival of carnage where you can go anywhere, shoot anything, and explode everything.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 一頭衝進社會法治崩解的反烏托邦世界。《RAGE 2》由超狂開放世界霸主Avalanche Studios、第一人稱射擊遊戲創作團隊id Software兩大傳奇工作室聯手打造，給你嘉年華式的血腥狂殺，路隨你走，槍隨你用，東西隨你炸。

games.title: RAGE 2 (PC)
games.shortDescription: Dive headfirst into a dystopian world devoid of society, law, and order. RAGE 2 brings together two studio powerhouses – Avalanche Studios, masters of open world insanity, and id Software, creators of the first-person shooter – to deliver a carnival of carnage where you can go anywhere, shoot anything, and explode everything.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 一头扎进一个没有社会、法律和秩序的反乌托邦世界。《RAGE 2》由两大超强实力游戏工作室——开放世界狂想大师Avalanche Studios和第一人称射击游戏创作团队id Software联手打造，让你尽享屠戮的狂欢。在这里，你可以去任何地方、射杀和引爆任何东西。

games.title: Rare Replay
games.shortDescription: Celebrate Rare’s 30th Anniversary with a jaw-dropping collection of 30 iconic games, lovingly presented for Xbox One. Tackle snapshot challenges and enjoy exclusive bonus features.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 庆祝 Rare 工作室成立三十周年纪念，令人惊喜的 30 个著名游戏合集在 Xbox One 上呈现给您。赶快来接受快速挑战和享受专属的功能奖励。

games.title: Rayman Legends
games.shortDescription: The Glade of Dreams is in trouble once again! The nightmares multiplied and spread, creating new monsters even more terrifying than before!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 碎夢林地再次陷入了危機！在英雄們沉睡的這100年間，噩夢開始蔓延並繁衍，甚至創造出了比以前更加恐怖的怪獸！這些來自傳說的生物…龍，巨型蟾蜍，海怪，還有邪惡的摔角手。在小精靈莫菲的幫助下，雷曼和格羅伯從睡夢中醒來共同對抗噩夢的入侵並拯救被抓走的小小們！ 健康遊戲忠告 抵制不良遊戲，拒絕盜版遊戲。 注意自我保護，謹防受騙上當。 適度遊戲益腦，沉迷遊戲傷身。 合理安排時間，享受健康生活。

games.title: RAYMAN LEGENDS
games.shortDescription: The Glade of Dreams is in trouble once again! During a 100-year nap, the nightmares multiplied and spread, creating new monsters even more terrifying than before! These creatures are the stuff of legend… Dragons, giant toads, sea monsters, and even evil luchadores. With the help of Murfy, Rayman and Globox awake and must now help fight these nightmares and save the Teensies!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 一天，当雷曼、格罗普斯和小小们在魔法森林中游荡时，他们偶然发现了满是美丽画卷的一顶帐篷。他们仔细查看，发现这些画卷似乎在讲述一个个神秘世界的故事。正当他们全神贯注地欣赏着一副中世纪大陆的画作时，那幅画突然将他们吸了进去并带他们进入了一个全新的世界...而我们的旅程，也随之开始。小队成员必须在各个世界奔跑、跳跃甚至战斗来化险为夷，最后才能发现每一幅传奇画卷背后的秘密。

games.title: ReCore
games.shortDescription:
From legendary creator Keiji Inafune and the makers of Metroid Prime comes the “ReCore Definitive Edition”, an action-adventure masterfully crafted for a new generation.
 
As one of the last remaining humans, forge friendships with courageous robotic companions and lead them on an epic adventure through a mysterious dynamic world.
 
Includes the new “Eye of Obsidian” adventure and “T8-NK” Corebot frame!
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在传奇创作者稻船敬二与《银河战士》制作者的联手合作下，为新生代玩家精心打造的动作冒险游戏“核心重铸: 最终版”就此诞生。
 
身为仅存的人类之一，与勇敢的机器人伙伴并肩战斗，在这神秘的多变世界中展开史诗级冒险之旅。
 
包括全新“黑曜石之眼”冒险和“T8-NK”核心机器人模组！

games.title: Redfall
games.shortDescription: The town of Redfall is under siege by a legion of vampires who have cut the island off from the outside world. Trapped with a handful of survivors, slay alone or squad up in open-world FPS action.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 一座名为红霞岛的小镇日前遭到了一群血族的围攻，他们切断了小岛与外界的联系。你将与少数幸存者一起受困于此，在这款开放世界第一人称射击动作游戏中，单打独斗或组队联手吧。

games.title: Relic Hunters Legend
games.shortDescription: A Top-Down Shooter/Looter RPG with a touching story inspired by JRPG classics. Shoot enemies, get loot, and customize your characters. Multiple endgame systems and over 100 hours of play await you solo or up to 4-player co-op!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 一款受经典 JRPG 启发的 [b]俯视角射击/Looter RPG，拥有感人至深的故事。射击敌人、收集战利品并自定义角色。多种终局内容和 100 多小时的游戏体验，支持 [b]单人或最多 4 人合作游玩！

games.title: Relooted
games.shortDescription: Reclaim real African artifacts from Western museums in this Africanfuturist heist game. Recruit crew members, plan escape routes, acquire the precious cargo, and bounce out of the joint as fast as you can.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 非洲未来主义劫盗来袭！潜入西方博物馆，夺回失落的非洲瑰宝。招募各路奇才，规划完美路线，夺取无价文物，然后火速撤离！

games.title: REMATCH
games.shortDescription:
Rematch is an online multiplayer football game. 
Control one player on your team and compete in fast-paced 5v5 matches from an immersive third-person perspective. Team up with your friends and join the action!
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《Rematch》是一款多人在线足球游戏。
从沉浸式第三人称的视角中，控制队伍中的一名球员，并投入到激烈、快节奏的5v5竞赛中。与好友一起组队上场吧！

games.title: Remnant II® - Standard Edition
games.shortDescription: Remnant II® pits survivors of humanity against new deadly creatures and god-like bosses across terrifying worlds. Play solo or co-op with two other friends to explore the depths of the unknown to stop an evil from destroying reality itself.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Remnant II®》是畅销游戏《Remnant: From the Ashes》的续作。在本作中，人类幸存者将再次深陷可怕的世界，对抗新的邪恶怪物和神一般的敌人头目。

games.title: REPLACED
games.shortDescription: Follow R.E.A.C.H., an AI trapped in a human body, on a cinematic adventure through an alternate 1980s America. Explore an atmospheric cyberpunk world full of high-stakes action wrapped in a unique 2.5D pixel art style.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 跟随受困于人类躯壳的人工智能——R.E.A.C.H.，在架空的80年代美国，开启一场电影般的冒险之旅。沉浸式探索光怪陆离的赛博朋克世界，在独特的2.5D像素艺术风格中，体验紧张刺激的高风险动作场面。

games.title: RESIDENT EVIL 2
games.shortDescription:
A deadly virus engulfs the residents of Raccoon City in September of 1998, plunging the city into chaos as flesh eating zombies roam the streets for survivors.

An unparalleled adrenaline rush, gripping storyline, and unimaginable horrors await you.

Witness the return of Resident Evil 2.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
一切都凌驾于玩家的想像之上。

一场生化灾难於1998年9月袭击了浣熊市，从残害幸存者的丧尸地狱中生还吧。
无尽的刺激、引人入胜的故事和无法想像的恐怖正在等候你。
见证系列首屈一指的杰作──《Resident Evil 2》的重生吧。

別被这场惨剧吞噬。

games.title: RESIDENT EVIL 3 for Windows
games.shortDescription: Jill Valentine is one of the last remaining people in Raccoon City to witness the atrocities Umbrella performed. To stop her, Umbrella unleashes their ultimate secret weapon; Nemesis!
games.shortDescriptionZh:
不管逃到哪里也会被追至绝路。

浣熊市发生突如其来的生物灾害，更为危险的武器被投入到这个逐渐毁灭的城镇中……

多重的危机，九死一生的惊险动作和重新构建的逃生剧情，一切超乎你的想象。

你能逃离这片绝望吗？

games.title: RESIDENT EVIL 3 for Xbox
games.shortDescription: Jill Valentine is one of the last remaining people in Raccoon City to witness the atrocities Umbrella performed. To stop her, Umbrella unleashes their ultimate secret weapon; Nemesis!
games.shortDescriptionZh:
不管逃到哪里也会被追至绝路。

浣熊市发生突如其来的生物灾害，更为危险的武器被投入到这个逐渐毁灭的城镇中……

多重的危机，九死一生的惊险动作和重新构建的逃生剧情，一切超乎你的想象。

你能逃离这片绝望吗？

games.title: RESIDENT EVIL 7 biohazard
games.shortDescription: Fear and isolation seep through the walls of an abandoned southern farmhouse. "7" marks a new beginning for survival horror with the “Isolated View” of the visceral new first-person perspective. Powered by the RE Engine, horror reaches incredible heights of immersion as players enter a terrifyingly new world of fear as they fight to survive.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 于美国南部的一间被废置的农舍，腐烂的墙身渗透着一股恐怖及孤独的氛围。 「7」标志着全新的恐怖求生体验，以及玩家视觉切换为更骇人的「隔离视觉」模式。有赖RE工程部的努力，恐怖的写实感提升至一个全新的境界。让你进入恐怖求生的新世界。

games.title: RESIDENT EVIL 7 biohazard
games.publisher: 株式会社 カプコン
games.shortDescription: Fear and isolation seep through the walls of an abandoned southern farmhouse. "7" marks a new beginning for survival horror with the “Isolated View” of the visceral new first-person perspective. Powered by the RE Engine, horror reaches incredible heights of immersion as players enter a terrifyingly new world of fear as they fight to survive.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 于美国南部的一间被废置的农舍，腐烂的墙身渗透着一股恐怖及孤独的氛围。 「7」标志着全新的恐怖求生体验，以及玩家视觉切换为更骇人的「隔离视觉」模式。有赖RE工程部的努力，恐怖的写实感提升至一个全新的境界。让你进入恐怖求生的新世界。

games.title: Resident Evil Village
games.shortDescription: Experience survival horror like never before in the 8th major installment in the Resident Evil franchise - Resident Evil Village. With detailed graphics, intense first-person action and masterful storytelling, the terror has never felt more realistic.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在《Resident Evil》系列最新游戏中展开令人毛骨悚然的绝命拚搏。
伊森一家的平静生活因克里斯·雷德菲尔德而又陷入混乱之中，他再次身陷无法逃离的梦魇中。


这款系列第8部主要作品由日益成熟的游戏引擎“RE ENGINE”创造，将带来最新生存“动作”恐怖游戏体验。

games.title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
games.shortDescription: Embark on an original story, prequel to the award-winning games: A Plague Tale. As Sophia, journey to the Minotaur’s Island, outsmart deadly foes, unravel ancient secrets, and confront a mythical creature at the heart of a devastating curse.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 本作的原创剧情在时间线上早于获奖作品《瘟疫传说》的故事，你将化身索菲亚，前往米诺陶岛，智取强敌，揭晓古老的秘密，直面凶煞诅咒之源的神话生物。

games.title: Retro Classics
games.shortDescription: Discover timeless classics and hidden gems with Game Pass. Power up your play with community challenges, competitive leaderboards, all-new challenge modes, high-score rankings and more.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 通过 Game Pass 探索永恒的经典和隐藏的瑰宝。通过社区挑战、竞技排行榜、全新的挑战模式、高分排名等功能，提升你的游戏体验。

games.title: Return to Castle Wolfenstein
games.developer: Gray Matter Interactive, Nerve Software, Splash Damage
games.shortDescription: World War II rages and nations fall. The Nazis are twisting science and the occult into an army capable of annihilating the Allies once and for all. As US Army Ranger William “B.J.” Blazkowicz, pierce the black heart of the Third Reich and stop them...or die trying.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 第二次世界大战爆发，国家沦陷。纳粹意图通过科学和秘仪打造出一支能够一劳永逸消灭盟军的军队。你需扮演美国军队的士兵William “B.J.” Blazkowicz，执行一项深入第三帝国黑暗心脏的艰巨任务，阻止或拼死阻止他们。

games.title: Riders Republic Standard Edition
games.shortDescription: Jump into a massive multiplayer playground! Bike, ski, snowboard, or wingsuit across an open world sports paradise where the rules are yours to make or break.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 跃入广阔的多人游乐场！带上单车、双板滑雪板、滑雪板或飞鼠装，尽情探索这堪称运动天堂的开放世界，在这里，一切的规则由你制定，由你打破。

games.title: Riders Republic™
games.shortDescription: Jump into a massive multiplayer playground! Bike, ski, snowboard, or wingsuit across an open world sports paradise where the rules are yours to make or break.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 跃入广阔的多人游乐场！带上单车、双板滑雪板、滑雪板或飞鼠装，尽情探索这堪称运动天堂的开放世界，在这里，一切的规则由你制定，由你打破。

games.title: Rise of Nations: Extended Edition
games.shortDescription: Join the over 2 million Rise of Nations fans. Master 6,000 years of history, from the Ancient Age to the Information Age. What forces will you wield to lead your nation to global prominence? Trade, espionage, diplomacy…war? Whichever path you choose, you’ll discover the pulse-pounding thrill and speed of real-time strategy gaming combined with the epic scope and depth of turn-based strategy games – brought together for the first time ever in Rise of Nations.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 快加入《国家的崛起》超过 200 万个粉丝的行列。一窥从远古时代到信息时代 6,000 年的历史。您会采用哪一种策略来领导国家称霸全球呢？贸易、刺探、外交…还是战争呢？无论您选择哪一种策略，《国家的崛起》都能让您全面感受到战争血脉贲张的刺激感、实时策略游戏的速度感，以及回合制策略游戏的浩大场景和深度。

games.title: Risk: Urban Assault
games.shortDescription: Lead your troops to victory with Risk Urban Assault! In a post-apocalyptic world, rally your armies and march across some of the most famous cities around the globe. Be cunning and play strategically to defeat driven opponents. Use diplomacy, build facilities or take advantage of your commanders’ special abilities, you now have smart new ways to establish your domination!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《Risk Urban Assault》中带领你的军队走向胜利！在历经浩劫的世界里，团结军队，向全球最著名的几个城市行军。运筹帷幄，打败一众敌人。加强外交，建造设施，充分利用指挥官的特别技能，现在你可以用这些新的方法来建立自己的统治帝国！

games.title: RoadCraft
games.shortDescription: As the leader of a company specialized in restoring sites devastated by natural disasters, use your construction machinery to restart the local industry. Clear debris and faulty equipment, rebuild roads and bridges damaged by weather, and much more!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 作为一位专门应对自然灾害的重建专家，运用你的建筑机械重振当地经济。清理废墟，修复受损设备，重建被恶劣天气摧毁的道路和桥梁，还有更多任务等你完成！

games.title: Roadside Research (Game Preview)
games.shortDescription: Roadside Research is a 1 to 4 player co-op gas station simulator. Except you’re aliens. And undercover. Do very human things like restocking shelves while preparing for the invasion. Just don’t get caught.
games.titleZh: 宇宙牌加油站（游戏预览版）
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《宇宙牌加油站》是一款支持1至4名玩家合作的加油站模拟游戏。不过，你扮演的是外星人，而且还是卧底。你要一边做着人类平常的事情，比如给货架补货，一边为入侵地球做准备。千万别被人发现哦！

games.title: RoboCop: Rogue City
games.shortDescription: Become the legendary part man, part machine, all cop hero and dish out justice in Old Detroit.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 成为传奇的半人半机械英雄警察，努力为旧底特律带来正义。

games.title: Roboquest
games.shortDescription: Roboquest is a fast-paced FPS Roguelite, playable in solo or 2-player co-op. Jump into the steel shoes of a high-powered, hyper-mobile robot and fight like you’ve never fought before.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
Roboquest是一款设定在被遗弃的未来世界中的快节奏的Roguelite的第一人称射击游戏。你是个被重启的守护者机器人，已经准备好暴打一顿别的破铜烂铁！
在多变的环境中与你的朋友，或孤身一人的消灭一群又一群的致命机器人。

games.title: Rocket League®
games.shortDescription:
PLAY ROCKET LEAGUE FOR FREE!

Download and compete in the high-octane hybrid of arcade-style soccer and vehicular mayhem! Unlock items in Rocket Pass, climb the Competitive Ranks, compete in Competitive Tournaments, complete Challenges, enjoy cross-platform progression and more! The field is waiting. Take your shot!
games.shortDescriptionZh:
免費遊玩 Rocket League！

下載遊戲，在街機風格足球遊戲和車輛混戰的高效混合遊戲中進行競賽！解鎖 Rocket Pass 中的物品、攀升競賽級別、參加競技錦標賽、完成挑戰，並享受跨平台進度和更多內容！來一試身手吧！

games.title: ROUTINE
games.shortDescription: ROUTINE is a First Person Sci-Fi Horror set on an abandoned lunar base designed around an 80s vision of the future. Explore and investigate your surroundings as you survive against unknown threats.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 踏入《ROUTINE》的科幻恐怖世界，以第一人称视角探索基于80年代未来主义兴建，但如今已然废弃的月球基地。深入调查周边环境，对抗未知威胁，努力活到最后。

games.title: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
games.shortDescription: On RuneScape's forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft in this co-operative survival adventure. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can you hope to face the ferocious Dragon Queen.
games.titleZh: RuneScape: Dragonwilds 符文世界：龙之荒野
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《符文世界》被遗忘的大陆——烬落之地，龙族已然苏醒。在这款多人合作生存冒险游戏中，收集资源、建造家园、修炼技能、打造道具。唯有精通生存之道、揭开远古秘辛，才有资格直面凶残的龙之女王。

games.title: Rush: A DisneyPixar Adventure
games.shortDescription: “Rush: A Disney•Pixar Adventure,” invites families and fans of all ages to experience the worlds of six beloved Disney•Pixar films like never before. Play cooperatively and team up with characters from “The Incredibles,” “Ratatouille,” “Up,” “Cars”, “Toy Story”, and “Finding Dory” or a friend to solve puzzles and uncover hidden secrets all remastered in 4K Ultra HD and HDR.
games.shortDescriptionZh: “Rush: A Disney•Pixar Adventure”诚挚邀请大大小小的粉丝们合家同乐，以前所未有的方式，一同体验六部广受喜爱的 Disney•Pixar 电影世界。快来与《超人总动员》、《美食总动员》、《飞屋环游记》、《赛车总动员》、《玩具总动员》及《海底总动员2：多莉去哪儿》的角色们携手合作，一起在 4K Ultra HD 及 HDR 的高画质重制版画面中破解谜题，揭开隐藏的秘密。

games.title: RV There Yet?
games.shortDescription:
A co-op adventure about driving your Recreational Vehicle home. 

DRIVE HOME

You and your buddies are on your way home from a relaxing vacation but are forced to take an alternate route. Get your RV through the back country and find the exit to Route 65.

SURVIVE MABUTTS VALLEY

Not everyone who enters Mabutts Valley makes it out alive. So be sure to keep a steady flow of burgers, antidotes, and
games.shortDescriptionZh:
一次在线合作把房车开回家的冒险，简约而不简单

开车回家！

你和铁汁们假期后自驾回家，但是因为种种原因不得不改道行驶。现在你们需要驾驶房车穿越偏远地区并找到通往65号公路的出口...

活着走出沃德皮谷

不是每一个人都能从沃德皮谷活着走出来的，所以记得要保持充足供应汉堡，解毒剂，以及典中典：肾上腺素注射剂。.

玩转绞盘

熟练掌握基于物理的绞盘操作，赢得成为远程主控的资格。房车前后都配有绞盘，让你能轻松跨越、绕过或穿过大多数路障。

互帮互助

随便喝点冰啤酒，抽抽有过滤嘴的低焦香烟，但别忘了司机是很难一个人完成这趟旅程的。

一群硬核老铁

利用你找到的一切来维持房车的完整性和友谊的牢固。

games.title: Ryse: Legendary Edition
games.shortDescription: Amidst the chaos of the late Roman Empire, become soldier Marius Titus and embark on a perilous campaign to avenge the death of your family and defend the honor of Rome. In Gladiator Mode, step into the Colosseum and fight for the glory, spectacle, and entertainment of the crowds. Legendary Edition includes full Season Pass contents, three bonus maps optimized for maximum challenge in Solo mode and a new Legionary Skin.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在羅馬帝國晚期的一片混沌之中，扮演士兵馬略提圖斯冒險犯難、為滅亡的家族報仇，並保衛羅馬帝國的榮耀。在格鬥士模式中踏入大競技場，並為勝利、光榮及人民的娛樂而戰。Legendary Edition 包含完整的季票內容、3 個專為單人競計模式極限挑戰而優化的獎勵地圖，以及 1 個全新的軍團士兵造型。

games.title: Sandustry (Game Preview)
games.shortDescription: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.
games.titleZh: 沙金工业 Sandustry (游戏预览版)
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这个可以任意重塑的无垠世界探索、开发，打造复杂自动化产业链。深入挖掘，揭开远古文明留下的奥秘。在这款工厂建造游戏中，每个像素都是待开采的宝藏。学会拥抱金沙，与之为伴吧。

games.title: ScreamRide
games.shortDescription: With more than 50 events and three unique game modes, ScreamRide unleashes the power of unbounded creation, extreme destruction, and addictive gameplay.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 超過 50 個事件與三個獨特的遊戲模式，ScreamRide 釋放無限的創新、極致的破壞和令人成癮的遊戲性。

games.title: Sea of Solitude
games.shortDescription: When humans get too lonely, they turn into monsters…  Set sail across a beautiful and evolving world of darkness and light, and discover what it means to be human.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 人类如果太孤独，就会变成怪兽……启航穿梭一个美丽而不断衍变、光明与黑暗互相交织的世界，探索生而为人的意义。

games.title: Sea of Thieves: 2026 Edition
games.shortDescription: Sea of Thieves is a smash-hit pirate adventure game, offering the quintessential pirate experience of plundering lost treasures, fighting intense battles, vanquishing sea monsters and more. Dive in with this revised edition of the game, which includes access to digital bonus media.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Sea of Thieves》是一款十分受欢迎的海盗冒险游戏，带你感受最正宗的海盗生活：寻找遗失的宝藏占为己有，和各方势力战个痛快，打败深海怪物等。深度体验改版之后的游戏，包括数字版奖励内容。

games.title: Shadowrun Returns
games.shortDescription: The unique cyberpunk-meets-fantasy world of Shadowrun has gained a huge cult following since its creation over 30 years ago. Return to the world of Shadowrun, with this cult-classic turn-based tactical RPG finally ported to consoles.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 自从 30 年前《Shadowrun》首次问世以后，这个独特的赛博朋克结合奇幻的世界观，已经受到大量爱好者的支持。马上回到《Shadowrun》的世界之中，这个邪典回合制战略角色扮演游戏终于登上主机平台了。

games.title: Shadowrun Returns PC
games.shortDescription: The unique cyberpunk-meets-fantasy world of Shadowrun has gained a huge cult following since its creation over 30 years ago. Return to the world of Shadowrun, with this cult-classic turn-based tactical RPG.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 自从 30 年前《Shadowrun》首次问世以后，这个独特的赛博朋克结合奇幻的世界观，已经受到大量爱好者的支持。马上回到《Shadowrun》的世界之中，这个邪典回合制战略角色扮。

games.title: Shadowrun: Dragonfall - Director's Cut
games.shortDescription: Harebrained Schemes' biggest Shadowrun game to date, and the definitive Shadowrun RPG experience available on consoles. A standalone title with tons of new content & improvements!
games.shortDescriptionZh: Harebrained Schemes 当前旗下最新且最大的《Shadowrun》游戏，也是主机平台最棒的《Shadowrun》角色扮演游戏体验。这个能单独执行的作品包含了数不清的全新内容以及质量改善！

games.title: Shadowrun: Dragonfall - Director's Cut PC
games.shortDescription: Harebrained Schemes' biggest Shadowrun game to date, and the definitive Shadowrun RPG experience. A standalone title with tons of new content & improvements!
games.shortDescriptionZh: Harebrained Schemes 当前旗下最新且最大的《Shadowrun》游戏，也最棒的《Shadowrun》角色扮演游戏体验。这个能单独执行的作品包含了数不清的全新内容以及质量改善！

games.title: Shadowrun: Hong Kong - Extended Edition
games.shortDescription: Shadowrun: Hong Kong - Extended Edition is the capstone title in Harebrained Schemes' Shadowrun series - and includes the all-new, 6+ hr Shadows of Hong Kong Bonus Campaign.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Shadowrun: Hong Kong - Extended Edition》是 Harebrained Schemes 的《Shadowrun》系列作的顶点。其中包含了全新且超过 6 小时的《Shadows of Hong Kong》额外战役。

games.title: Shadowrun: Hong Kong - Extended Edition PC
games.shortDescription: Shadowrun: Hong Kong - Extended Edition is the capstone title in Harebrained Schemes' Shadowrun series - and includes the all-new, 6+ hr Shadows of Hong Kong Bonus Campaign.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Shadowrun: Hong Kong - Extended Edition》是 Harebrained Schemes 的《Shadowrun》系列作的顶点。其中包含了全新且超过 6 小时的《Shadows of Hong Kong》额外战役。

games.title: Shelldiver
games.shortDescription: Take a deep breath and dive right into this cozy incremental game about a senior turtle trying to start a business selling jellyfish. Upgrade your equipment, explore biomes, and help your turtly village!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 深吸一口气……欢迎潜入这款温馨的增量游戏！你将扮演一只准备经营水母小店的老龟，升级装备、探索各类生物群落，并为你的龟龟村出一份力！

games.title: Shift At Midnight
games.shortDescription: An online co-op detective horror for up to 3 players. Work together across randomly generated shifts to investigate your customers, as some are only pretending to be human. Make one mistake, and you’ll be forced to board up, set traps, and hide.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 一款支持最多 3 名玩家联机的合作侦探恐怖游戏。在随机生成的班次中，玩家需携手合作，调查前来的顾客。当心，并不是所有的顾客都是人类。一旦犯错，你们就得被迫封堵门窗、设置陷阱并躲藏起来。

games.title: Sifu
games.shortDescription: Sifu is a realistic third-person brawler with tight Kung Fu combat mechanics and cinematic martial arts action embarking you on a path for revenge.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Sifu》是一款拳拳到肉的第三人称动作格斗游戏，紧张刺激的功夫打斗机制 以及电影化的武术动作将引领你踏上一段复仇之旅。

games.title: Skate 3
games.shortDescription: The SKATE™ franchise is back and rolling into new territory as SKATE™ 3 heads to the brand new city of Port Carverton.  Delivering a unique co-op skateboarding experience, build your own customized skate team and change the face of the city by taking on unique team challenges, competing against rival crews online, and shredding the streets of an all-new skaters’ paradise.  SKATE™ 3 - Team Up. Throw Down.
games.shortDescriptionZh: The SKATE™ franchise is back and rolling into new territory as SKATE™ 3 heads to the brand new city of Port Carverton.  Delivering a unique co-op skateboarding experience, build your own customized skate team and change the face of the city by taking on unique team challenges, competing against rival crews online, and shredding the streets of an all-new skaters’ paradise.  SKATE™ 3 - Team Up. Throw Down.

games.title: skate. (2007)
games.shortDescription: The authentic skate experience.Some multi-player functionalities may no longer be supported.
games.shortDescriptionZh: The authentic skate experience.部分多人遊戲功能可能已不支援。

games.title: Skull and Bones
games.shortDescription: Skull and Bones is an open world naval action RPG where ship combat, build choice, and sailing skill define your pirate legend. Play solo or team up with two friends to conquer rival ships and mythical beasts in a vast ocean of up to 20 players. No one rules the seas.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 航向線上動作角色扮演遊戲《怒海戰記》生動的海上開放世界，一步步攀升為令人聞風喪膽的海盜大人物。自訂艦隊、打造獨特船隻與強大的武器，在令人熱血沸騰的海戰中稱霸四方。投身瞬息萬變的世界，享受每一季推出的新挑戰、功能與故事。

games.title: Skull and Bones
games.shortDescription: Set sail into the vibrant open world of Skull and Bones, a naval online action RPG where you rise to become the most fearsome pirate kingpin.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 航向線上動作角色扮演遊戲《怒海戰記》生動的海上開放世界，一步步攀升為令人聞風喪膽的海盜大人物。

games.title: Sledding Game
games.shortDescription: A game about sledding and hanging out with friends :)
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这个游戏的内容是几个朋友一起滑雪玩耍 :)

games.title: SMITE 2 (Game Preview)
games.shortDescription:
This game is a work in progress. It may or may not change over time or release as a final product. Purchase only if you are comfortable with the current state of the unfinished game. 

Become a god and wage war in SMITE 2, the Unreal Engine 5-powered sequel to the legendary third-person action MOBA. If you love competition, intense action, ability-driven combat, rewarding teamwork, or godly mythology, you’ll see why 40+ million players love SMITE.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
此游戏是在制品。 可能会随时间更改，亦可能会作为最终产品发布。 请仅在您熟悉此未完成游戏的当前状态下购买。 

《神之浩劫2》由Unreal Engine 5打造，在这款传奇第三人称动作MOBA续作中，玩家将化身为神，并掀起战争的狂澜。如果你热衷于激烈的竞争、火爆的动作、技能驱动的战斗、回报满满的团队合作，或者热爱神话传说，那么你就能明白为什么超过4千万玩家都喜爱《神之浩劫》

games.title: SnowRunner
games.shortDescription:
Get ready for the next-generation off-road experience! 
SnowRunner puts you in the driver’s seat of powerful vehicles as you conquer extreme open environments with the most advanced terrain simulation ever. Drive 40 vehicles from brands such as Ford, Chevrolet, and Freightliner as you leave your mark on an untamed open world.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
做好准备，迎接下一代越野体验吧！
驾驶强力载具，克服各种极端户外环境，包括泥地、湍流、雪地、冻湖……
• 高级物理引擎打造的极端户外环境
• 40种独特载具供您解锁、升级和自定义
• 超多挑战任务，探索互联世界
• 可单人游戏，也可在四人合作模式中与其他玩家畅玩

games.title: Solarpunk
games.shortDescription: Solarpunk is a survival game in a technically advanced world of floating islands. Alone or together with your friends, you can construct buildings, grow food, craft gadgets and hop on your airship to explore distant islands in the sky.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Solarpunk》是一款生存游戏，背景设定在一个科技先进、由漂浮岛屿组成的世界。你可以独自一人或与朋友一起建造建筑、种植食物、制作工具，并驾驶飞船探索遥远的天空之岛。

games.title: SOPA - Tale of the Stolen Potato
games.shortDescription: Miho steps into the pantry to fetch a potato for his grandma and falls into a magical world full of wonders. Meet quirky characters, venture through the depths of South America, and learn the importance of the things we pass along in this unforgettable emotional narrative adventure.

games.title: South of Midnight
games.shortDescription: South of Midnight is a new action-adventure from Compulsion Games. Learn an ancient weaving power, explore the Deep South mythos and confront mysterious creatures in this folktale for modern times.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《午夜以南》是由 Compulsion Games 倾力打造的一款全新动作冒险游戏。在游戏中，你将学习掌握一种古老的编织之力，并在这个现代版的民间传说中，深入探索美国南部的神秘文化，直面那些匪夷所思的生物。

games.title: South Park: The Stick of Truth
games.shortDescription: Discover the lost Stick of Truth and earn your place at the side of Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny as their new friend in a hilarious and outrageous RPG adventure.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 扮演屎蛋、凯子、阿ㄆ一ㄚˇ和阿尼的新朋友，一同踏上荒诞又疯狂的 RPG 之旅，寻回失落的真实之杖。

metacritic.title: South Park: The Stick of Truth

games.title: South Park™: The Fractured but Whole™
games.developer: Ubisoft Studio SF / South Park Studios
games.shortDescription: From the creators of South Park, Trey Parker and Matt Stone, comes South Park: The Fractured but Whole, a sequel to 2014's award-winning South Park: The Stick of Truth. Players will once again assume the role of the New Kid and join South Park favorites Stan, Kyle, Kenny and Cartman in a new hilarious and outrageous RPG adventure.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 繼 2014 年得過遊戲獎的「South Park: The Stick of Truth」後，「南方四賤客」作者 Trey Parker 與 Matt Stone 將推出全新力作「South Park: The Fractured but Whole」。這次玩家將再度扮演 New Kid，和南方四賤客超人氣角色 Stan、Kyle、Kenny 與 Cartman 一起展開一場全新爆笑、無厘頭的角色扮演冒險故事。

metacritic.title: South Park: The Fractured But Whole

games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这次《南方公园》作者精心制作的全新作品中，玩家将扮演新来的孩子，和斯坦、凯尔、肯尼与卡特曼一起展开一场全新的爆笑无厘头角色扮演冒险故事。

metacritic.title: South Park: The Fractured But Whole

games.title: South Park™: The Stick of Truth ™
games.shortDescription:
From the creators of South Park, Trey Parker and Matt Stone, comes an epic quest to become…cool.

Arm yourself with weapons of legend to defeat underpants gnomes, hippies, and other forces of evil. Discover the lost Stick of Truth and succeed in earning your place alongside Stan, Kyle, Cartman, and Kenny as their new friend. Fail, and you will forever be known…as a loser.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 扮演屎蛋、凱子、阿ㄆ一ㄚˇ和阿尼的新朋友，一同踏上荒誕又瘋狂的 RPG 之旅，尋回失落的真實之杖。

metacritic.title: South Park: The Stick of Truth

games.title: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
games.shortDescription: The ultimate competitive platformer is back!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 终极版竞技性平台游戏回来了！激烈到令人窒息的线上及本地竞速

games.title: SpongeBob SquarePants™: The Patrick Star Game
games.shortDescription: Step into Patrick’s shorts and create hilarious, physics-based mayhem, as you make the open world of Bikini Bottom your playground!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 套上派大星的小短裤，创造基于物理的滑稽混乱场面，将比奇堡的开放世界变成你的游乐场！

metacritic.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: The Patrick Star Game

games.title: Spyro™ Reignited Trilogy
games.shortDescription: Same sick burns, same smoldering attitude, now all scaled up in stunning HD, Spyro is back in the Spyro™ Reignited Trilogy! Rekindle the fire with the original three games, Spyro™ the Dragon, Spyro™ 2: Ripto's Rage! and Spyro™: Year of the Dragon, all in fully-remastered glory.

games.title: SSX
games.shortDescription: SSX is the rebirth of the beloved franchise on the current generation of consoles where you can own the planet, compete online in totally new ways and defy reality across Race it, Trick it and Survive it events.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 大受歡迎的經典滑雪特許專營遊戲，現在有當代遊戲主機版本，您可以擁有世界，以前所未有的方式與您的朋友在線上較量，並在競賽、技術及求存遊戲項目裡，對抗險峻的滑雪環境。

games.title: Stacking
games.shortDescription: From Tim Schafer’s Double Fine Productions, explore a vintage world inhabited by living Russian stacking dolls as you jump into more than 100 unique dolls and use their special abilities to solve a wide variety of puzzles & challenges. Play as Charlie Blackmore, the world’s tiniest Russian stacking doll,  and embark on an adventure to rescue Charlie’s family from the nefarious industrialist known only as the “Baron.”

games.title: Star Trucker
games.shortDescription: Haul cargo, trade salvage and keep your space suit close as you search for fame and fortune among the stars in a game that puts an interstellar twist on the truck sim genre.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这款游戏在卡车模拟类型中融合星际元素，你将拖运货物，交换打捞来的货品，在星辰之间追寻名与利，只是时刻都要做好穿上宇航服的准备。

games.title: STAR WARS Jedi: Fallen Order™
games.shortDescription: Optimized for Xbox Series X|S.  A galaxy-spanning adventure awaits in STAR WARS Jedi: Fallen Order. An abandoned Padawan must complete his training, develop new powerful Force abilities, and master the art of the lightsaber - all while staying one step ahead of the Empire.
games.titleZh: 星球大战 绝地：陨落的武士团
games.shortDescriptionZh: Xbox Series X|S 专属强化。纵横整个银河系的冒险正在《星球大战 绝地：陨落的武士团》中等待着您。一名被抛弃的绝地学徒必须完成他的修行，习得强大的新原力技能，纯熟掌握光剑的使用 - 同时还要步步抢在帝国的前面。

games.title: STAR WARS Jedi: Survivor™
games.shortDescription: The story of Cal Kestis continues in Star Wars Jedi: Survivor™, a third-person galaxy-spanning action-adventure game from Respawn Entertainment and Lucasfilm Games.
games.titleZh: 星球大战 绝地：幸存者
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《星球大战 绝地：幸存者™》，这款由 Respawn Entertainment 与 Lucasfilm Games 合作开发的跨银河系第三人称动作冒险游戏中，卡尔·凯斯提斯的故事仍将继续。

games.title: Star Wars Outlaws
games.shortDescription:
Experience the first-ever open world Star Wars™ game and explore distinct locations across the galaxy, both iconic and new. Risk it all as scoundrel Kay Vess, seeking freedom and the means to start a new life. Fight, steal, and outwit your way through the galaxy’s crime syndicates as you join the galaxy’s most wanted.

If you’re willing to take the risk, the galaxy is full of opportunity.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
体验首个《星球大战™》开放世界游戏，领略银河系名胜，探索新区域。扮演恶棍凯·维丝，赌上一切踏上寻找自由，通往新生的道路。你将加入银河系头号通缉犯的队伍，战斗、偷窃，与犯罪集团斗智斗勇。

银河系充满机遇，只要你不惧冒险。

games.title: STAR WARS™ Battlefront™
games.shortDescription: Immerse yourself in the epic STAR WARS™ battles you’ve always dreamed of and create new heroic moments of your own in STAR WARS™ Battlefront™.
games.titleZh: 星际大战 战地风云
games.shortDescriptionZh: 投入一直梦寐以求的史诗般的 星际大战™，和星际大战 战地风云™一起开启自己的英雄时刻。

games.title: STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ II
games.shortDescription:
Embark on an all-new Battlefront experience from the bestselling STAR WARS™ HD game franchise of all time.

Become the hero and play as a fearless trooper, pilot a legendary starfighter, fight as your favorite iconic STAR WARS character, or forge a new path as an elite special forces soldier through an emotionally gripping new STAR WARS story.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
随时体验来自畅销 STAR WARS™ HD 游戏系列的全新战地感受。

成为英雄并作为无畏的骑兵去战斗、探索传奇的星战机，用你最爱的标志性 STAR WARS 角色来进行战斗，或通过一个崭新的扣人心弦激动人心的 STAR WARS 故事来塑造一个新的精英特种部队士兵的全新征程。

games.title: STAR WARS™: Squadrons
games.shortDescription: Master the art of starfighter combat in the authentic piloting experience STAR WARS™: Squadrons. Buckle up, feel the adrenaline of first-person multiplayer space dogfights alongside your squadron, and learn what it means to be a pilot in a thrilling STAR WARS™ single-player story.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《星球大战™：战机中队》感受逼真的飞行体验，并掌控星际战斗机的战斗艺术。系好安全带，与您的中队联手，享受令人血脉偾张的第一人称多人太空混战，并以一名飞行员的视角，亲身体验惊心动魄的《星球大战™》单人故事。

games.title: StarCraft® II Campaign Collection
games.shortDescription: Dive into a peerless real-time strategy game set in the distant reaches of the galaxy. Experience the scifi epic with the StarCraft II Campaign Collection, now on Game Pass!

games.shortDescription: Dominate the battlefields of the far-flung future!

games.title: Stardew Valley
games.shortDescription: You’ve inherited your grandfather’s old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home? Ever since Joja Corporation came to town, the old ways of life have all but disappeared. The community center, once the town’s most vibrant hub of activity, now lies in shambles. With a little dedication, you might just be the one to restore Stardew Valley to greatness!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 你继承了你爷爷在星露谷留下的老旧农场。带着爷爷留下的残旧工具和几枚硬币开始了你的新生活。你能适应这小镇上的生活并且将这个杂草丛生的老旧农场变成一个繁荣的家吗？

games.title: Starfield
games.shortDescription: Starfield is the first new universe in 25 years from Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim and Fallout 4. In this next generation role-playing game set amongst the stars, create any character you want and explore with unparalleled freedom as you embark on an epic journey to answer humanity’s greatest mystery.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Starfield》是由载誉无数、曾为大家带来《The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim》和《Fallout 4》的Bethesda Game Studios睽违超过25年所打造的第一个全新宇宙。这款新一代角色扮演游戏将背景设定在茫茫宇宙。在这里，你可以创建任意角色，探索世界并体验前所未有的自由。踏上这趟史诗般的旅程，发掘人类文明的终极奥秘。

games.title: Starlink: Battle for Atlas™
games.shortDescription: In Starlink: Battle for Atlas, lead a group of interstellar pilots as you build your own starship, explore the Atlas star system, and battle the vile Grax and his Forgotten Legion.

Return to the tranquil embrace of Starsand Island, a gem hailed as the "Star of the Deep Sea." Here, immerse yourself in a serene pastoral lifestyle: slow-paced days spent bonding with adorable capybaras, cats, and dogs, savoring the thrill of bountiful fishing, exploring the mystical Moonlit F
games.shortDescriptionZh:
厌倦了城市的繁冗生活？那就回到温馨家园星砂岛吧！在这座被誉为"深海中的一颗明星"的岛屿上，您将体验一段轻松写意的田园生活。您可以在这里享受慢节奏的日常，与可爱的水豚、猫狗等小动物为邻，体验渔获丰收的喜悦，探索神秘的荧月之森或是单纯享受这座岛屿自然美景。让我们一起逃离无聊的都市，在这片海上桃源重拾生活的美好。

与自然和谐共生的理想生活： 在星砂岛，您可以种植当地特色的热带果蔬，打理属于自己的农场；饲养各类可爱的动物，与它们建立深厚的感情；依据地形建造独具特色的乡村别墅，装点错落有致的露台花园。岛上的一切都在等待您的探索与经营。

自由自在，快意人生： 踩着滑板漫游在细长的海岸线上，骑着复古小摩托穿行于葱郁的树林间，扬帆远航探索邻近岛屿的奥秘。星砂岛为您准备了丰富多样的交通工具，让您尽情感受不同速度带来的乐趣。更有标志性的环岛公路，您可以驾驶载具领略岛屿的秀丽风光。

 与温暖人心的岛民共度

games.title: STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions (Game Preview)
games.shortDescription:
This game is a work in progress. It may or may not change over time or release as a final product. Purchase only if you are comfortable with the current state of the unfinished game.

Join the ESS Starseeker crew to explore strange new worlds and work together with friends. Complete planet-wide objectives on timed Expeditions before returning to safety aboard the Station. Collect and unlock powerful tech to help the crew tackle the perils of space!

加入 ESS 寻星号的船员队伍，探索奇异的新世界，与朋友们彼此合作。在限时远征中完成星球范围内的探索目标，然后安全返回空间站。收集并解锁强大的科技，帮助船员应对太空中的各种危险！

games.title: State of Decay 2: Juggernaut Edition
games.shortDescription: State of Decay 2: Juggernaut Edition is an improved version of the popular zombie survival game and includes the all-new Homecoming Update – a fully remastered, open world version of Trumbull Valley for the core game, reintegrating the Mount Tanner and Fairfield regions to the map, and adding new sites to scavenge, along with new sights to behold.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《腐烂国度 2：巨霸版》是热门丧尸生存游戏《腐烂国度 2》的强化版。此版本包含全新的归乡更新：为核心游戏带来全面重制的开放世界版本特兰伯尔谷，并且将在地图上重新引入坦纳山与费尔菲尔德区域。此外还有许多可以搜刮的新区域以及可以观赏的新景点。

games.title: State of Decay: Year-One
games.shortDescription: Included with purchase of State of Decay: Year-One Survival Edition; not available for purchase separately.

games.title: STEEP
games.shortDescription:
Ride the massive open world of the Alps, where the powder is always fresh and the run never ends. 
Defy and master the mountain alone or with friends on skis, wingsuits, snowboards and paragliders. Record and share your best stunts.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在阿爾卑斯山脈與阿拉斯加的廣闊開放世界中，無盡遨遊飄落新鮮細雪的天地。
獨自一人或與好友一同挑戰爭霸高山，自由體驗滑雪、飛鼠裝滑翔、單板滑雪與滑翔傘飛行的快感。記錄並分享你的最佳表現時刻。

games.shortDescriptionZh:
在阿尔卑斯山脉的广阔开放世界中，无尽遨游飘落新鲜细雪的天地。
独自一人或与好友一同挑战，称霸最险峻的高山，自由体验滑雪、飞鼠装滑翔、单板滑雪与滑翔伞飞行的快感。记录并分享你的最佳表现。

games.title: Subnautica 2 (Game Preview)
games.shortDescription: Subnautica 2 is an underwater survival adventure set on an all-new alien world, developed by Unknown Worlds. Play alone or with friends in 4-player co-op. Adapt to survive by building custom bases and crafting tools. Explore the unknown to uncover the mysteries hidden within the depths.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Subnautica 2：异星水域》是背景设定在全新外星世界的水下生存冒险游戏，由Unknown Worlds倾力打造。可以单人游玩，也可以与好友组队开启四人合作模式。建造专属基地，制作不同工具，适应环境，水下求生。探索未知世界，揭开深海中隐藏的谜团。

games.title: Sunset Overdrive
games.shortDescription: Sunset Overdrive transforms an open-world apocalypse into your tactical playground. Zip, grind and wall-run across Sunset City while using a devastating, unconventional arsenal. With hyper-agility, unique weapons, and customizable special abilities, Sunset Overdrive rewrites the rules of traditional shooters and delivers an explosive and irreverent adventure in the end times.

Jinx is the scheming and mysterious villain trying to reshape the world, but for what reason?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这是一款老少咸宜的欢乐游乐场平台游戏。主角乐琦是一个天性乐观、精力充沛、令人爱戴的英雄，他的任务是找到自己的内在力量，帮助姐姐将时代之书从金克斯手中夺回来。金克斯是一个奸诈又神秘的坏蛋，试图重塑世界，但他的目的是什么呢？

games.title: Super Meat Boy 3D
games.shortDescription: The infamous, tough-as-nails platformer – now in 3D!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 那款大名鼎鼎、硬核到炸裂的平台跳跃游戏推出 3D 版了！

games.title: Super Mega Baseball 3
games.shortDescription: Run up the score in a relaxed slugfest or push the limits of your reflexes in this refined baseball simulator. The third entry in the series features all-new Franchise and Online Leagues modes, major graphical enhancements, and on-field additions including pickoffs and situational player traits.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Run up the score in a relaxed slugfest or push the limits of your reflexes in this refined baseball simulator. games.title: Super Mega Baseball™ 4
games.shortDescription: Super Mega Baseball™ 4 is where the Legends play. The signature mix of arcade-inspired style and immersive gameplay returns with 200+ baseball Legends and a grand slam of presentation upgrades.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Super Mega Baseball™ 4》是与传奇球员同场竞技的地方。该系列标志性地将街机风格与沉浸式游玩深度结合，带来超过 200 名棒球传奇球员，呈现方式也已全面升级。

games.title: Superball
games.shortDescription:
Superball is a multiplayer superpower sports game featuring 3v3 team-based combat in cyberpunk-themed stadiums. 
Select your character, pass, kick and pave the way to victory!
games.shortDescriptionZh:
超级巴基球是一款赛博朋克背景的超能力英雄体育竞技游戏。
好好利用英雄们的各式技能，你既可以秀翻全场，也能与队友打出行云流水的配合。去把球搞进对手球门，获取胜利吧。

games.title: SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE
games.shortDescription: The third game in the SUPERHOT franchise - MIND CONTROL DELETE gives you more insight into the world of SUPERHOT, more story, more signature gameplay. Hours and hours of timeless combat. Keep dancing the slow motion ballet of destruction for so much longer than ever before.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《SUPERHOT》系列的第三款游戏《MIND CONTROL DELETE》将带来更多《SUPERHOT》的世界观、更多剧情，以及更多招牌游戏玩法。享受比以往更长的游戏时间，持续跳着慢动作的毁灭之舞。

games.title: Supermarket Simulator
games.shortDescription: Run your supermarket! Stock shelves, set prices, take payments, hire staff, expand, handle shoplifters, design layout, deliver orders. Buy goods locally or online and bring them to customers yourself.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 经营你的超市！补货、定价、收款、雇员、扩店、防盗、设计布局并亲自送货。商品可来自线上或本地市场，订单由你亲自交付。

games.title: SWORN
games.shortDescription:
SWORN is a 1-4 player co-op action rogue-like. Explore and reclaim a fallen Camelot from the reign of a corrupted Arthur and his Knights of the round table.

Play Solo or Co-Op

Play solo or unite with friends to stand off against the Knights of the Round Table. Combine the strengths of your characters in surprising ways and master abilities to become knights worthy of standing off against Arthur
games.shortDescriptionZh:
SWORN是一款支持1-4名玩家合作的动作肉鸽游戏，玩家将共同探索并收复被腐化的亚瑟和他的圆桌骑士统治下倒塌的卡美洛。
独自或合作游玩

独自或与好友共同游玩，将角色的优势巧妙结合，掌握技能，并成为足以与亚瑟抗衡的骑士。

探索没落的卡美洛

游戏中玩家将与亚瑟传奇中熟悉的朋友和敌人相遇，发现阿瓦隆上蔓延黑暗的源头，并与梅林、尼姆女士等强大人物结交并学习。玩家将以灵魂锻造骑士之姿挥舞剑锋。

释放你的创造力

在不断变化的卡美洛战场上，多样性蓬勃发展。玩家将祝福与角色、武器和能力结合，成为一名经验丰富的骑士。

games.title: Symphonia 𝄞
games.shortDescription: Awaken an expansive musical realm in this non-violent and poetic platformer. In Symphonia, you'll use the power of your violin coupled with your platforming skills to gather an orchestra to bring the musical machinery of the world back to life.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款没有暴力元素且充满诗意的平台游戏中，你将唤醒一片广阔的音乐国度。在《Symphonia》中，你要运用小提琴的力量和你的平台跳跃技巧，召集一支管弦乐队，让王国的音乐机械重获生机。

games.title: Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU
games.shortDescription:
Wield the dance of the shaman. Reclaim your father’s spirit.
Brave the beautiful and treacherous land of Kenzera with the God of Death in Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU, a thrilling metroidvania-style adventure crafted by Surgent Studios.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
跃动萨满之舞。重拾你父亲的灵魂。
在 Surgent Studios 制作的《肯泽拉传说：扎乌》中，与死神一起勇闯美丽而危险的肯泽拉大陆，展开一场惊险刺激的类银河战士恶魔城式冒险。

games.title: Tamashika
games.shortDescription:
ATTENTION IS ALL YOU NEED

TAMASHIKA is a fast-paced arcade-style corridor shooter focused on flow, precision, and survival.

Move through shifting environments, react quickly, and stay locked in. Each run is about control, timing, and keeping your mind in one place.

Patterns in the world create a sense of continuity, but everything is in motion. Focus is what keeps you alive.

Features:
TAMASHIK

Tears of Metal is a medieval hack-and-slash co-op roguelike. Carve through hordes of enemies to reclaim your island with the help of your formidable Scottish battalion. As you advance deeper into the trenches, uncover more about the mysterious Dragon Meteor and the treacherous enemy invasion.

games.shortDescription: A psychedelic soundscape in the sky. Puzzle through the seasons by conducting chaotic Tempopo to rescue musical flowers. Design and populate your melodic garden, then let the music play!

games.shortDescriptionZh: 《矩阵：零日危机》是一款融合了虚拟多元世界题材的肉鸽刷宝射击PVE游戏。

games.title: Terraria
games.shortDescription:
The world is at your fingertips as you fight for survival, explore for fortune, and dig for glory. Delve deep into cavernous expanses, test your mettle in combat, or construct your own city!

Now including the brand new 1.4.5 Bigger and Boulder Content!
games.shortDescriptionZh:
整个世界尽在掌中，为生存、财富与荣耀而战吧。深入探索深邃的洞穴，磨练战斗勇气，建造属于你的都市!

全新 1.4.5 版本更新“巨石滚滚”现已上线！

games.title: TerraTech Legion
games.shortDescription: TerraTech Legion, a chaotic Bullet Heaven Builder. Build the ultimate battle vehicle block by block and survive waves of robotic foes, ramming them at speed and shooting infinite projectiles.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《泰拉科技魇团》，一款混乱爽快的“弹幕射击”建造游戏。自由拼装模块化终极战车，在一波波机械敌潮中破局求生，以高速冲撞与无限弹幕火力，彻底摧毁自由无人机团。

games.title: The Alters
games.shortDescription: Explore an emotional sci-fi game with a unique blend of survival, adventure, and base-building elements. Help Jan Dolski—the sole survivor of an ill-fated space expedition—create alternative versions of himself to escape a hostile planet and tackle personal turmoils with this unconventional crew.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 体验一款牵动人心的科幻游戏，探索融合冒险、生存和基地建设的异星奇景。你将扮演扬·道尔斯基——某次不幸的太空探险事故唯一的幸存者，创造出不同版本的自己，逃离这个充满致命陷阱的星球，并与这支“非正规军”一起面对心灵深处的个人创伤。

games.title: The Bard's Tale ARPG : Remastered and Resnarkled
games.shortDescription: You are the Bard, a selfish rogue weary of pointless sub-quests and rat-infested cellars. Through magical song you summon characters to join your quest!
games.shortDescriptionZh: You are the Bard, a selfish rogue weary of pointless sub-quests and rat-infested cellars. Through magical song you summon characters to join your quest!

games.title: The Bard's Tale IV: Director's Cut
games.shortDescription: The Bard's Tale IV: Director’s Cut is the triumphant return of one of the most iconic RPG series of all-time. Delve into a tactically rich combat system that rewards creativity, solve puzzles to gain treasure and advantages, and discover a beautifully crafted world.

The Bard's Tale Trilogy is a remastering of the classic 1980s series, one of the godfathers of the RPG genre. Create an adventuring party in the first volume and play it across all three, creating a heroic story all your own!

games.title: The Casting of Frank Stone™
games.shortDescription: The shadow of Frank Stone looms over Cedar Hills, a town forever altered by his violent past. As a group of young friends are about to discover, Stone’s blood-soaked legacy cuts deep, leaving scars across families, generations, and the very fabric of reality itself.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 弗兰克·斯通的阴影笼罩着雪松山，他的暴力过去永远地改变了这个小镇。正如一群年轻的朋友即将发现的那样，斯通的血腥传承影响深远，给家庭、世代甚至现实本身都留下了伤痕

games.title: The Cave
games.shortDescription: Assemble your team of three from seven unlikely adventurers and descend into the mysterious depths. The Cave awaits.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Assemble your team of three from seven unlikely adventurers and descend into the mysterious depths. The Cave awaits.

games.title: The Crew Motorfest
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Motorfest, the ultimate open world driving experience. Explore the beautiful Hawaiian archipelago, from O'ahu to the newly added Maui Island, at the wheel of the most prestigious vehicles. Discover the best of car culture through intense races, themed events, unexpected challenges, and collect hundreds of iconic cars. Try the game for free for up to 5 hours!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 欢迎来到《轰鸣盛典》，这里有终极的开放世界驾驶体验！你将驾驶着久负盛名的各种载具，探索美丽的夏威夷群岛，从欧胡岛到新增的茂宜岛，尽情飞驰。在激烈的比赛、主题活动、意想不到的挑战中，探索汽车文化的精髓，同时还能收集数百辆标志性载具。免费试玩游戏，最多 5 个小时！

games.title: The Crew Motorfest - Xbox One
games.shortDescription: Sharpen your driving skills and get your ticket for a one-of-a-kind car festival set in one of the most spectacular locations in the world: Hawaii.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 磨練駕駛技巧並取得一場獨一無二車輛盛會的入場券，場地將移師世界上最壯麗的其中一個地點——夏威夷。

免費試玩《飆酷車神：動力慶典》5 小時！

歡迎來到 Motorfest，終極的駕駛體驗！一邊在激烈的比賽、主題賽事和更多活動中競速，一邊探索夏威夷歐胡島充滿活力的開放世界！有數百輛經典汽車可收集，你將有諸多機會展示自身技術。

games.title: The Crew® 2
games.shortDescription:
JOIN A COMMUNITY OF 30 MILLION PLAYERS! Take on the American motorsports scene as you explore and dominate the land, air, and sea across the USA. Pick your favorite vehicles and test your skills in a wide range of driving disciplines.

New: play The Crew 2 offline or online with the new Hybrid mode, available now! Enjoy both the original online experience and a new way to play solo.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
加入 3,000 萬名玩家的社群行列吧！挑戰美式動力運動賽事，探索並征服美國陸海空。選擇你最愛的載具，以多種競速項目考驗自身能耐。

新內容：透過新混合模式離線或線上遊玩《飆酷車神 2》，現已推出！同時享受原汁原味線上模式體驗，以及單人遊玩的新方式。

games.shortDescriptionZh: 加入社区，和 3000 万玩家一起游戏！你将在这里探索并统御美国的大地、高空与海洋，挑战美国赛车界。在众多载具中挑选你的挚爱，参与各类竞速赛事，测试你的驾驶技术。

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Adventures: Redguard
games.shortDescription:
ONE MAN AGAINST AN EMPIRE

Tiber Septim has swept through Tamriel, uniting its squabbling lands by force. Even the mighty Redguards of Hammerfell have come under Imperial control. Cyrus, the legendary Redguard mercenary, leads a rebellion against the Empire. Along with a faction known as the Restless League, Cyrus defeats the occupying forces at Stros M’kai and forces Tiber Septim to make peace with the Redguards.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
形单影只对抗整个帝国

提伯·赛普汀横扫泰姆瑞尔，用武力统一了纷争不断的土地。与此同时，连汉默菲尔强大的红衣卫士也被帝国控制了。赛勒斯，传奇红衣卫士雇佣兵，领导了一场反抗帝国的叛乱。他与一个名为“不安联盟”的帮派联手在斯特罗斯姆凯击败了占领军，并迫使提伯·赛普汀与红衣卫士握手言和。

games.title: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind Game of the Year Edition (PC)
games.shortDescription: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind Game of the Year Edition includes Morrowind plus all of the content from the Bloodmoon and Tribunal expansions.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在史诗般的开放式单人RPG游戏《Morrowind》中，你可以创造和扮演任何想象得到的角色。你可以选择跟随主线剧情，寻找肆虐于这片大地的邪恶枯萎病的根源，或者自行前去探索陌生地点，并基于角色在整个游戏中的剧情来发展他们的特性。《Morrowind》以令人惊叹的3D图形、开放式的玩法以及超乎想象的细节和交互性，提供了无可匹敌的游玩体验。

games.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion
games.shortDescription: Step inside the most richly detailed and vibrant game-world ever created. Oblivion is the latest chapter in the epic Elder Scrolls saga. With a powerful combination of freeform gameplay and unprecedented graphics, you can unravel the main quest at your own pace or explore the vast world and find your own challenges.

With a powerful combination of freeform gameplay and unprecedented graphics, you can unravel the main quest at your own pace or explore the vast world and find your own challenges.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion》年度最佳游戏版是有史以来最好的RPG游戏之一。进入这个迄今为止细节最为丰富且充满活力的游戏世界。在这款有力结合了游玩自由度和前所未有之图形的游戏中，你可以自己的节奏完成主要任务，或探索这个广阔的世界，寻找你自己的挑战。

games.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
games.shortDescription: Explore Cyrodiil like never before with stunning new visuals and refined gameplay in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion™ Remastered.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 体验全新制作的精美画面和悉心改善的游戏系统，在《上古卷轴IV：湮灭重制版》中探索前所未有的西罗帝尔。

games.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Standard Edition
games.shortDescription: Every legend starts somewhere and in The Elder Scrolls Online, it starts with you. Join millions of players in an online, fantasy RPG set in a vast living Elder Scrolls world.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 包含《上古卷轴OL》基础版游戏以及《晨风》、《帝都》、《奥辛纽姆》、《盗贼公会》与《黑暗兄弟会》冒险。

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
games.shortDescription:
Winner of more than 200 Game of the Year Awards, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition brings the epic fantasy to life in stunning detail. The Special Edition includes the critically acclaimed game and add-ons with all-new features like remastered art and effects, volumetric god rays, dynamic depth of field, screen-space reflections, and more. 

Skyrim Special Edition also brings the power of Bethesda Game Studios Creations to consoles. New quests, environments, characters, dialogue, armor, weapons and more – with Creations, there are no limits to what you can experience.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
荣获超过200项年度游戏大奖的《The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim》推出特别版，以令人惊叹的细致画面带来史诗奇幻巨作。特别版内含大获好评的主游戏、附加内容，还有重制的艺术和特效、体积光效、动态景深、屏幕空间反射等全新功能。

现在主机也能使用Bethesda Game Studios创作的强大功能了。新推出的任务、环境、角色、对话、装备、武器和更多内容，再搭配创作，为你带来无限游戏体验。

games.title: The Evil Within
games.shortDescription: Developed by Shinji Mikami, The Evil Within embodies the meaning of pure survival horror. Highly-crafted environments and an intricate story are combined to create an immersive world that will bring you to the height of tension. With limited resources at your disposal, you’ll fight for survival in this perfect blend of horror and action.

games.title: The Evil Within (PC)
games.shortDescription: This bundle includes The Evil Within and all season pass content: The Assignment, The Consequence, and The Executioner packs.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这个捆绑包内含《The Evil Within》及所有季票内容：“The Assignment”、“The Consequence”和“The Executioner”组合包。

games.title: The Evil Within® 2
games.shortDescription: Detective Sebastian Castellanos has lost everything, including his daughter, Lily. To save her, he must descend into the nightmarish world of STEM. Horrifying threats emerge from every corner, and he must rely on his wits to survive. For his one chance at redemption, the only way out is in.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 失去女儿的赛巴斯汀·卡司特拉诺警探已孑然一身，一无所有。为了拯救女儿莉莉，他必须潜入STEM梦魇般的世界。身陷四面楚歌的困境下，唯有仰赖智慧才能觅得一线生机。这是获得救赎的一丝希望，而深入梦魇则是唯一的出路。

games.title: THE FINALS
games.shortDescription: THE FINALS is the ultimate virtual combat game show, where you and your team fight for fame, riches, and the favor of generous seasonal sponsors. This free-to-play, team-based, first-person shooter pits contestants against each other in Virtual Arenas based on iconic real-world locations that can be altered and even destroyed.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《THE FINALS》是一档顶尖的虚拟格斗游戏节目，你和你的战队要在这里争夺荣誉、财富和慷慨的赛季赞助方的支持。这是一款免费、团队合作、第一人称射击游戏，选手们可以在虚拟竞技场中展开激烈的较量，这些竞技场不仅依照真实世界的著名地点所设计，还可以肆意改造或破坏。

games.title: The First Descendant
games.shortDescription: The First Descendant is a cross-platform (free-to-play) next-gen, third-person looter shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《The First Descendant》是一款以虚幻引擎5为基础，可跨平台游玩（free-to-play）的新一代第3人称打宝射击游戏。

games.title: The Gunk
games.shortDescription: The Gunk stars Rani, part of our duo of gritty space haulers, struggling to make a buck as they chance upon an untouched planet brimming with life. They came in search of valuable resources, and it looks like they’ve hit the jackpot…
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Gunk》的主角Rani是勇敢的太空搬运工双人组之一，靠着辛勤工作勉强维持生计的两人偶然来到了一个生机勃勃的未开发星球。他们来此寻找有价值的资源，看起来这次是中了头彩……

games.title: The Long Dark
games.shortDescription: The Long Dark is a thoughtful, exploration-survival experience that challenges solo players to think for themselves as they explore an expansive frozen wilderness in the aftermath of a geomagnetic disaster. There are no zombies -- only you, the cold, and all the threats Mother Nature can muster.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《漫漫长夜》是一款引人深思的探索生存类游戏。在游戏中，玩家需要在地磁灾难之后探索巨大的荒野冰原，他们必须独立思考，找到出路。游戏中没有僵尸，只有你、严寒和大自然中的所有残酷环境。

games.title: The Outer Worlds
games.shortDescription: The Outer Worlds is a new single-player sci-fi RPG from Obsidian Entertainment and Private Division. As you explore the furthest reaches of space and encounter a host of factions all vying for power, who you decide to become will determine the fate of everyone in Halcyon. In the corporate equation for the colony, you are the unplanned variable.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《天外世界》是Obsidian Entertainment与Private Division联手打造的单人科幻RPG游戏。当你探索太空的最深处，遭遇众多竭尽所能争权夺势的派系时，你决定要成为什么样的人，将左右神翠所有人的命运。在这个殖民地的企业方程中，你是计划外的未知变量。

games.title: The Outer Worlds 2
games.shortDescription: The Outer Worlds 2 is the sequel to the award-winning first-person sci-fi RPG from Obsidian Entertainment.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《The Outer Worlds 2》是屡获奖项的第一人称科幻RPG《天外世界》的续作，由Obsidian Entertainment打造。

games.title: The Outer Worlds: Spacer's Choice Edition
games.shortDescription: The Outer Worlds: Spacer’s Choice Edition is the ultimate way to play the award-winning RPG from Obsidian Entertainment and Private Division. Including the base game and all DLC, this remastered masterpiece is the absolute best version of The Outer Worlds.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 入手《The Outer Worlds: Spacer’s Choice Edition》，内含游戏本体与所有 DLC。获得最为完整与顶级的体验，畅玩重制版经典大作，感受这款由 Obsidian Entertainment 与 Private Division 联手打造、屡获殊荣的 RPG 游戏。

games.title: The Planet Crafter
games.shortDescription: A space survival open world terraforming crafting game, designed for 1 to 8 players. Alter the ecosystem of an inhospitable planet to render it habitable for humanity. Survive, gather resources, and build your base. Then, generate oxygen, warmth, and pressure to create a brand new biosphere.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这是一款太空生存开放世界类地化改造游戏，既可单人畅玩，也可供多达8名玩家同乐。改变荒芜星球的生态系统，让其适合人类生存。努力求生，收集资源，建设自己的基地；更能供给氧气、提升热量和大气压，打造全新的生物圈。

games.title: The Rogue Prince of Persia™
games.shortDescription: In this challenging, fast-paced roguelite, every death is a unique chance to rewrite fate, save Persia – or die trying. Master fluid, acrobatic combat and parkour as you explore your kingdom to right your wrongs!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款充满挑战的快节奏肉鸽游戏里，每一次死亡都是改写命运、拯救波斯的独特机会——不成功，便成仁。掌握特技般的流畅战斗和跑酷技巧，探索你的王国，弥补自己犯下的错误！

games.title: The Royal Writ
games.shortDescription: Sacrifice creates stories in this medieval roguelike deckbuilder. Watch your cards march to glory or permanent death as they battle toward the enemy. Each fallen hero becomes part of your kingdom's legend. Command wisely... some sacrifices are necessary.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 听着！朕乃这四海之内的无上霸主，特此颁布此诏令，召集天下前来体验朕的伟大统治！这不仅是一款游戏，更是朕展示王权与战争艺术的绝佳舞台，战场既是吾辈之牌局，朕才是永远的赢家！尔等若不速速加入，便是对朕威严的公然挑衅，后果自负——朕可不介意派出一支“小型围攻队”拜访尔等陋室！

games.title: The Settlers: New Allies
games.shortDescription:
Buy The Settlers: New Allies and get the Pioneer Pack for free.

games.shortDescription: The Settlers®: New Allies is a strategy game with an in-depth build-up experience and real-time strategic battles.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《工人物语®：新兴同盟》是一款策略游戏，有着深度的建造体验和实时策略战斗。

The Sims™ 4 Get To Work
