games.title: The Talos Principle 2
games.shortDescription: The Talos Principle 2 is a thought-provoking first-person puzzle experience that greatly expands on the first game's philosophical themes and stunning environments with increasingly mind-bending challenges.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《塔洛斯的法则2》是激发思考的第一人称解谜游戏，大幅拓展了第一代游戏的哲学主题及令人叹为观止的环境，加入解谜难度越来越高的挑战。

games.title: The Thaumaturge
games.shortDescription: The Thaumaturge is a character-driven RPG with a rich story, morally ambiguous choices, and turn-based combat. In a city on the brink of change, use your mystical powers to read emotions, uncover motives, and command folklore-inspired demons — while resisting the temptation of your own pride.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《奇唤士》是一款以角色为核心的角色扮演游戏，你将在游戏中体验丰富的剧情故事、两可的道德选择以及充满策略的回合制战斗。在这座风起云涌的城市中，利用你的神秘力量解读情感、揭露动机，驱使源自民间传说中的恶魔，并抵御自身傲慢的诱惑。

games.title: The Walking Dead: A New Frontier - The Complete Season (Episodes 1-5)
games.shortDescription: As Javier, a young man determined to find the family taken from him, you meet a young girl who has experienced her own unimaginable loss. Her name is Clementine, and your fates are bound together in a story where every choice you make could be your last.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 当Javier，决心找回被夺走的家时，你遇到了一个年轻女孩，她也经历了无法想象的遭遇，她的名字叫Clementine，你们的命运从此交织在一起，你所做的每个选择都有可能是你人生最后一个。

games.title: The Walking Dead: Michonne - The Complete Season
games.shortDescription: The Walking Dead: Michonne - A Telltale Miniseries stars the iconic, blade-wielding character from Robert Kirkman's best-selling comic books. Haunted by her past, and coping with unimaginable loss and regret, the story explores Michonne's absence between issues #126 and #139 of the comic book.
games.shortDescriptionZh: The Walking Dead: Michonne - A Telltale Miniseries以漫画书中的标志性人物为主角，她被自己的从前所困扰，不得不生活在难以想象的伤痛与懊悔中。故事发生在漫画书第126话和第139话之间，带着玩家探索她不为人知的旅程。在这个miniseries的3个章节中，玩家将发现到底是什么使Michonne远离了Rick、Ezekiel等等她所信任的队友……以及又是什么令她重新改变。

games.title: The Walking Dead: Season Two
games.shortDescription: Experience what it’s like to play as Clementine, meet new survivors, explore new locations and make gruesome decisions in this five-part game series of choice and consequence.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Experience what it’s like to play as Clementine, meet new survivors, explore new locations and make gruesome decisions in this five-part game series of choice and consequence.

games.title: The Walking Dead: The Complete First Season
games.shortDescription: Winner of over 90 ‘Game of the Year’ Awards, The Walking Dead Complete First Season includes all 5 episodes of the critically acclaimed series, plus special episode ‘400 Days’.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Winner of over 90 ‘Game of the Year’ Awards, The Walking Dead Complete First Season includes all 5 episodes of the critically acclaimed series, plus special episode ‘400 Days’.

games.title: The Walking Dead: The Final Season - The Complete Season
games.shortDescription: Clementine, now a fierce and capable survivor, has reached the final chapter in her journey. After years on the road facing threats both living and dead, a secluded school might finally be her chance for a home. But protecting it will mean sacrifice. Clem must build a life and become a leader while still watching over AJ, an orphaned boy and the closest thing to family she has left. In this gripping and emotional final season, you will define your relationships, fight the undead, and determine how Clementine’s story ends.
games.titleZh: The Walking Dead：最后一季 - The Complete Season
games.shortDescriptionZh: 克蕾敏汀跨越重重难关，成为了一位坚强自立的幸存者，她的旅途终于到达了最终章。多年来在活人和丧尸的威胁下流离失所，或许她终于能在一间与世隔绝的学校安家。但是保护家园势必有所牺牲。克蕾敏必须建立新生活并成为一位领导者。她同时还要照顾艾基，这个孤儿是她仅剩像家人般的同伴。在这扣人心弦的最终一季故事中，你将会定义你的人际关系、与丧尸战斗、并决定克蕾敏汀的故事将如何结束。

games.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild™
games.shortDescription: Discover an atmospheric hunting game like no other in this realistic, stunning open world – regularly updated in collaboration with the community. Immerse yourself in the single player campaign, or share the ultimate hunting experience with friends.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这个风光旖旎又栩栩如生的开放世界中，体验与众不同、身临其境的狩猎游戏——我们与游戏社区携手合作，定期更新。可选择投身于单人狩猎模式，或与好友分享终极狩猎体验。

games.title: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ - Windows 10
games.shortDescription: Discover an atmospheric hunting game like no other in this realistic, stunning open world – regularly updated in collaboration with the community. Immerse yourself in the single player campaign, or share the ultimate hunting experience with friends.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Discover an atmospheric hunting game like no other in this realistic, stunning open world – regularly updated in collaboration with the community. Immerse yourself in the single player campaign, or share the ultimate hunting experience with friends.

games.title: Tiny Bookshop
games.shortDescription: Leave everything behind and open a tiny bookshop by the sea in this cozy narrative management game. Stock your tiny bookshop with different books and items, set up shop in scenic locations, and run your cozy second-hand bookshop while getting to know the locals.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款温馨的叙事经营游戏中，抛开一切，在海边开一家小小的书店。为你的小书店备齐各式书籍与物品，在风景如画的地点开张营业，经营这家温馨的二手书店，同时结识当地居民。

games.title: Titanfall® 2
games.shortDescription:
From Respawn Entertainment comes Titanfall® 2. 

Featuring the debut of a singleplayer campaign and a deeper multiplayer experience, Titanfall® 2 delivers more of the innovative, fast, fluid gameplay fans expect from the series.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
Respawn Entertainment为您呈现：《Titanfall™ 2》！ 

《Titanfall™ 2》将首次推出单人战役，同时具备更深邃丰富的多人模式，带来更多新颖、快节奏的流畅游戏体验，保证让系列爱好者们大呼过瘾。

games.title: to a T
games.shortDescription: A charming, colorful adventure game from the creator of Katamari Damacy and the uvula team about a teen navigating life in a small town with their cute dog companion. While their body is stuck in a T-pose, they do their best to make the most of it.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 由《块魂》的创作者与uvula团队打造的一款充满魅力和色彩的冒险游戏，讲述了一名少年与可爱的小狗伙伴在小镇上一同生活的故事。尽管身体一直保持T字形，但这名少年还是尽力让自己过得充实。

games.title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Breakpoint
games.shortDescription: Ghost Recon Breakpoint is a tactical third-person shooter set in a vast open world. You must survive, adapt, and fight a rogue spec ops faction, using stealth, strategy, and high-tech gear in solo or co-op.
games.titleZh: 汤姆·克兰西《幽灵行动：断点》
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《幽灵行动：断点》是一款设定于广阔开放世界的战术第三人称射击游戏。你必须依靠潜行、策略和高科技装备，在单人模式或合作模式中生存、适应，并击败一支叛变特殊行动部队。

games.title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Wildlands
games.shortDescription:
Lead your elite team of Ghosts in this tactical third-person shooter. Explore a massive open world, infiltrate and destroy the deadly Santa Blanca cartel, and save Bolivia and its people.

All editions now include a free title update, featuring a new story mission, plus 4K and 60 FPS availability!
games.titleZh: 汤姆·克兰西《幽灵行动：荒野》
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在这款战术第三人称射击游戏中，率领你的精英幽灵小队。你将探索广阔的开放世界，渗透并摧毁致命的圣塔布兰卡贩毒集团，拯救玻利维亚及其人民。

现所有版本均已包含免费的重大更新，内含全新剧情任务、支持 4K 及 60 帧画质！

games.title: Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon Wildlands
games.shortDescription: Create a team with up to 3 friends in Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon® Wildlands and enjoy the ultimate military shooter experience set in a massive, dangerous, and responsive open world.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon® Wildlands》是第一款置身于超大开放世界的军事射击游戏，您可纯粹单人游戏，或四人组队联合行动。

games.title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon® Breakpoint
games.shortDescription: Become a Ghost, an elite spec ops soldier, tasked with a special mission to Auroa. The remote archipelago has lost contact with outside world due to Skell Technology turning hostile. The Wolves, a rogue spec ops team, lead by your ex-brother in arms, have taken over and are hunting you down. Lead your team through the island landscape and save the civilians without being noticed.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 化身菁英特種部隊士兵「魅影」，接下前往奧羅亞的特殊任務。這座偏遠群島因為與斯凱爾科技為敵，失去了與外界的聯繫。你前戰友領導的武裝叛變特種部隊「影狼」佔領了這座島嶼，也正在獵殺你。領導你的團隊，在島嶼的群山峻嶺間穿梭，避開敵人追捕以拯救平民。

games.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege - Elite Edition
games.shortDescription:
Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege is the undisputed reference in tactical team shooters, where elite strategy and execution triumph.

The Elite Edition grants access to all game modes including Ranked playlists and the Siege Cup, as well as 16 additional operators.
games.titleZh: 彩虹六号：围攻- 精英版
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《彩虹六号：围攻》是战术团队射击游戏中无可争议的典范，明智的策略和行动力是制胜关键。

精英版将解锁全部游戏模式（包括排名战对战列表和围攻杯），以及额外16名特勤干员。

games.title: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six® Extraction
games.shortDescription: Team Rainbow now faces the greatest terror ever: a lethal, mutating alien invasion. Pre-order now to get the Orbital Decay bundle.
games.titleZh: 虹彩六号: 撤离禁区
games.shortDescriptionZh: 虹彩小隊正面臨前所未有的強烈恐懼：一場致命且持續突變的外星入侵。立即預購，取得「星際環軌」同捆。

games.title: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six® Extraction
games.shortDescription:
For decades, Team Rainbow has been the shield against the worst global threats imaginable. Now, we face the greatest terror yet: a lethal, mutating alien parasite. 
•	Includes Buddy Pass: Invite 2 friends to play with you for FREE for 14 days
•	Play alone or with friends from any platform
•	69 guns, 25 gadgets, 18 operators with progression levels, 12 maps, 13 mutating enemies, & free post-launch
games.titleZh: 虹彩六号: 撤离禁区
games.shortDescriptionZh:
數十年來，虹彩小隊這面銅牆鐵壁在全球持續對抗你所能想像到的重大威脅。現在，我們正面臨前所未有的強烈恐懼：一場致命且持續突變的外星入侵。你必須不斷調整策略以搶占先機。
•	在可 1 至 3 名玩家合作遊玩的第一人稱戰術射擊遊戲組成小隊
•	90 件武器與裝備、18 名可自訂的特勤幹員、12 張大地圖、13 種任務、13 類敵方古菌型態與更多內容

games.title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six® Siege - Elite Edition
games.shortDescription:
Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege is an elite, tactical team-based shooter where superior planning and execution triumph.

Siege X marks the biggest evolution in its history, and deepens the game’s tactical core.
games.titleZh: 彩虹六号：围攻- 精英版
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《彩虹六号：围攻》是一款精英团队战术射击游戏，高超的策略和行动力是制胜关键。

games.title: Tom Clancy's The Division
games.shortDescription:
New-York City, today. An unprecedented pandemic has struck the city during the fever of Black Friday. One by one, basic services fail. In only days, without food or water, society collapses into chaos. You’re part of the Division, an autonomous unit of tactical agents trained to operate independently. Your mission: protect what remains and restore hope. 

•  Fight your way through a breath-taking urban jungle dragged into chaos

• As a member of the Division, customize your Agent, loot and upgrade your equipment with state-of-the art technology
 
• Take back New York City from hostile factions, alone or with your friends
games.shortDescriptionZh: 一场毁灭性的疫情在美国感恩节购物旺季「黑色星期五」后横扫纽约市，全市的重要机构与基础设施接连瘫痪、在缺乏食物和水源下整个社会很快便陷入一片混乱之中。作为社会文明的最终防线，一支秘密且可独立运作的战术特工部队—「The Division」就此启动。你的任务是保护仅存的一切，并且重建希望。

games.title: Tom Clancy’s The Division
games.shortDescription: A tactical open world third-person shooter set in New York after a deadly pandemic. Team up or go solo to restore order against deadly factions, secure loot, and conquer high-risk endgame challenges. Rediscover this classic, now in 4K 60 FPS!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这是一款战术性的开放世界第三人称射击游戏，故事背景设定在致命疫情爆发后的纽约。你可以选择孤身奋战或团队协作，对抗致命派系，恢复城市秩序，还可以搜刮战利品，完成高风险的终局挑战。重温经典之作，现已支持 4K 60 帧！

games.title: Tom Clancy’s The Division 2
games.shortDescription: Join The Division in this open world tactical shooter. Engage in intense cover-based combat, team up with friends, and build your ultimate agent to save Washington, D.C.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 快來遊玩《湯姆克蘭西：全境封鎖 2》這款角色扮演射擊遊戲吧，血脈賁張的主線戰役完全支援多人合作，還有多種 PvP 模式任你暢玩。加入國土戰略局吧，這是一支由平民特工組成的菁英團隊，投身激烈的戰術對戰，與好友並肩作戰，在動態開放世界中求生，並從敵方勢力手中拯救華盛頓特區！

games.title: Tom Clancy’s The Division 2
games.shortDescription: Join The Division in this open world tactical shooter. Engage in intense cover-based combat, team up with friends, and build your ultimate agent to save Washington, D.C.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 快來遊玩《湯姆克蘭西：全境封鎖 2》這款角色扮演射擊遊戲吧，血脈賁張的主線戰役完全支援多人合作，還有多種 PvP 模式任你暢玩。加入國土戰略局吧，這是一支由平民特工組成的菁英團隊，投身激烈的戰術對戰，與好友並肩作戰，在動態開放世界中求生，並從敵方勢力手中拯救華盛頓特區！

games.title: Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4 - Cross-Gen Edition
games.shortDescription: Get hyped for the legendary franchise to return with Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4. Everything you loved is back, but revamped with more skaters, new parks, gnarlier tricks, eardrum shattering music, plus a whole lot more.
games.titleZh: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4- 跨世代版
games.shortDescriptionZh: 传奇归来，热血重燃！《Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 3+4》强势回归！深受玩家喜爱的经典玩法重装上阵，焕新出击：精英滑板手阵容升级、全新场地重磅亮相、花式技巧突破创新、劲爆音乐热血轰鸣，海量新内容等你来战！

games.title: Torment: Tides of Numenera
games.shortDescription: Explore Earth one billion years in the future in the science-fantasy setting of Numenera. Discover the Ninth World built on the bones of extinct, hyper-advanced civilizations and leave your own mark on it. Make thousands of essential choices, face the consequences, and meet death incarnated as you seek the answer to the ultimate question: What does one life matter?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在 Numenera 的科幻背景中探索十亿年后的地球。发现建立在已灭绝物种尸骨之上的第九个地球、高度先进的文明并在其上留下你自己的印记。做出数千个关键的选择并直面其后果，在寻求生命意义何在这一终极问题的答案之时，邂逅死亡的化身。

games.title: Torment: Tides of Numenera
games.shortDescription: Explore Earth one billion years in the future in the science-fantasy setting of Numenera. Discover the Ninth World built on the bones of extinct, hyper-advanced civilizations and leave your own mark on it. Make thousands of essential choices, face the consequences, and meet death incarnated as you seek the answer to the ultimate question: What does one life matter?
games.shortDescriptionZh: Explore Earth one billion years in the future in the science-fantasy setting of Numenera. Discover the Ninth World built on the bones of extinct, hyper-advanced civilizations and leave your own mark on it. Make thousands of essential choices, face the consequences, and meet death incarnated as you seek the answer to the ultimate question: What does one life matter?

games.title: Total Chaos
games.developer: Trigger Happy Interactive, Black Sheep Studio
games.shortDescription: Fort Oasis is no paradise—it's a decaying nightmare where reality crumbles. The creator of Turbo Overkill unleashes survival-horror stacked with mysteries and monstrosities. Scavenge to craft weapons, while a voice on your walkie-talkie guides you into the island's depths.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 绿洲堡绝非天堂——这是一场腐朽的恐怖魇梦，现实在此逐渐崩坏。《Total Chaos》是一款充满谜团与畸变怪物的生存恐怖游戏。你需在废墟中搜寻废料打造武器，并跟随对讲机里神秘声音的指引，深入这座岛屿的黑暗腹地。

games.title: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator
games.shortDescription: Be the leader of wobblers from ancient lands, spooky places and fantasy worlds. Watch them fight in simulations made with the wobbliest physics system ever created, make your own wobblers in the unit creator and send your army off to fight your friends in multiplayer.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 率领来自古代、亡灵、幻想世界的兵种，在这款基于史上最无厘头物理系统创建的游戏中展开激战。你也可以在兵种编辑器中创建自己的兵种，或者派出大军，与好友进行在线多人对战！

games.title: Totally Reliable Delivery Service
games.shortDescription: Buckle up your back brace and fire up the delivery truck, it's time to deliver! Join up to three of your friends and haphazardly get the job done in an interactive sandbox world. Delivery attempted, that's a Totally Reliable Delivery Service guarantee!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 系好你的护腰，发动运货卡车，该交货了！与三个好友一起加入，在交互式沙盒世界中随意完成工作。尝试交货才是Totally Reliable Delivery Service的保证！

games.title: Towerborne
games.shortDescription: Towerborne is an exciting side-scrolling Action RPG Brawler. As an immortal warrior journey across a crumbling world, uncover the mystery of the fallen City of Numbers, and push back the corruption threatening humanity’s survival.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Towerborne》是款节奏爽快的横版 ARPG。你将化身不死的“英灵战士”，肩负守护钟楼的使命，对抗入侵的黑暗势力。征程中，你将游历支离破碎的大地，揭开数字之城陷落的谜团，击退威胁人类存续的腐败力量。

games.title: Trackmania Turbo
games.shortDescription: Trackmania offers you the ultimate arcade racing universe where everything is about reaching the perfect racing time. Test your skills in over 200 tracks, experience immediate fun by challenging your friends at home (offline splitscreen) or online.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《赛道狂飙》呈现了极限街机赛车的世界，这是一个完美的赛车世界。游戏中拥有超过200个赛道来测试你的技术，在家中（本地分屏模式）或者在线挑战你的还有，体验即时竞赛的趣味。

games.title: Trackmania® Turbo
games.shortDescription:
Available for the very first time on Xbox One, Trackmania offers you the ultimate arcade racing universe where everything is about reaching the perfect racing time.
Test your skills in over 200 tracks, experience immediate fun by challenging your friends at home (offline splitscreen) or online.
The competition lasts forever: design and share your own tracks with other players in the Trackbuilder!
games.shortDescriptionZh:
Trackmania 首次在 Xbox One 推出，帶你體驗終極賽車境界，在這裡，速度勝於一切。
遊戲超過 200 條賽道，讓你在家（離線分割畫面）或線上跟好友瘋狂尬車，體驗即時快感。
永無止盡的競賽：在 Trackbuilder 設計賽道，並分享給其他玩家！

games.title: Trailmakers
games.shortDescription: Build the ultimate vehicle and explore a vast open world filled with challenges and adventure. Play solo or team up with friends in multiplayer to conquer the toughest obstacles. With a thrilling campaign mode and endless creative possibilities, Trailmakers is the ultimate sandbox for builders and adventurers alike.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《Trailmakers》中打造一个开放世界并徜徉在其中。释放你自身的能力，在《Trailmakers》中挥洒创意。这是一款前所未有的工程沙盒游戏，由全球最具创造力的游戏社区鼎力支持。

games.title: Transference
games.shortDescription: Imagine an escape room set in a deranged mind. Experience a first-person exploration game in a chilling new dimension. Shift between three perspectives of a family and unravel the mystery hiding in this mind-bending psychological thriller.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 想像一场以疯狂心智为背景的密室逃脱。以令人不寒而栗的全新角度，体验第一人称探索游戏；从深陷疯狂科学家实验中的一家三口各自的视角，试着揭开这部心理惊悚片背后复杂又神秘的面纱。

games.title: Transference™
games.shortDescription: Jump into an escape room set in a deranged mind and experience a first-person exploration game in a chilling new dimension. Shift between three perspectives and attempt to unravel the mystery hiding in this mind-bending psychological thriller.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 想像一場以瘋狂心智為背景的密室逃脫。以令人不寒而慄的全新角度，體驗第一人稱探索遊戲；從深陷瘋狂科學家實驗中的一家三口各自的視角，試著揭開這部心理驚悚片背後複雜又神秘的面紗。

games.title: Trepang2
games.shortDescription: Become the ultimate badass in Trepang2: A gory, action-packed FPS set in the distant future. Unleash all hell on your enemies, dodge bullets and leave a trail of destruction in this hardcore and frenetic shooter.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Trepang2》是一款背景设置在遥远未来、动作性十足的血腥第一人称射击游戏。在这款硬核的疯狂射击游戏中，对敌人释放猛烈炮火、躲避子弹并留下毁灭的痕迹，成为一名顶尖狠角色。

games.title: Trials Fusion
games.shortDescription: Trials Fusion combines simple yet addictive physics-based motorbike racing with the social and visual breakthroughs of the new generation of console gaming. Its frenzied multiplayer, global leader boards, track creation and sharing, and an all-new FMX tricks system ensure even more addictive gameplay.  Discover what has made the Trials series from RedLynx a hit with millions of players around the world.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
好玩的特技摩托又回来啦!

基于特技摩托系列扎实的核心玩法，聚变向玩家们发起了无止境的挑战，新一代的主机更为游戏画面带来了质的飞跃。
独特的障碍赛车玩法，激烈的竞争还有不断增加的赛道和功能，特技摩托:聚变的车轮永不停歇。在超现实的世界里接受多种多样的挑战，用精湛的技术越过满是荆棘和起伏的赛道，向着最佳圈速不断迈进。不论是职业赛模式，多人模式或是疯狂的锦标赛模式，竞争无处不在，带齐你的独门绝活成为最佳骑士吧！

健康游戏忠告
抵制不良游戏，拒绝盗版游戏。
注意自我保护，谨防受骗上当。
适度游戏益脑，沉迷游戏伤身。
合理安排时间，享受健康生活。

games.title: Trials Fusion
games.developer: RedLynx, in collaboration with Ubisoft Shanghai, Ubisoft Kiev
games.shortDescription: Trials Fusion is the gold-standard platform racer for the next-generation of gaming. Built upon the Trials franchise’s proven gameplay foundations, Fusion challenges players endlessly in both classic and all-new ways.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《特技摩托：聚变》的虚拟世界中挑战无穷无尽的关卡！运用你高超的技巧穿越充满障碍和斜坡，你可以和全世界最强的《特技摩托》玩家一比高下。无论你是独自飙车，官方赛道上的通过富有创意的、经验丰富的关卡制作者制作的地图，你可以不断征服最新的、最疯狂世界。在未来不断的新功能、新特色的支持下，你在《特技摩托》中的经历也会变得更加丰富，同时挑战其他玩家。

games.title: TRIALS of MANA
games.shortDescription:
Different destinies, different choices. 
The tale of three interwoven stories begins again. 

A full remake of Trials of Mana, originally released in 1995 and loved to this day by many Mana fans, finally makes its appearance on Xbox!
games.titleZh: 圣剑传说3 TRIALS of MANA
games.shortDescriptionZh:
各自的命运，各自的选择。
再度展开三途旅程。

于1995年发售，至今仍被许多“圣剑传说”粉丝喜爱的《圣剑传说3》的完全重制版终于登陆Xbox。

games.title: Trials of the Blood Dragon
games.shortDescription:
2019 - NOW.

12 years on from Vietnam War 2. Roxanne and Slayter, the offspring of the legendary Rex Power Colt are going to Vietnam War 4 to save freedom, and save the world.
Discover an epic single player experience with the unique combination of competitive, precise Trials gameplay- and rather less precise gun toting, neon-drenched Blood Dragon action.

The future is back. Are you ready?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 現在是 2019 年，傳奇中士 Rex Power Colt 的子女 Roxanne 和 Slayter 將要投入越南戰爭 4 拯救自由，並且拯救世界。準備迎接超精彩的單人遊戲體驗，結合競爭、精密和體能的《Trials》遊戲方式，以及沒那麼精密的槍戰、鐵球亂甩和大發霓虹光的《Blood Dragon》動作風格。未來回來找你，你準備好了嗎？

games.title: TRIALS OF THE BLOOD DRAGON
games.shortDescription: The year is 2019. Roxanne and Slayter, the offspring of the legendary Rex Power Colt, are going to Vietnam War 4 to save freedom, and save the world. Discover an epic single player experience with the unique combination of competitive, precise, physics-based Trials gameplay- and rather less precise gun toting, balls swinging, neon-drenched Blood Dragon action. The future is back. Are you ready?
games.shortDescriptionZh: 现在是 2019 年，传奇威猛中士 Rex Colt 的子女 Roxanne 和 Slayter 将要投入第四次越南战争中拯救自由，并且拯救世界。准备迎接超精彩的单人游戏体验，结合竞赛、操控准确度和真实物理效果的《特技摩托赛》游戏方式，以及没那么精准的枪战、铁球乱甩和大发霓虹光的《血龙》动作风格。未来风又回来了，你准备好了吗？

games.title: Trials Rising
games.shortDescription: Explore over-the-top action and physics-bending motorcycle racing in the latest opus of the Trials franchise.  With new tracks in exotic places all over the world  and more ways to compete, Trials® Rising is the best one yet.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《Trials》系列最新作中探索充滿極限動作與挑戰物理極限的摩托車競速。透過遍布全世界各地的全新賽道，以及更多競賽方式，《Trials® Rising》將提供最棒的多人競速體驗。全新協力車合作模式、規模更大的賽道中心與道具自訂工具為你帶來無窮樂趣。吃得土中土，方為人上人。

games.title: Trials® Rising
games.shortDescription: Explore over-the-top action and physics-bending motorcycle racing in Trials® Rising, the latest edition of the Trials franchise. All new features, more competitions, and more tracks mean new challenges!  Pre-order now to receive the Jungle Rider Pack and the Wild West Ride Pack!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《Trials》系列最新作中探索充滿極限動作與挑戰物理極限的摩托車競速。透過遍布全世界各地的全新賽道，以及更多競賽方式，《Trials® Rising》將提供最棒的多人競速體驗。全新協力車合作模式、規模更大的賽道中心與道具自訂工具為你帶來無窮樂趣。吃得土中土，方為人上人。

games.title: TUNIC
games.shortDescription: Explore a land filled with lost legends, ancient powers, and ferocious monsters in TUNIC, an isometric action game about a small fox on a big adventure.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在TUNIC中探索一个失落的传说、古老的力量和凶猛的怪物的土地，这是一个关于小狐狸大冒险的无透视三维动作游戏。

games.title: UFC® 4
games.shortDescription: In EA SPORTS UFC 4 the fighter you become is shaped by your fight style, your achievements, and your personality. No matter how or where you play EA SPORTS UFC 4 puts ‘you’ at the center of every fight.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《EA SPORTS UFC 4》中，您的战斗风格、成就和个性塑造了你的斗士。无论您是如何游玩或是在哪游玩，您都将是《EA SPORTS UFC 4》中战斗的中心。

games.title: UFC® 5
games.shortDescription: Powered by Frostbite™, EA SPORTS™ UFC® 5 is the next evolution of the fight game. From unrivalled graphics upgrades to all-new damage systems and doctor stoppages that affect gameplay in truly authentic fashion — this is as real as it gets.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 由 Frostbite™ 驱动的《EA SPORTS™ UFC™ 5》将开辟格斗游戏的新纪元。从无与伦比的画面升级，到影响游戏进程的全新伤害系统和伤停——一切都极尽真实。

games.title: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon
games.shortDescription: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon is a bike-racing party game where you and your friends build the course together. Add obstacles and dangerous traps, take the lead with power-ups, and race to the finish!
games.shortDescriptionZh: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon 是一款可以自定义赛道的自行车竞速派对游戏。挑战遍布的障碍物与危险陷阱，强化道具可助你一马当先，直达终点！

games.title: Undisputed
games.shortDescription: Become Undisputed and rule the ring in the most authentic boxing game to date! Featuring true to life visuals, bone-jarring action, and more licensed boxers than ever before, Undisputed gives you unprecedented control to master every inch of the ring.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 称霸当今最正宗的拳击游戏《Undisputed》并统治擂台！《Undisputed》不仅有栩栩如生的视觉效果、拳拳到肉的格斗，其中囊括的职业拳击手数量之多更是史无前例，绝对能让玩家获得前所未见的操控感，打遍擂台无敌手。

games.title: UNO®
games.shortDescription: One of the most iconic classic games which we all grew to know and love! UNO makes its return with an assortment of exciting new features such as added video chat support and an all new theme system which adds more fun!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这是我们从小熟知并喜爱的最为经典的标志性游戏之一！《UNO》带着各种令人振奋的新功能回归啦，我们增加了视频聊天支持，还有全新的主题系统，为你带来更多乐趣！

games.title: UNO™
games.shortDescription: Dive into the iconic game that we all grew up with! Match cards by color, number, or symbol, play action cards, and race to empty your hand first. Spice things up with fun House Rules and customize your game with colorful boards, card decks, and avatars. Play solo or challenge your friends locally or online with up to 4 players for endless fun!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 进入伴随我们长大的标志性游戏！按照颜色、数字或符号匹配卡牌，打出行动卡，看谁先清空自己的手牌。通过乐趣无穷的家规，让比赛更加刺激，你还能使用彩色的面板、卡组和虚拟形象自定义游戏。无论是单人游戏，还是在线上或本地向好友发起挑战，与最多 4 名玩家一较高下，在这里，你都能畅享无尽的快乐！

games.title: Unravel
games.shortDescription: Unravel introduces Yarny, a character made from a single thread of yarn.  Inspired by environments of Northern Scandinavia, Unravel is a physics-based puzzle platformer. Yarny is a representation of the ties that bind loved-ones together. Embark with Yarny on a larger than life adventure to reconnect the long-lost memories of a family.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《崩解（Unravel）》为玩家介绍一名可爱讨喜的新面孔：亚尼。亚尼是一根毛线所制成的。《崩解》的设计灵感来自斯堪地那维亚北部的美景，是一款以物理学为基础的平台解谜益智游戏。亚尼象征着将相爱的人系在一块的结。加入亚尼的冒险旅程，将家庭长久以来被遗忘的记忆链接在一起。

games.title: Unravel Two
games.shortDescription: When you cut ties to the past, new bonds form. In Unravel Two, create relationships with other Yarnys in local co-op or as a single player, fostering friendship and support as you solve challenges together. Chase the spark of adventure through stunning landscapes to watch your surroundings blossom with new life.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 当你剪断了与过去的联系，新的纽带就会形成。 在《Unravel Two》的本地合作模式中与别的亚尼建立关系，或进行单人模式，随着你们共同解决难关，友情也会在相互扶持中愈加深厚。 在惊艳的风景中追寻冒险的火花，让你身边的事物焕发新生。

games.title: Valiant Hearts: The Great War
games.shortDescription: Valiant Hearts - The Great War is the story of 4 crossed destinies and a broken love in a world torn apart.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《英勇之心：偉大戰役》的故事由四位主角的命運交織而成，訴說了一段迫於大環境而顛沛流離的愛情故事。

games.title: Valiant Hearts: The Great War
games.shortDescription:
This is the story of crossed destinies and a broken love in a world torn apart.

All of them will try to survive the horror of the trenches following their faithful canine companion.

In Valiant Hearts, the lives of all these characters are inextricably drawn together over the course of the game. Friendship, love, sacrifice and tragedy befall each one as they help each other to retain their humanity against the horrors of war.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 这是一个发生在分裂的世界中，关于人物交错的命运与一段破碎爱情的故事。主角将和自己忠实的军犬一同努力，在可怕的战壕中努力存活。随着《勇敢的心》的游戏进程，人们的生活不可避免地交织在了一起。友情、爱情、牺牲、悲剧降临到每一个人的头上，而他们要帮助彼此对抗战争的恐怖，重新找回人性。

games.title: VALORANT PC
games.shortDescription:
VALORANT is a character-based 5v5 tactical shooter set on the global stage. Outwit, outplay, and outshine your competition with tactical abilities, precise gunplay, and adaptive teamwork.

With Game Pass, members will unlock: 
●	All current Agents 
●	Day-one access to every new Agent as they're released
●	20% Match XP boost given to Battlepass, Event Pass, and active Agent Contract progress.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
VALORANT is a character-based 5v5 tactical shooter set on the global stage. Outwit, outplay, and outshine your competition with tactical abilities, precise gunplay, and adaptive teamwork.

With Game Pass, members will unlock:

●	Day-one access to every new Agent as they're released
●	20% Match XP boost given to Battlepass, Event Pass, and active Agent Contract progress.

games.title: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
games.shortDescription: Deal world-ending combos and blitz through infested dungeons! Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors is a casual, turn‑based deckbuilder with roguelite elements. Master the TURBOTURNTTM with your own hands of cards.
games.titleZh: 吸血鬼爬行者: 屠戮地牢的吸血鬼幸存者
games.shortDescriptionZh:
黑暗的世界中，新的冒险开始了。探索地图，升级力量，击杀怪物，寻找宝藏。

轻度Rogue、回合制、卡牌……来自（意外）三次获得BAFTA奖项的《Vampire Survivors》开发者全新打造了《Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors》，将Survivors的爽快玩法融入了这款超上头的地下城探索新作。构筑绝杀牌组，从新的视角探索熟悉的地下城，释放毁天灭地的连击。要么稳扎稳打、运筹帷幄，要么以最快速度结束回合：结果总是准确的，毕竟我们说它“超上头”不是没有原因的！

游戏内容
滚雪球般的回合制杀戮：按照法力从小到大的顺序出牌连击，每一手牌都结合下一张卡牌的效果倍增。使用万能牌不断叠加至10、20、30……你能一直叠到无穷大吗？
跟随自己的节奏：要么稳扎稳打、运筹帷幄，要么以最快速度结束回合：结果总是准确的，毕竟

metacritic.title: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors

games.title: Vampire Survivors
games.shortDescription: Vampire Survivors is a time survival game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelite elements.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
来猎杀暗夜的魔物吧！杀出重围，迎来胜利的黎明！ Vampire Survivors是一款结合了哥特式恐怖和肉鸽元素的休闲游戏，通过一次次的选择让角色越变越强，身处怪物的重重包围也无所畏惧

地狱空荡荡，恶魔在此间。谁都逃不过，哪儿都藏不住。你唯一能做的就是奋力作战，尽可能地多活久一点，直到最终面对必然的死亡。从每一轮的战斗中收集金币，购买强化，帮助下一位幸存者。

超自然题材热门独游，带你体验弹幕游戏的快乐！

入门小技巧
* 不用急着收集宝石或物品，它们不会消失的。
* 开局时要拿到两个或三个武器，但在升级时要重点关注其中某一个。
* 护甲和运气是早期值得投入金钱的强化属性。
* 你可以时常重置强化，反正是免费的。另外，去试试不一样的升级路线吧。

games.title: Vapor World: Over The Mind (Game Preview)
games.shortDescription: Lost in darkness, a boy drawn into a twisted dream, no way out. Vapor World is a narrative-driven souls-like platformer with deflection combat in a dreamlike world. Descend into a shattered mind seeking lost memories. Face a dark, beautiful world born of anguish and regret.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 迷失於黑暗的少年，被拽入扭曲的夢境，無路可逃。《蒸汽世界》（Vapor World: Over The Mind）是一款以彈反戰鬥為核心的劇情驅動魂系平台動作遊戲，舞台鋪展於一片如夢似幻的世界。深入支離破碎的心靈，追尋失落的記憶。直面由苦痛與悔恨孕育而生的黑暗而華美的世界。

games.title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage
games.shortDescription: The pioneer 3D fighting series continues to evolve as Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage arrives on Xbox Series X|S.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 不断追求真实感的3D格斗游戏始祖“Virtua Fighter”，终于登陆Xbox Series X|S。

games.title: Visions of Mana
games.shortDescription: Explore a world of elemental spirits and adventure in the latest Mana action-RPG.
games.titleZh: 圣剑传说 Visions of Mana
games.shortDescriptionZh:
体验围绕着圣剑和玛那之树展开的全新故事。
本作是一款动作RPG，玩家可以借助精灵之力在广阔的3D原野中自由驰骋。

games.title: Viva Piñata
games.shortDescription: Attract and tame your favourite Piñatas. There are more than 60 species that roam wild on Piñata Island.Personalise everything from the grass at your feet to the hat on your Piñata's head.Welcome to Piñata Island, enjoy your stay!
games.shortDescriptionZh: Attract and tame your favourite Piñatas. There are more than 60 species that roam wild on Piñata Island.Personalise everything from the grass at your feet to the hat on your Piñata's head.Welcome to Piñata Island, enjoy your stay!

games.title: Viva Piñata: TIP
games.shortDescription: Welcome back to Piñata Island where Prof. Pester's latest scheme has lead to disaster.Visit the scorching desert or icy wastes to trap new species. Train them, dress them, then send them to a party!We’ve new Piñatas, new activities, new features and new secrets, so come visit and find out why people never want to leave.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 歡迎你回到被壞私特教授弄的一蹋糊塗的寶貝島！造訪熱呼呼沙漠或冷颼颼極區來捕捉新寶貝，訓練並打扮牠們，然後送寶貝們去參加派對！在這個寶貝島中有全新的寶貝物種、新活動、新功能和新祕密。快來造訪寶貝島，你就會發現大家流連忘返的原因囉！

games.title: VOID/BREAKER (Game Preview)
games.shortDescription: Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS
games.shortDescriptionZh: 让人肾上腺素狂飙的 Roguelite 第一人称射击游戏

games.title: Voidtrain
games.shortDescription: Become a crew member of an Interdimensional Express Train! Discover a new world full of mysterious creatures, enemies and places. Upgrade and customize your train, gather new materials and build better weapons. Play solo or online сo-op with up to 4 people.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 成为多维特快列车的一员吧！探索新世界里的神秘生物、敌人和地点。升级并自定义你的火车，收集新材料并建造更好的武器。可单人游玩，也可在线进行最多4人的联机合作。

games.title: War Thunder
games.shortDescription: War Thunder is the most comprehensive free-to-play MMO military game dedicated to aviation, armoured vehicles, and naval craft from World War II and the Cold War. Join now and take part in major battles on land, in the air, and at sea, fighting with millions of players from all over the world in an ever-evolving environment.
games.shortDescriptionZh: War Thunder is the most comprehensive free-to-play MMO military game dedicated to aviation, armoured vehicles, and naval craft from World War II and the Cold War. Join now and take part in major battles on land, in the air, and at sea, fighting with millions of players from all over the world in an ever-evolving environment.

games.title: Warcraft® I: Remastered
games.shortDescription: Relive the original Warcraft tale of Orcs & Humans
games.shortDescriptionZh: 重温最初的魔兽传说，就在《兽人与人类》

games.title: Warcraft® II: Remastered
games.shortDescription: Master the tides in Warcraft's second iconic title
games.shortDescriptionZh: 游玩魔兽宇宙第二部经典游戏，掌控影响世界的巨浪

games.title: Warcraft® III: Reforged
games.shortDescription: A classic favorite, reforged
games.shortDescriptionZh: 经典游戏，完美重制

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide
games.shortDescription:
Take back the city of Tertium from hordes of bloodthirsty foes in this intense and brutal action shooter. Warhammer 40,000: Darktide is the new co-op focused experience from the award-winning team behind the Vermintide series.

As Tertium falls, Rejects Will Rise.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
枪林弹雨，血雨腥风。在这款激烈残酷的动作射击游戏中，你将击杀无数嗜血凶恶的敌人，夺回巢都特提恩。《战锤40K：暗潮》是一款全新多人合作游戏，由曾开发《战锤：末世鼠疫》系列、屡获殊荣的团队——肥鲨（Fatshark）倾力打造，将带给你全新的游戏体验！

特提恩衰落之际，正名之战打响之时。

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader
games.shortDescription: THE FIRST CLASSIC CRPG IN THE WARHAMMER 40,000 UNIVERSE
games.shortDescriptionZh: 第一款以战锤40000世界为背景的经典角色扮演游戏

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2
games.shortDescription: Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine and defend the Imperium in spectacular third-person action in solo or multiplayer modes.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 体验星际战士的超人技能和残暴手段，选择单人或多人模式，在恢弘的第三人称战斗中保卫帝国。

games.title: Warhammer: Vermintide 2
games.shortDescription: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 is the sequel to the critically acclaimed Warhammer: End Times - Vermintide. Fight together with your friends against the forces of Chaos and Skaven in this epic 4-player co-op game set in the Warhammer Fantasy Battles world. Vermintide 2 expands the intense first-person combat with a brand new enemy faction, 15 new career paths, talent trees, new weapons, an improved loot system, and more.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 is the sequel to the critically acclaimed Warhammer: End Times - Vermintide. Fight together with your friends against the forces of Chaos and Skaven in this epic 4-player co-op game set in the Warhammer Fantasy Battles world. Vermintide 2 expands the intense first-person combat with a brand new enemy faction, 15 new career paths, talent trees, new weapons, an improved loot system, and more.

games.title: Wartales
games.shortDescription: Wartales is an open world RPG in which you lead a group of mercenaries in their search for wealth across a massive medieval universe. Explore the world, recruit companions, collect bounties and unravel the secrets of the tombs of the ancients!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《战争传说》是一款开放世界 RPG 游戏，你将带领一群雇佣兵在浩大的中世纪宇宙中进行探索，寻觅财富。探索世界，招募同伴，领取赏金，揭开先民之墓的秘密！

games.title: Wasteland 3
games.shortDescription: The Patriarch of Colorado has promised to help the Desert Rangers if you can rescue his land from his three bloodthirsty children. In this post-apocalyptic RPG you must travel north to build a new base, equip a vehicle, train recruits, explore Colorado's hostile frozen wastes, and deal with the locals—but remember, every choice has a consequence.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 科羅拉多大元老已經答應，如果你能從他三位嗜血為樂的孩子手中拯救他的領地科羅拉多，他就會協助沙漠巡警。在這款浩劫後的RPG中，你必須一路北上建造一座新的基地、裝備車輛、培訓新兵，探索科羅拉多敵方的凍原荒地，並與當地人打交道——但請記住，每種選擇都有其後果。

games.title: Wasteland 3 (PC)
games.shortDescription: The Patriarch of Colorado has promised to help the Desert Rangers if you can rescue his land from his three bloodthirsty children. In this post-apocalyptic RPG you must travel north to build a new base, equip a vehicle, train recruits, explore Colorado's hostile frozen wastes, and deal with the locals—but remember, every choice has a consequence.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 科羅拉多大元老已經答應，如果你能從他三位嗜血為樂的孩子手中拯救他的領地科羅拉多，他就會協助沙漠巡警。在這款浩劫後的RPG中，你必須一路北上建造一座新的基地、裝備車輛、培訓新兵，探索科羅拉多敵方的凍原荒地，並與當地人打交道——但請記住，每種選擇都有其後果。

games.title: Wasteland Remastered
games.shortDescription: The RPG classic rises from the nuclear ashes! Wasteland Remastered is an overhaul of the 1988 title that brought the post-apocalypse to video games. Bring law to a lawless future or burn everything to the ground with full freedom of choice and consequence. See where the Wasteland series began and experience the character and world the sequels are built on.
games.shortDescriptionZh: The RPG classic rises from the nuclear ashes! Wasteland Remastered is an overhaul of the 1988 title that brought the post-apocalypse to video games. Bring law to a lawless future or burn everything to the ground with full freedom of choice and consequence. See where the Wasteland series began and experience the character and world the sequels are built on.

games.title: Watch Dogs®: Legion
games.shortDescription: Build a resistance from anyone in the world as you fight to take back a near-future London facing its downfall. Experience never-before-seen gameplay innovation that allows you to recruit and play as any character. Everyone has a unique skill to help your team. Recipient of over 65 E3 awards and nominations.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在《看門狗：自由軍團》中，隨著你駭入、滲透及戰鬥，你可以和遇到的幾乎每一位角色攜手組成反抗勢力，共同拯救正一步步走向崩毀的近未來倫敦。歡迎加入反抗軍。
於線上模式的全新任務與好友並肩作戰，帶領反抗軍向前邁進吧。

games.title: Watch Dogs®: Legion
games.shortDescription: Build a resistance from anyone in the world as you fight to take back a near-future London facing its downfall. Experience never-before-seen gameplay innovation that allows you to recruit and play as any character. Everyone has a unique skill to help your team. Recipient of over 65 E3 awards and nominations.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《看门狗：军团》中，随着黑客活动、渗透和战斗的进行，您可以与遇到的每个人联手，打造一支反抗军，夺回即将沦陷的近未来伦敦。欢迎加入反抗军！

games.title: Watch Dogs®2
games.shortDescription: Welcome to San Francisco. Play as Marcus, a brilliant young hacker, and join the most notorious hacker group, DedSec. Your objective: execute the biggest hack of the history.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 欢迎来到技术革命的起源地：旧金山。扮演年轻的聪明黑客马可仕（Marcus），加入最恶名昭彰的黑客团体 DedSec。你的目标：执行史上最大规模的黑客行动。

games.title: Watch Dogs®2
games.shortDescription: Welcome to San Francisco. Play as Marcus, a brilliant young hacker, and join the most notorious hacker group, DedSec. Your objective: execute the biggest hack of the history.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 欢迎来到技术革命的起源地：旧金山。扮演年轻的聪明黑客马可仕（Marcus），加入最恶名昭彰的黑客团体 DedSec。你的目标：执行史上最大规模的黑客行动。

games.title: WATCH_DOGS
games.shortDescription: All it takes is the swipe of a finger. We connect with friends. We buy the latest gadgets and gear. We find out what’s happening in the world. But with that same simple swipe, we cast an increasingly expansive shadow. With each connection, we leave a digital trail that tracks our every move and milestone, our every like and dislike. And it’s not just people. Today, all major cities are networked.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
只需滑动手指，您就可以联系亲朋好友、购买最新出品的手工零件和工具，还能获知世界各地的新闻。但通过同样简单的滑动动作，我们还能投下不断扩张的阴影。每一次连接我们都会留下电子痕迹，循着这些痕迹就能追踪我们生活中的每一个行为和重要事件，辨别我们的好恶——而这不仅仅适用于人。如今所有的大城市都有网络连接，市区的基础设施都由复杂的操作系统监视控制。

在《看门狗》当中，这个系统被称作中央控制系统（ctOS）。它控制了城市科技的几乎每一个角落，掌握了全体城市居民的关键信息。玩家在游戏中将扮演艾登·皮尔斯，作为一名天才黑客和曾经的恶徒，他过去的犯罪行为曾导致了一场可怕的家庭悲剧。现在，玩家正在追踪曾经伤害主角家人的罪魁祸首。通过操纵所有连入城市网络的物件，玩家能够监控并骇入身边所有人的系统。还可以接入无所不在的监控摄像头，下载目标的个人资料以定位他们，控制交通信号灯和公共交通系统来阻拦敌人，以及更多可能

games.title: WATCH_DOGS™
games.shortDescription: Play as Aiden Pearce, a brilliant hacker, whose criminal past led to a violent family tragedy. Now on the hunt for those who hurt your family, monitor and hack all who surround you by manipulating everything connected to the city’s network. Access omnipresent security cameras, download personal information to locate a target, control traffic lights and public transportation to stop the enemy. Use the city of Chicago as your ultimate weapon and exact your own style of revenge.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在今日高度聯網的世界中，芝加哥市被最尖端的電腦網路 ctOS 所管理。 身為艾登‧皮爾斯，你駭入並操控著 ctOS，將整個城市變為你執行私法正義的武器。

games.title: We Happy Few
games.shortDescription: Set in a drug-fuelled, retrofuturistic city in an alternative 1960s England, We Happy Few is an action/adventure game in which you hide, fight, and conform your way out of a delusional Joy-obsessed world.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Set in a drug-fuelled, retrofuturistic city in an alternative 1960s England, We Happy Few is an action/adventure game in which you hide, fight, and conform your way out of a delusional Joy-obsessed world.

games.title: Wheel World
games.shortDescription: Dive into Wheel World as Kat, a rider chosen by ancient cycling spirits. Race elite teams, trick out your bike, and perform the long overdue Great Shift ritual to save a universe on the brink! Your bike is your destiny.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 调校好你的自行车，超越你的对手，完成你的使命。

games.title: Where Winds Meet
games.shortDescription: Where Winds Meet is an epic Wuxia open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China at the tenth century. Players will assume the role of a young sword master as they embark on a journey to uncover the mysteries of their own identity. Let the wind carry your legend on an epic journey to the East!Game requires online multiplayer and user-generated content to play on both console and PC.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《燕云十六声》是一款以武侠文化为核心的史诗级开放世界动作冒险角色扮演游戏。 故事背景设定在动荡的十世纪中国，你将化身一名年轻的剑客，揭开被遗忘的真相与自身身世的谜团。 当清风拂过山河之际，你的传奇也将随之展开。游戏需要打开多人游戏和UGC内容权限才能在主机和PC上游玩。

games.title: WILD HEARTS™ Standard Edition
games.shortDescription: Master ancient tech to hunt down giant beasts. WILD HEARTS™ is a twist on the hunting genre where ancient tech gives you a fighting chance against giant nature-infused beasts. Set in a fantasy feudal Japan, hunt alone or with friends in seamless co-op.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 掌握机巧奇术，狩猎巨型野兽。《WILD HEARTS™》是款独具特色的狩猎游戏，您可以利用古代科技对抗与自然融合的巨型野兽。故事设定于奇幻的封建日本，您可以独自狩猎，也可以与朋友并肩作战。

games.title: Wildgate
games.shortDescription: Wildgate is a PvPvE multiplayer shooter that blends tactical ship-to-ship combat with fast-paced first-person action. Evade deadly environmental hazards, search for powerful weapons and ship upgrades, and be the first crew to escape with the Artifact... or the last crew left flying.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《Wildgate》是一款结合了星舰战术作战与快节奏第一人称动作的多人 PvP 射击游戏。在危险环境中腾挪躲闪，搜寻强大武器与星舰升级资源，带上遗珍逃离这片星域……或是血战到底，直到只余最后一艘星舰。

games.title: Winds of Arcana: Ruination
games.shortDescription: Discover the secrets of a sundered world as you help Aryn save his comrades in this story-rich, fully-voiced, 2.5D action-platformer. Fight terrible dangers and explore ancient mysteries as Aryn uncovers the forces that forge his destiny.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在一片被古老力量撕裂的破碎大陆上，你的同伴正身陷险境。这趟史诗般的冒险，将考验你的勇气与智慧。驾驭强大魔法，挥舞传奇武器，对抗步步紧逼的宿命强敌，探索广袤的世界，在废墟深处揭开世界崩坏的最终真相。同伴的性命、世界的存续，皆悬于你一念之间 —— 准备好回应命运的召唤了吗？

games.title: Winter Burrow
games.shortDescription: Winter Burrow is a cozy woodland survival game about a mouse returning home to restore their childhood burrow. Explore, gather resources, craft, knit warm sweaters, bake pies and meet the locals.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Winter Burrow 是一款关于一只小鼠回家修复它儿时洞穴的温馨森林生存游戏。探索、收集资源、制作工具、编织温暖的毛衣、烘焙馅饼并与当地居民见面。

games.title: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty
games.shortDescription:
From the depths of darkness, a dragon soars. 

A new dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG, presented by Team NINJA.

184 AD, Later Han Dynasty China. The land is overcome by chaos and destruction. The imperial dynasty that prospered for many years is now about to collapse. 

Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty is a dramatic, action-packed story of a nameless militia soldier fighting for survival in a
games.titleZh: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty （卧龙：苍天陨落）
games.shortDescriptionZh:
妖邪乱世 龙跃在渊

Team Ninja出品暗黑三国诛死游戏。

西历184年，中国。时值东汉末年，硝烟四起，生灵涂炭。
昔日睥睨天下的大汉王朝，其天命如今摇摇欲坠。
在结合历史、 奇幻与动作元素的本三国动作RPG中，
玩家将化身为无名义勇兵，运用融合了中华武术精髓的剑戟动作，
力挑各路英雄豪杰与横行跋扈的妖魔，踏破三国乱世。

以东汉末年的中原大地为舞台，玩家将化身无名义勇兵，
运用融合了中华武术精髓的剑戟动作，踏破妖魔横行之乱世。
此外，本作还设计了崭新的战略要素，帮助玩家克服逆境。

※所有下载内容皆需连接网络方可执行。
※本产品为通常版。另有包含本产品内容在内的“Complete Edition”可供选购 。

games.title: Wobbly Life
games.shortDescription: Wobbly Life is a vibrant open-world physics sandbox. Play with your friends online or in local co-op, with exciting jobs, mini games and wacky story missions. Earn cash to spend in the world on clothes, vehicles and houses. There is a whole Wobbly World out there to explore!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《晃晃人生》是一款基于物理的开放世界沙盒游戏。欢乐小游戏与经营模拟融为一体，各种打工和剧情任务蕴藏无限惊喜。赚取现金，购买衣服、车辆和房屋，在晃晃岛享受你的非凡人生！最多支持4人在线或本地联机。游戏支持中文。

games.title: Wolfenstein 3D
games.shortDescription: You are OSA super agent B.J. Blazkowicz and you must escape from Castle Wolfenstein and defeat the twisted Nazi regime!
games.shortDescriptionZh: You are OSA super agent B.J. Blazkowicz and you must escape from Castle Wolfenstein and defeat the twisted Nazi regime!

games.title: Wolfenstein 3D
games.shortDescription: World War II rages. The Nazis are planning to build an unstoppable, mutant army. On a mission to steal the secret plans, you were captured and imprisoned. Now, a lucky break gives you the chance to escape, but a maze of passages and trigger-happy Nazis stand in your way.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 二战期间，纳粹计划打造无人能挡的变异军团。你接到任务，要去偷取这个秘密计划，但不幸被俘。现在你幸运地逃脱了，不过前方等待你的却是迷宫般的路线和嗜血的纳粹。

games.title: Wolfenstein II: Standard Edition
games.shortDescription: Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus is the highly anticipated sequel to the critically acclaimed, Wolfenstein®: The New Order™ developed by the award-winning studio MachineGames.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 继广受好评的《德军总部：新秩序》（Wolfenstein®: The New Order™）后，获奖无数的MachineGames工作室推出了万众瞩目的续作《德军总部II：新巨像》（Wolfenstein® II: The New Colossus™）。《Wolfenstein®II》采用领先业界的id Tech®6引擎，完美呈现了一场精彩刺激的冒险。玩家将前往受纳粹控制的美国，召集所有遗留下的英勇反抗军领袖。在美国各个知名地标与纳粹浴血奋战，并装备强力武装、解放全新技能，在这场第一人称射击游戏中力搏纳粹军队，杀出一条血路。

games.title: Wolfenstein: The New Order
games.shortDescription: Europe, 1960. The tide of World War II has been turned using a new kind of mysterious, advanced technology. Using unrelenting force and intimidation, a ruthless world power has brought even the most powerful of nations to their knees. The regime now dominates the globe with an iron fist. You are B.J. Blazkowicz, the American war hero. You are the only man capable of rewriting history.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在1960年的欧洲，纳粹透过一种崭新而神秘的先进科技扭转了败战的浪潮。它们驱策着无情的武力与威胁，让各个强国都屈服於其脚下。现在，纳粹以其铁腕统治了整个世界。这次，你将成为唯一一个胆敢对抗世上最强大军队的家伙。你就是毕杰．布雷斯柯维茨，美国的战争英雄。你是唯一有能力改写历史的人！

games.title: Wolfenstein: The New Order (PC)
games.shortDescription: Intense and cinematic, Wolfenstein: The New Order sends players across Europe on a personal mission to bring down the Nazi war machine.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 紧张激烈、极具影院效果：在《The New Order》中，玩家将穿越欧洲，以执行打倒纳粹战争机器的单人任务。

games.title: Wolfenstein: The Old Blood
games.shortDescription: Wolfenstein: The Old Blood is a standalone prequel to the critically acclaimed first-person action-adventure shooter, Wolfenstein: The New Order. The adventure, which spans eight chapters and two interconnected stories, features the hallmarks of MachineGames – thrilling action, immersive story and intense first-person combat.
games.shortDescriptionZh: Wolfenstein: The Old Blood is a standalone prequel to the critically acclaimed first-person action-adventure shooter, Wolfenstein: The New Order. The adventure, which spans eight chapters and two interconnected stories, features the hallmarks of MachineGames – thrilling action, immersive story and intense first-person combat.

games.title: Wolfenstein: The Old Blood (PC)
games.shortDescription: The year is 1946 and the Regime is on the brink of winning World War II. In an effort to turn the tide in the allies’ favor, B.J. Blazkowicz must embark on an epic, two-part mission deep within Bavaria….
games.shortDescriptionZh: 故事发生于1946年，当时法西斯政权即将赢得第二次世界大战的胜利。为了协助同盟国阵营扭转局势，B·J·布拉兹科维奇必须深入巴伐利亚，挑战一项分为两阶段进行的史诗任务……

games.title: Wolfenstein: Youngblood
games.shortDescription:
Try Wolfenstein: Youngblood for free. Access to all gameplay and features requires an invitation from a Buddy Pass owner.

Wolfenstein: Youngblood is the first modern co-op Wolfenstein adventure.

Team up with a friend or play solo as one of BJ Blazkowicz’s twin daughters and wield a powerful arsenal of new weapons, gadgets, and abilities to liberate Paris from the Nazis.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
快來免費試玩《Wolfenstein: Youngblood》。凡收到擁有Buddy Pass的玩家發出的邀請，即可享受所有遊戲內容與功能。

《Wolfenstein: Youngblood》是《Wolfenstein》首款現代合作冒險遊戲。

快來與好友組隊，或獨自與AI踏上戰場，扮演B．J．布拉柯威茲的雙胞胎女兒，施展威力強大的全套新武器、道具和技能，從納粹手中解放巴黎。

games.title: Wolfenstein: Youngblood (PC)
games.shortDescription:
Wolfenstein: Youngblood is the first modern co-op Wolfenstein adventure.

Team up with a friend or play solo as one of BJ Blazkowicz’s twin daughters and wield a powerful arsenal of new weapons, gadgets, and abilities to liberate Paris from the Nazis.
games.shortDescriptionZh:
《Wolfenstein: Youngblood》是首款当代《Wolfenstein》合作冒险游戏。

化身为B·J·布拉柯威兹的双胞胎女儿之一，使用大量的全新武器、工具和动力装甲战斗，与朋友组队歼敌，或者单打独斗，从纳粹手中解放巴黎。

games.title: Wolfenstein® II: The New Colossus™
games.shortDescription: America, 1961. The assassination of Nazi General Deathshead was a short-lived victory. The Nazis maintain their stranglehold on the world. You are BJ Blazkowicz, aka “Terror-Billy,” member of the Resistance, scourge of the Nazi empire, and humanity’s last hope for liberty. Only you have the guns and gumption to return stateside, kill every Nazi in sight, and spark the second American Revolution.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 1961年，美国。成功暗杀纳粹将军死颅，只是一场昙花一现的胜利，因为整个世界仍受纳粹的魔爪所操控。你是人称“恐怖威廉”的B‧J‧布拉柯威奇，是反抗军的一员、纳粹帝国的心腹之患，也是人类重获自由的最后希望。只有你有足够的武力和决心返回美国境内，击杀所有视线内的纳粹分子，发动第二次美国革命。

games.title: World of Tanks Modern Armor
games.shortDescription: World of Tanks Modern Armor puts you in command of over 1,000 modern and legendary tanks. Challenge yourself in 15v15 tactical team battles. Choose Cold War battles for modern, fast-paced action or World War II for deliberate, tactical combat.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在World of Tanks Modern Armor中指挥超过1,000辆现代和传奇坦克。在15v15的团队对战中挑战自己的极限。选择冷战模式体验快节奏的现代化战斗，或者在二战模式中体验步步为营、强调战术的严谨战斗。

games.title: World of Tanks: HEAT
games.shortDescription: World of Tanks: HEAT is a free-to-play PvP vehicle shooter with powerful hero abilities and explosive team combat. Pilot customizable tanks, unleash Agent skills, and take control in 10v10 online battles where tactical warfare meets FPS-style intensity.
games.shortDescriptionZh: World of Tanks: HEAT是一款免费的PvP坦克射击游戏，融合了强大的英雄能力和火爆的团队战斗。驾驶可自定义坦克，施展特工技能，在兼具战术博弈与第一人称射击游戏风格激情的线上战斗中主宰战局。

games.title: World of Warships
games.shortDescription:
Build a Fleet—Rule the Sea!

Key Features:
• Over 800 historical ships recreated in breathtaking, true-to-life detail.
• Five different ship types—submarines, destroyers, cruisers, battleships, and aircraft carriers—all offering distinct gameplay challenges.
• Tech Tree with 13 distinct nations and dozens of branches to explore.
• Epic multiplayer naval battles between massive fleets across a mult

games.title: World of Warships: Legends
games.shortDescription: Experience epic naval action in World of Warships: Legends, a global multiplayer free-to-play online game in which you can master the seas on the decks of history's greatest warships! Recruit Legendary Commanders, upgrade your vessels, and stake your claim to naval domination alongside and against players from around the world.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在《战舰世界：传奇》中体验史诗海军行动，这是一款免费的全球多人在线游戏，指挥历史上最伟大的军舰征服大海！招募传奇指挥官，升级您的战舰，和来自全球的玩家合作或对战，争夺海上霸权。

games.title: World War Z: Aftermath
games.shortDescription: World War Z: Aftermath is the ultimate co-op zombie shooter and the next evolution of the original hit World War Z that has captivated over 20 million players.  Fight off hordes of zombies in intense story episodes across new zombie-ravaged locations around the world.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《僵尸世界大战：劫后余生》是一款制作精良的合作类僵尸射击游戏，也是对《僵尸世界大战》的再度升级，后者吸引的玩家达2000万之众。跟随紧张激烈的故事主线，前往世界各地最新涌现的僵尸肆虐地，击退成群僵尸。

games.title: Wreckfest
games.shortDescription:
Break the rules and take full-contact racing to the limit with Wreckfest! 





Expect epic crashes, neck-to-neck fights over the finish line and brand-new ways for metal to bend – These are the once-in-a-lifetime moments that can only be achieved in Wreckfest, with its true-to-life physics simulation crafted by legendary developer Bugbear, who also brought you FlatOut 1 & 2!





Burn rubber and shred metal in the ultimate driving playground!
games.shortDescriptionZh:
在《Wreckfest》里打破规则，感受极限赛车！

期待史诗般的碰撞、终点线前并驾齐驱的争斗和全新的弯曲金属的方式——这些千载难逢的瞬间只能在《Wreckfest》里实现，它忠于生活的物理模拟是由传奇开发商Bugbear制作，就是他们创造了《FlatOut》1和2！

在终极驾驶场上燃烧橡胶、撕碎金属吧！

games.title: WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers
games.shortDescription: WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers is a soulslike, action RPG set in the land of Shu during the dark and tumultuous late Ming Dynasty, plagued with warring factions and a mysterious illness spawning monstrous creatures.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《明末：渊虚之羽》是一款类魂动作角色扮演游戏，故事发生在巴蜀之地，此时正值黑暗动荡的明末，战事四起，一场神秘的疫病催生了妖怪一般的生物。

games.title: Wuthering Waves
games.shortDescription: Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG with a high degree of freedom. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and change the world.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《鸣潮》是一款跨平台开放世界动作游戏，主打高自由度的动作战斗玩法与丰富多样的开放世界探索。而你，在这个世界苏醒的漂泊者，将在找回记忆、寻找自我身份的同时结识无数的共鸣者同伴，并和伙伴一起踏上改变这个世界的旅途。

games.title: Young Suns
games.shortDescription: Young Suns is a narrative life sim set after a successful revolution on Jupiter. Explore fantastical planetoids, derelict ruins, and converted stations with a crew of up to three friends or on your own. Help the friendly citizens of Jupiter rebuild!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 《未来的太阳》是一款叙事性生活模拟游戏，故事发生在木星，时间设定在一次革命之后。探索奇妙的小卫星、破败的遗迹和经过改造的空间站，最多可以带三个朋友，也可以独自行动。帮助木星友善的居民重建家园吧！

games.title: Zenless Zone Zero
games.shortDescription: Venture into a post-apocalyptic world, explore perilous Hollows, and unveil the mysteries behind the last beacon of hope for human civilization.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 踏上一段后末世冒险，探索危机四伏的空洞及文明最后一座灯塔背后的谜团。

games.title: ZOMBI
games.shortDescription: London is falling. Are you prepared?  For the second time in history, a great plague has shrouded London in a fog of death. The nail-biting survival experience of ZombiU™ is now available to everyone on Xbox One.  Zombi takes the power of the latest generation of hardware to bring you a new level of horror. Test your will to survive, but beware: one wrong move can cause you to lose everything.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 伦敦正在沦陷。你准备好了吗？史上第二次大规模的瘟疫把伦敦笼罩在死亡的毒雾当中。惊悚刺激的生存游戏《ZombiU™》现已登录 Xbox One。通过最新的硬件产品，Zombi 将为你带来全新级别的恐怖体验。考验你的生存意志，但是要当心：走错一步，可能会导致万劫不复。

games.title: ZOMBI
games.shortDescription: London is falling. Test your will to survive, but beware: one wrong move can cause you to lose everything and survival is not guaranteed.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 伦敦正在沦陷。快来测试一下你的意志力是否足够让你存活下去，但是，注意： 走错一步就有可能全盘皆输，你也因此一命呜呼。

games.title: Zombie Army 4: Dead War
games.shortDescription: Hitler’s hordes are back for more in this spine-chilling shooter! Occult enemies, epic weapons and a new campaign for 1-4 players await, as you fight to save humankind from undead Armageddon!
games.shortDescriptionZh: 在这款令人毛骨茸然的射击游戏中，希特勒的僵尸群又回来耍阴谋了！超自然敌人、非凡武器和全新1-4人战役翘首以待，你要为了从亡灵大决战中拯救人类而奋战！

games.title: Zoo Tycoon: Ultimate Animal Collection
games.shortDescription: The wildly popular Zoo Tycoon series gets fully-remastered and set to crank up the excitement, challenge, and fun of building the ultimate zoo. Let your imagination run wild with "Zoo Tycoon: Ultimate Animal Collection"! Build, manage, and maintain your dream zoo alone or with up to four players on Xbox LIVE.  This zoo simulation will charm animal lovers of all ages.
games.shortDescriptionZh: 广受欢迎的动物园大亨系列经过了全面重制，并且将建造终极动物园的刺激、挑战和乐趣提高到了一个新的水平。让您的想象力随着《Zoo Tycoon: Ultimate Animal Collection》尽情飞扬！建造、管理并维护您梦想中的动物园，或者在 Xbox Live 上和最多三名玩家一起进行游戏。这款动物园模拟游戏将会迷倒所有年龄段的动物爱好者们。

games.title: Zuma
games.shortDescription: Discover the ancient secrets of Zuma! Deep in the jungle lie hidden temples bursting with traps and trickery. It will take a quick hand and a sharp eye to unlock their treasures! Explore over 20 realms in adventure mode and put your skills to the test in the gauntlet. Fire magical balls from the stone frog idol to make color matches, then collect coins and powerups to clear the path. But watch out! If the stream of spheres reaches the golden skull, it’ll be the end for you!
